programme.title: Dogs: The Untold Story.
programme.desc: Dogs: The Untold Story is an amazing documentary series providing us with unbelievable stories, research results and facts about our best friends, healers and protectors- dogs. They have evolved from predators to favourite pets, adored by millions people all over the world. They can understand people and even talk to them, they have been by human's side for more than 33.000 years. Dogs are actually more incredible than anyone has ever imagined. (Dogs: The Untold Story). Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Animal Cribs.
programme.desc: American animal TV series with designer Antonio Ballatore own show creating the perfect space for pet owning families. Believing that if dad can have a "man cave" and mum a "she shed" then surely there is such thing as a animal crib?! Antonio's passion for design and animals shines through throughout every episode. Joined by project manager Grace and their trusty companion Chewie the Bulldog they produce the most fantastic spaces for both pets and their owners. Pets include Chinchillas, dogs, cats and snakes and possibly many more. (Animal Cribs). Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Lone Star Law.
programme.desc: Reality series, set in Texas and similar to ''North Woods Law'', that follows daily lives of men and women who are Game Wardens and whose job is to protect deserts, lakes, woods, bayous, coasts and wild animals that live in the second-largest state in the U.S. These people have their plates full as they must deal with poachers, hunters who don't obey the law, smugglers, while they rescue injured wildlife and defend citizens. (Lone Star Law). Gamtos.

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People.
programme.desc: Alaskan Bush People is an American docudrama-style reality TV series revolving around the Brown family, members of which are trying to survive in the wilderness, far away from the society. Take a journey deep into Alaska's bush, where naturalist and adventurer Billy Brown, along with his wife, Ami, and their seven children, choose to live life on their own terms, connected to wild nature and bonded to each other. (Alaskan Bush People).

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People.
programme.desc: Alaskan Bush People is an American docudrama-style reality TV series revolving around the Brown family, members of which are trying to survive in the wilderness, far away from the society. Take a journey deep into Alaska's bush, where naturalist and adventurer Billy Brown, along with his wife, Ami, and their seven children, choose to live life on their own terms, connected to wild nature and bonded to each other. (Alaskan Bush People).

programme.title: Project Grizzly.
programme.desc: The Project Grizzly series follows the trials and tribulations of world renowned bear trainer Jeff Watson as he battles against time to teach his rescued grizzlies the skills and tricks needed for them to survive back in the wild where they truly belong. The domesticated grizzlies Bob and Screech learn to live outside the cage, to fish, to hunt and to live in the wild. Raised by him since cubs, Jeff's decision is not only emotionally charged but emotive in the message it gives of a 'father's' love to do the best for his young. (Project Grizzly). Nuotykių. Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins.
programme.desc: US reality TV show follows the Irwin family through their adventures in continuing Steve Irwin's legacy. The family share their wildlife experiences from their travels across the world. They show how they care for all the animals while giving insight into their family life at Australia Zoo where they live and work. The Australian family including mother Terri who is a naturalist and conservationist stars alongside daughter Bindi and son Robert who are fully immerse in animal life and their family. (Crikey! It's the Irwins). Gyvūnai.

programme.title: The Zoo.
programme.desc: A behind-the-scenes look at the Bronx Zoo, one of the largest zoos in the USA and the largest city zoo the country has to offer. Opening their doors to camera crews, the daily operations of the world-famous animal sanctuary are revealed, as the staff keep their loving creatures healthy and happy. Renowned for its diverse collection of animals and wonderful exhibitions, the Bronx Zoo is one of the finest in the world, home to lions, bears, tigers, snow leopards, baboons, flamingos and many more extravagant species. This series showcases the effort, experience and expertise required to run the Bronx Zoo. (The Zoo). Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Homestead Rescue.
programme.desc: This reality TV show follows Marty Raney and his two children, Matt Raney and Misty Bilodeau, who are successful homesteaders from the state of Alaska and have the skills needed to fish, hunt, raise livestock, and otherwise survive in an untamed landscape. Struggling homesteaders across the country call these experts to help them save their homesteads and become self-sufficient while they teach them the necessary skills to survive the wilderness. (Homestead Rescue). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet.
programme.desc: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet is a TV series entirely dedicated to love and care for animals. Thanks to a genius Dr. Jeff Young Denver's Planned Pethood Plus veterinary clinic is always busy and is taking care of 80,000-plus clients and their pets. Dr. Jeff's sharp surgical skills and his unconditional love for animals make him one of the most respected vets in the country. Dr. Jeff has a dedicated team of more than 30 veterinary staffers and once a month they go to remote locations where people do not have access to vets. (Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet). Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Tanked.
programme.desc: Follow aquarium enthusiasts Brett Raymer and Wayde King as they attempt to build some of the most luxurious fish tanks in the world. At Acrylic Tank Manufacturing, the brothers-in-law guide you through the design process and the building of their truly jaw-dropping aquariums. Experience the unveiling of finished tanks housed everywhere from restaurants and banks, to glamorous casinos and mansions. Join the duo in their Las Vegas workshop as they deliver some budget-shattering builds to their high-profile clientele. (Tanked).

programme.title: Animal Cops: Houston.
programme.desc: Animal Cops - Houston is the third Animal Planet series to follow the work of animal cruelty investigators. This particular series follows the animal cruelty investigators of the Houston Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (HSPCA). This team of 8 investigators works in a large area of Texas investigating reports of animal cruelty and, when necessary, removing animals from horrible abuse situations. Since these investigators do not have arrest or warrant seeking powers on their own, they work closely with local law enforcement, including the Harris County Precinct One Constable's Office. This office has permantly assigned Deputy Constable Christine Kendrick to assist the HSPCA investigators with any law enforcement issue that arises, including seeking warrents and arresting those charged with animal cruelty. (Animal Cops: Houston). Kriminalai. Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Pit Bulls & Parolees.
programme.desc: Pit bulls are eager to please, faithful and enthusiastic friends and pleasant with children according to credible canine organizations. But they have fallen from grace. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls. (Pit Bulls & Parolees). Gyvūnai.

programme.title: My Cat from Hell.
programme.desc: Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. These are attacks and misbehavior, and Jackson is a true cat-lover and a believer that any problem can be solved thanks to love, patience and proper handling. Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member. (My Cat from Hell). Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Nature's Strangest Mysteries: Solved.
programme.desc: An informative and interesting nature documentary where experts explain the natural worlds mysteries. Animal Planet audiences get to see demonstrations, experiments and first hand experiences necessary to solve nature's strangest mysteries. The experts analyse animal behaviours and unravel each mystery behind these different behaviours. Presenting the series and guiding you through the series include biologist Dan Riskin, zoologist Lucy Cooke, marine biologist Andrew Nosal and wildlife expert Bradley Trevor Greive. (Nature's Strangest Mysteries: Solved). Gamtos. Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Expedition Bigfoot.
programme.desc: Expedition Bigfoot is a documentary series exploring the possible existence of the fabled apelike creature. A primatologist, a survivalist, an author and a Bigfoot investigator team up, and set out into the Oregon forests to search for the hairy creature. With the help of advanced technology, like drones, algorithms and trail cameras, they try to find out if the old myth could be true. The series also includes interviews with eyewitnesses, as every year hundreds of people claim to have seen it. (Expedition Bigfoot). Nuotykių.

programme.title: Extinct or Alive.
programme.desc: Extinct or Alive is an Animal Planet documentary show exploring the possible existence of animals thought to be extinct. Biologist and explorer Forrest Galante follows real life stories and visits wildlife locations across the planet, hoping to discover proof that animals such as the Zanzibar leopard or the Galapagos tortoise still exist. Find out if his methods will bring new exciting discoveries. Could animals we think are extinct for a century still be found in nature? (Extinct or Alive). Nuotykių. Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Guardians Of the Glades.
programme.desc: Follow snake hunter Dusty "The Wildman" Crum and his team - Brittany, swamp expert Jay, wildlife specialist Gary, survivalist Tom and Florida's number one python-hunting dog Riley, as they hunt down fearsome snake that's terrorizing Everglades - swamps located on the southernmost tip of Florida, called the Burmese python. This notorious predators that escaped captivity after Hurricane Andrew, quickly multiplied after breeding and feeding on the animals in the Glades. Dusty will take matters into his own hands as he tries to stop these deadly creatures from further destroying the ecosystem. (Guardians of the Glades). Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Treetop Cat Rescue.
programme.desc: Climbing enthusiasts brother-in-law duo Shaun Sears and Tom Otto work together to rescue the felines that climb beyond capability and get stuck in Washington State. The experienced tree climbers do their best to rescue all of the cats they find out about whether a call comes in at day or night. With sometimes unfavourable weather, weak branches and bees nests to overcome the pair have to overcome obstacles and then have to avoid scaring the cats away as they approach. (Treetop Cat Rescue). programme.title: Animal Cops: Houston.
programme.desc: Animal Cops - Houston is the third Animal Planet series to follow the work of animal cruelty investigators. This particular series follows the animal cruelty investigators of the Houston Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (HSPCA). This team of 8 investigators works in a large area of Texas investigating reports of animal cruelty and, when necessary, removing animals from horrible abuse situations. This office has permantly assigned Deputy Constable Christine Kendrick to assist the HSPCA investigators with any law enforcement issue that arises, including seeking warrents and arresting those charged with animal cruelty. (Animal Cops: Houston). Gyvūnai. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Expedition Bigfoot.
programme.desc: Expedition Bigfoot is a documentary series exploring the possible existence of the fabled apelike creature. A primatologist, a survivalist, an author and a Bigfoot investigator team up, and set out into the Oregon forests to search for the hairy creature. With the help of advanced technology, like drones, algorithms and trail cameras, they try to find out if the old myth could be true. The series also includes interviews with eyewitnesses, as every year hundreds of people claim to have seen it. (Expedition Bigfoot). Nuotykių.

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins.
programme.desc: Bindi and Chandler's daughter Grace discovers her new world at Australia Zoo, while Robert and the team attempt the biggest Gator move in the zoo's history; for the first time, they will try to capture 10 alligators from Gator Lake, home to over 40 crocodilians. Meanwhile, Terri helps her Sumatran Elephants as they learn to use a purpose built, giant runway which will allow them to freely move around the Zoo. And Bindi later encounters the joys and tragedies of another Koala breeding season. (Crikey! It's the Irwins). Gyvūnai.

programme.title: The Zoo.
programme.desc: A behind-the-scenes look at the Bronx Zoo, one of the largest zoos in the USA and the largest city zoo the country has to offer. Opening their doors to camera crews, the daily operations of the world-famous animal sanctuary are revealed, as the staff keep their loving creatures healthy and happy. Renowned for its diverse collection of animals and wonderful exhibitions, the Bronx Zoo is one of the finest in the world, home to lions, bears, tigers, snow leopards, baboons, flamingos and many more extravagant species. This series showcases the effort, experience and expertise required to run the Bronx Zoo. (The Zoo). Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Saved By the Barn.
programme.desc: Dan McKernan was earning a six figure salary at a tech company in Austin, Texas, when his father called from the family farm in Michigan, asking him to take the reigns. Instantly, Dan knew what he wanted to do, and left his city life behind to create a sanctuary for farmyard animals that have suffered abuse, neglect or simply don't have a home. At his Barn Sanctuary, the animals are given a new lease of life, with spacious land to roam and see out the remainder of their years. The cameras document what life is like for the family and the animals living at the 140-year-old farm in this heartwarming reality series. (Saved by the Barn). Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet.
programme.desc: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet is a TV series entirely dedicated to love and care for animals. Thanks to a genius Dr. Jeff Young Denver's Planned Pethood Plus veterinary clinic is always busy and is taking care of 80,000-plus clients and their pets. Dr. Jeff's sharp surgical skills and his unconditional love for animals make him one of the most respected vets in the country. Dr. Jeff has a dedicated team of more than 30 veterinary staffers and once a month they go to remote locations where people do not have access to vets. (Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet). Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Little Giants.
programme.desc: This time it's the rhinoceros beetle in Thailand that interests our intrepid duo. Pound for pound, this could be the strongest creature on earth. Adults of some species can lift objects 850 times their weight. The name comes from the horns borne by the males and are used for jousting with other males. These little giants are among the largest beetles but fortunately for us, they cannot bite or sting. (Little Giants). Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Little Giants.
programme.desc: When one thinks of dominant animals that roam the earth, large predators - lions, grizzlies and titanic anacondas come to mind. But, pound for pound, the most powerful and awe-inspiring creatures are the elusive micro-monsters that exist just beneath our feet. Wildlife author & expert Bradley Trevor Greive and biodesigner Billy Almon venture to some of the most remote and inhospitable habitats in the world to track down these tiny beasts. Using state of the art equipment, they will measure the abilities of these creatures and present them in a way never seen before. (Little Giants). Gyvūnai.

programme.desc: Reality series, set in Texas and similar to ''North Woods Law'', that follows daily lives of men and women who are Game Wardens and whose job is to protect deserts, lakes, woods, bayous, coasts and wild animals that live in the second-largest state in the U.S. These people have their plates full as they must deal with poachers, hunters who don't obey the law, smugglers, while they rescue injured wildlife and defend citizens. (Lone Star Law). Gamtos.

programme.title: Wild Appalachia.
programme.desc: This stunning wildlife documentary captures the seldom seen wild side of America's most popular forests and reveals the nature of the Appalachians. (Wild Appalachia). Gamtos.

programme.title: Animal Cribs.
programme.desc: American animal TV series with designer Antonio Ballatore own show creating the perfect space for pet owning families. Believing that if dad can have a "man cave" and mum a "she shed" then surely there is such thing as a animal crib?! Antonio's passion for design and animals shines through throughout every episode. Joined by project manager Grace and their trusty companion Chewie the Bulldog they produce the most fantastic spaces for both pets and their owners. Pets include Chinchillas, dogs, cats and snakes and possibly many more. (Animal Cribs). Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Pit Bulls & Parolees.
programme.desc: Pit bulls are eager to please, faithful and enthusiastic friends and pleasant with children according to credible canine organizations. But they have fallen from grace. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls. (Pit Bulls & Parolees). Gyvūnai.

programme.title: My Cat from Hell.
programme.desc: Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. These are attacks and misbehavior, and Jackson is a true cat-lover and a believer that any problem can be solved thanks to love, patience and proper handling. Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member. (My Cat from Hell). Gyvūnai.

programme.title: The Pool Master.
programme.desc: The Pool Master is a show presented by Anthony Archer-Wills, a top pool expert, landscape architect and artist. Team of professionals lead by him design and build amazing one-of-a-kind pools, which are in great demand among homeowners. After seeing masterpiece by Anthony, you will never agree to have a rectangle with water for swimming. Multipurpose pools for exercising and entertainment full of flowers, waterfalls, decorated with natural stone according to every taste and wallet will take your breath away. (The Pool Master).

programme.title: Animal ER.
programme.desc: Today at Gulf Coast, Damon, a rescue dog found bleeding and missing a paw, is a candidate for an artificial limb. Dr. Beale gets Damon ready for an operation on his foot to fit the prosthetic limb designed by Animal Prosthetic Maker Bill Bickley. With the new paw, Damon's life is transformed and is now enjoying life with his newly adopted family in Colorado. Two African caracal cats, Nova and Starlord, come to Gulf Coast to investigate why the female Nova is having digestion troubles. After a series of tests, Dr. Chen prescribes medications that do the trick - after a week of treatment, Nova is showing signs of improvement by maintaining a healthy appetite and being a playful mate to Starlord. Lucy, a dachshund, is rushed to the ICU and a crushed jaw. Dr. Chanda Miles performs two marathon surgeries, and places steel bone plates to hold the jaw together. Although challenging, the procedure is a success, and Lucy has a shot at recovery. Meanwhile, Emma, a French Bulldog, is brought to the neurology department with paralyzed legs. Dr. Laura Vasquez performs emergency surgery to remove ruptured disc material in hopes of regaining her ability to walk. The procedure is a success and within 24 hours, Emma begins to walk and is expected to make a full recovery. Two sea turtles are driven 200-miles from the Gulf of Mexico to Avian and Exotics to remove a rash of tumors that are growing out of control all over their bodies. Dr. Chen and Danielle help these endangered animals by using a CO2 laser to remove the tumors before they grow so large that they cause paralysis or blindness. Finally, Darth Rachel, a Labrador retriever, is brought to Gulf Coast because of her heavy labored breathing. Dr. Heidi Hottinger performs surgery to permanently hold open the cartilage on one side of her airway. Despite now having a clear airway, Darth Rachel retains her raspy breathing. (Animal ER). [12+]. Gyvūnai.

programme.title: The Aquarium.
programme.desc: Reality-documentary series following the lives of the aquatic inhabitants at the Georgia Aquarium. The largest in the United States and fourth-largest in the world, the aquarium boasts a wide range of diverse inhabitants and explores the relationship between animals and trainers. With many heart-warming scenes, the series beautifully reveals the friendships between the different species and how they learn to co-exist with each other. (The Aquarium). Gyvūnai.

programme.title: I'm Alive.
programme.desc: I'M ALIVE features the death-defying and moving stories of people who — regardless of the obstacles or consequences — were determined to survive an animal attack. Driven by thoughts of loved ones and the desire to live, these individuals found the strength to survive terrifying and unexpected encounters by some of nature's most dangerous creatures. This inspirational drama combines victim interviews with true-to-life reenactments, giving a replay of the split-second decisions that saved lives. Over the course of 10 episodes, I'M ALIVE immerses viewers in the psychological experience of those involved, focusing on what pulled them through and what left them powerfully changed. Every survivor had something to live for, and in that fleeting moment of chaos, their desire for life outshone the attack. (I'm Alive). [16+].

programme.title: I'm Alive.
programme.desc: I'M ALIVE features the death-defying and moving stories of people who — regardless of the obstacles or consequences — were determined to survive an animal attack. Driven by thoughts of loved ones and the desire to live, these individuals found the strength to survive terrifying and unexpected encounters by some of nature's most dangerous creatures. This inspirational drama combines victim interviews with true-to-life reenactments, giving a replay of the split-second decisions that saved lives. Over the course of 10 episodes, I'M ALIVE immerses viewers in the psychological experience of those involved, focusing on what pulled them through and what left them powerfully changed. Every survivor had something to live for, and in that fleeting moment of chaos, their desire for life outshone the attack. (I'm Alive). [16+].

programme.title: Deadly Islands.
programme.desc: Renowned zoologist, animal trainer, and television presenter Dave Salmoni is no stranger to adventure. Having trekked the globe to study creatures and their unique ecosystems, Dave has walked the line between the wild and human world to explore the delicate balance between wildlife and civilization. From the people behind the stunning natural history series, PLANET EARTH and NORTH AMERICA, DEADLY ISLANDS sees Dave's skills tested to the limits as he lives alongside some of Mother Nature's fiercest predators. Dave visits some of the world's most remote islands to investigate how and why their native inhabitants have been so spectacularly successful at surviving - despite the harshest of conditions. In a unique approach that blends all the splendour of a natural history documentary series with an incredible investigative twist, audiences follow Dave as detective while he sets out to crack some of the last big secrets surrounding some of the world's most successful natural-born killers. Only by venturing closer than most would dare to some of the planet's most dangerous animals-from the great hammerhead shark to the grizzly bear. Can Dave uncover their secrets. How have they come to thrive so spectacularly in these remote places, often in confined island settings? Dave's skills will be tested to the limits as he lives alongside some of Mother Nature's fiercest predators, on some of the world's most remote islands,all to solve the DEADLY ISLANDS. (Deadly Islands). Gamtos. Gyvūnai.

programme.title: I Was Prey.
programme.desc: Nature's great predators are animals you don't want to come across, especially when you find yourself in their own backyard. In this heart-pumping documentary series, individuals share their stories of encounters with dangerous animals, reliving the frightful, life-threatening ordeal. With stories from across the world, we reveal the heart-in-mouth moments when these lucky individuals managed to escape the jaws of death. From a swimmer mauled by a bull shark in the Bahamas to a close shave with a grizzly bear in the mountains, these stories showcase the fearsome power of predators. (I Was Prey). Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Animal Cops: Houston.
programme.desc: Animal Cops - Houston is the third Animal Planet series to follow the work of animal cruelty investigators. This particular series follows the animal cruelty investigators of the Houston Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (HSPCA). This team of 8 investigators works in a large area of Texas investigating reports of animal cruelty and, when necessary, removing animals from horrible abuse situations. Since these investigators do not have arrest or warrant seeking powers on their own, they work closely with local law enforcement, including the Harris County Precinct One Constable's Office. This office has permantly assigned Deputy Constable Christine Kendrick to assist the HSPCA investigators with any law enforcement issue that arises, including seeking warrents and arresting those charged with animal cruelty. (Animal Cops: Houston). Kriminalai. Gyvūnai.

programme.title: The Last Alaskans.
programme.desc: With the beginning of winter setting in, the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge is now losing 10-minutes of crucial sunlight each day. Soon, the refuge will be concealed by darkness for the next 67 days. Heimo takes advantage of what little light remains and continues to set up traps in hopes of him finding game before complete darkness overtakes the refuge. While Heimo continues to hunt, Tyler and Ashley try to find food by ice fishing while they trek 15 miles from their lake cabin to take their dogs out for the first sled run of the season. Later, Bob travels into town to see his daughter, Talicia, and determine the status of his plane after he nearly dies in a crash three weeks prior. When he receives bad news about possible internal damage, Bob wonders if he is getting too old to fly. (The Last Alaskans). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: The Zoo.
programme.desc: A behind-the-scenes look at the Bronx Zoo, one of the largest zoos in the USA and the largest city zoo the country has to offer. Renowned for its diverse collection of animals and wonderful exhibitions, the Bronx Zoo is one of the finest in the world, home to lions, bears, tigers, snow leopards, baboons, flamingos and many more extravagant species. This series showcases the effort, experience and expertise required to run the Bronx Zoo. (The Zoo). Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Homestead Rescue.
programme.desc: This reality TV show follows Marty Raney and his two children, Matt Raney and Misty Bilodeau, who are successful homesteaders from the state of Alaska and have the skills needed to fish, hunt, raise livestock, and otherwise survive in an untamed landscape. Struggling homesteaders across the country call these experts to help them save their homesteads and become self-sufficient while they teach them the necessary skills to survive the wilderness. (Homestead Rescue). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: Big Fish Man.
programme.desc: World record-holding angler Jakub Vagner would die for fishing and has come close more than once. In Big Fish Man he embarks on extreme fishing expeditions to the most remote regions of the world in search of fish that have never before been filmed in the wild many weighing more than 200kg and measuring over six metres in length. His exploits take us to a variety of remote locations Congo, Mongolia, Europe, Canada, Thailand, Ecuador and Peru. Carrying all his kit and supplies, Jakub spends days trekking through unforgiving jungle and paddling against wild river currents. He survives using the hunting and foraging skills hes honed over almost two decades of fishing missions. On his visually stunning adventure he tries to land the Amazons largest freshwater fish in Ecuador and the mighty Goliath Tiger Fish, with its 32 shark-like teeth, in Congo. He enlists the help of nomadic reindeer herders to land a giant Taimen in the ice cold rapids of the Shishgid River in Mongolia and tries to catch a massive Northern Pike in the Canadian sub-Arctic even though their natural habitat is completely frozen over. The series is packed with drama and danger. Jakub is stubborn and determined as time after time he faces nature at its most extreme. (Big Fish Man). Gamtos.

programme.title: Deadly Islands.
programme.desc: Renowned zoologist, animal trainer, and television presenter Dave Salmoni is no stranger to adventure. Having trekked the globe to study creatures and their unique ecosystems, Dave has walked the line between the wild and human world to explore the delicate balance between wildlife and civilization. From the people behind the stunning natural history series, PLANET EARTH and NORTH AMERICA, DEADLY ISLANDS sees Dave's skills tested to the limits as he lives alongside some of Mother Nature's fiercest predators. Dave visits some of the world's most remote islands to investigate how and why their native inhabitants have been so spectacularly successful at surviving - despite the harshest of conditions. In a unique approach that blends all the splendour of a natural history documentary series with an incredible investigative twist, audiences follow Dave as detective while he sets out to crack some of the last big secrets surrounding some of the world's most successful natural-born killers. Only by venturing closer than most would dare to some of the planet's most dangerous animals-from the great hammerhead shark to the grizzly bear. Can Dave uncover their secrets. How have they come to thrive so spectacularly in these remote places, often in confined island settings? Dave's skills will be tested to the limits as he lives alongside some of Mother Nature's fiercest predators, on some of the world's most remote islands,all to solve the DEADLY ISLANDS. (Deadly Islands). Gamtos. Gyvūnai.

programme.title: I Was Prey.
programme.desc: Nature's great predators are animals you don't want to come across, especially when you find yourself in their own backyard. In this heart-pumping documentary series, individuals share their stories of encounters with dangerous animals, reliving the frightful, life-threatening ordeal. With stories from across the world, we reveal the heart-in-mouth moments when these lucky individuals managed to escape the jaws of death. From a swimmer mauled by a bull shark in the Bahamas to a close shave with a grizzly bear in the mountains, these stories showcase the fearsome power of predators. (I Was Prey). Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Little Giants.
programme.desc: When one thinks of dominant animals that roam the earth, large predators - lions, grizzlies and titanic anacondas come to mind. But, pound for pound, the most powerful and awe-inspiring creatures are the elusive micro-monsters that exist just beneath our feet. Wildlife author & expert Bradley Trevor Greive and biodesigner Billy Almon venture to some of the most remote and inhospitable habitats in the world to track down these tiny beasts. Using state of the art equipment, they will measure the abilities of these creatures and present them in a way never seen before. (Little Giants). Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Little Giants.
programme.desc: This time the guys are heading to Mozambique where they are investigating the Devil Flower Mantis. It lives up to its Latin name of idolomantis diabolica as it lies in wait for its prey, perfectly mimicking the flower on which it sits. Its objective is to seduce the insect into its striking zone, which it catches with a lightning strike of its front legs. The strike speed and strength of this little giant is tested by Bradley and Billy. (Little Giants). Gyvūnai.

But, pound for pound, the most powerful and awe-inspiring creatures are the elusive micro-monsters that exist just beneath our feet. Wildlife author & expert Bradley Trevor Greive and biodesigner Billy Almon venture to some of the most remote and inhospitable habitats in the world to track down these tiny beasts. Using state of the art equipment, they will measure the abilities of these creatures and present them in a way never seen before. (Little Giants). Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Animal Cops: Houston.
programme.desc: Animal Cops - Houston is the third Animal Planet series to follow the work of animal cruelty investigators. This particular series follows the animal cruelty investigators of the Houston Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (HSPCA). This team of 8 investigators works in a large area of Texas investigating reports of animal cruelty and, when necessary, removing animals from horrible abuse situations. Since these investigators do not have arrest or warrant seeking powers on their own, they work closely with local law enforcement, including the Harris County Precinct One Constable's Office. This office has permantly assigned Deputy Constable Christine Kendrick to assist the HSPCA investigators with any law enforcement issue that arises, including seeking warrents and arresting those charged with animal cruelty. (Animal Cops: Houston). Gyvūnai. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Wild Costa Rica.
programme.desc: Explore the incredible creatures that survive in the wild lands of Costa Rica. (Wild Costa Rica). Gyvūnai. Laukinė gamta. Gamtos.

programme.title: Animal Cribs.
programme.desc: American animal TV series with designer Antonio Ballatore own show creating the perfect space for pet owning families. Believing that if dad can have a "man cave" and mum a "she shed" then surely there is such thing as a animal crib?! Antonio's passion for design and animals shines through throughout every episode. Joined by project manager Grace and their trusty companion Chewie the Bulldog they produce the most fantastic spaces for both pets and their owners. Pets include Chinchillas, dogs, cats and snakes and possibly many more. (Animal Cribs). Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Pit Bulls & Parolees.
programme.desc: Pit bulls are eager to please, faithful and enthusiastic friends and pleasant with children according to credible canine organizations. But they have fallen from grace. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls. (Pit Bulls & Parolees). Gyvūnai.

programme.title: My Cat from Hell.
programme.desc: Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. These are attacks and misbehavior, and Jackson is a true cat-lover and a believer that any problem can be solved thanks to love, patience and proper handling. Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member. (My Cat from Hell). Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins.
programme.desc: US reality TV show follows the Irwin family through their adventures in continuing Steve Irwin's legacy. The Australian family including mother Terri who is a naturalist and conservationist stars alongside daughter Bindi and son Robert who are fully immerse in animal life and their family. (Crikey! It's the Irwins). Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet.
programme.desc: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet is a TV series entirely dedicated to love and care for animals. Thanks to a genius Dr. Jeff Young Denver's Planned Pethood Plus veterinary clinic is always busy and is taking care of 80,000-plus clients and their pets. Dr. Jeff's sharp surgical skills and his unconditional love for animals make him one of the most respected vets in the country. Dr. Jeff has a dedicated team of more than 30 veterinary staffers and once a month they go to remote locations where people do not have access to vets. (Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet). Gyvūnai.

programme.title: The Pool Master.
programme.desc: The Pool Master is a show presented by Anthony Archer-Wills, a top pool expert, landscape architect and artist. Team of professionals lead by him design and build amazing one-of-a-kind pools, which are in great demand among homeowners. After seeing masterpiece by Anthony, you will never agree to have a rectangle with water for swimming. Multipurpose pools for exercising and entertainment full of flowers, waterfalls, decorated with natural stone according to every taste and wallet will take your breath away. (The Pool Master).

programme.title: Big Fish Man.
programme.desc: World record-holding angler Jakub Vagner would die for fishing and has come close more than once. In Big Fish Man he embarks on extreme fishing expeditions to the most remote regions of the world in search of fish that have never before been filmed in the wild many weighing more than 200kg and measuring over six metres in length. His exploits take us to a variety of remote locations Congo, Mongolia, Europe, Canada, Thailand, Ecuador and Peru. Carrying all his kit and supplies, Jakub spends days trekking through unforgiving jungle and paddling against wild river currents. He survives using the hunting and foraging skills hes honed over almost two decades of fishing missions. On his visually stunning adventure he tries to land the Amazons largest freshwater fish in Ecuador and the mighty Goliath Tiger Fish, with its 32 shark-like teeth, in Congo. He enlists the help of nomadic reindeer herders to land a giant Taimen in the ice cold rapids of the Shishgid River in Mongolia and tries to catch a massive Northern Pike in the Canadian sub-Arctic even though their natural habitat is completely frozen over. The series is packed with drama and danger. Jakub is stubborn and determined as time after time he faces nature at its most extreme. (Big Fish Man). Gamtos.

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People.
programme.desc: Alaskan Bush People is an American docudrama-style reality TV series revolving around the Brown family, members of which are trying to survive in the wilderness, far away from the society. Take a journey deep into Alaska's bush, where naturalist and adventurer Billy Brown, along with his wife, Ami, and their seven children, choose to live life on their own terms, connected to wild nature and bonded to each other. (Alaskan Bush People).

programme.title: Shark Week.
programme.desc: Wildlife biologist and animal tracker, Forrest Galante, sets out on the Indian Ocean to search for the Pondicherry shark-believed to be extinct since the 1970s. The rare species' alleged extinction has been recently questions, due to recent photos appearing of unidentified sharks around Sri Lanka and the Maldives. Could the Pondicherry shark still be alive? If Galante can prove it's still alive, it will be removed off the extinct species list. Extinct or Alive. (Shark Week). Gamtos. Laukinė gamta. Gyvūnai.

programme.title: I Was Prey.
programme.desc: Nature's great predators are animals you don't want to come across, especially when you find yourself in their own backyard. With stories from across the world, we reveal the heart-in-mouth moments when these lucky individuals managed to escape the jaws of death. From a swimmer mauled by a bull shark in the Bahamas to a close shave with a grizzly bear in the mountains, these stories showcase the fearsome power of predators. (I Was Prey). Gyvūnai.

programme.title: The Zoo.
programme.desc: A behind-the-scenes look at the Bronx Zoo, one of the largest zoos in the USA and the largest city zoo the country has to offer. Opening their doors to camera crews, the daily operations of the world-famous animal sanctuary are revealed, as the staff keep their loving creatures healthy and happy. Renowned for its diverse collection of animals and wonderful exhibitions, the Bronx Zoo is one of the finest in the world, home to lions, bears, tigers, snow leopards, baboons, flamingos and many more extravagant species. This series showcases the effort, experience and expertise required to run the Bronx Zoo. (The Zoo). Gyvūnai.

programme.title: The Aquarium.
programme.desc: Reality-documentary series following the lives of the aquatic inhabitants at the Georgia Aquarium. The largest in the United States and fourth-largest in the world, the aquarium boasts a wide range of diverse inhabitants and explores the relationship between animals and trainers. The 10-million-gallon (38-million-litre) facility plays home to over 500 marine species including endangered penguins, rescued sea otters and recovering sea lions. The show reveals the difficulties that come with nursing and caring for such a wide variety of species. With many heart-warming scenes, the series beautifully reveals the friendships between the different species and how they learn to co-exist with each other. (The Aquarium). Gyvūnai.

programme.title: I'm Alive.
programme.desc: I'M ALIVE features the death-defying and moving stories of people who — regardless of the obstacles or consequences — were determined to survive an animal attack. Driven by thoughts of loved ones and the desire to live, these individuals found the strength to survive terrifying and unexpected encounters by some of nature's most dangerous creatures. This inspirational drama combines victim interviews with true-to-life reenactments, giving a replay of the split-second decisions that saved lives. Over the course of 10 episodes, I'M ALIVE immerses viewers in the psychological experience of those involved, focusing on what pulled them through and what left them powerfully changed. Every survivor had something to live for, and in that fleeting moment of chaos, their desire for life outshone the attack. (I'm Alive). [16+].

programme.title: I'm Alive.

programme.title: Project Grizzly.

The domesticated grizzlies Bob and Screech learn to live outside the cage, to fish, to hunt and to live in the wild. programme.title: Deadly Islands.
programme.desc: Renowned zoologist, animal trainer, and television presenter Dave Salmoni is no stranger to adventure. Having trekked the globe to study creatures and their unique ecosystems, Dave has walked the line between the wild and human world to explore the delicate balance between wildlife and civilization. From the people behind the stunning natural history series, PLANET EARTH and NORTH AMERICA, DEADLY ISLANDS sees Dave's skills tested to the limits as he lives alongside some of Mother Nature's fiercest predators. Dave visits some of the world's most remote islands to investigate how and why their native inhabitants have been so spectacularly successful at surviving - despite the harshest of conditions. In a unique approach that blends all the splendour of a natural history documentary series with an incredible investigative twist, audiences follow Dave as detective while he sets out to crack some of the last big secrets surrounding some of the world's most successful natural-born killers. Only by venturing closer than most would dare to some of the planet's most dangerous animals-from the great hammerhead shark to the grizzly bear. Can Dave uncover their secrets. How have they come to thrive so spectacularly in these remote places, often in confined island settings? Dave's skills will be tested to the limits as he lives alongside some of Mother Nature's fiercest predators, on some of the world's most remote islands,all to solve the DEADLY ISLANDS. (Deadly Islands). Gamtos. Gyvūnai.

programme.title: The Last Alaskans.
programme.desc: The first day of darkness has arrived at the refuge. Now, the days are growing shorter, causing Bob, Heimo and the Lewis family to set additional traps and continue hunting for food. Heimo uses what little daylight there is to catch his biggest adversary and competition for resources - the wolf. But overflow on the river blocks his path home and jeopardizes his golden rule of surviving the winter: "Always return home before the faint light of day is gone." Bob returns to the refuge from town and begins to follow fresh animal tracks as a result of the constant snowfall. Ray's daughters, Emma, Sarah and Molly, become emotional after what might be their last winter at the refuge as a family. (The Last Alaskans). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: Big Fish Man.
programme.desc: World record-holding angler Jakub Vagner would die for fishing and has come close more than once. In Big Fish Man he embarks on extreme fishing expeditions to the most remote regions of the world in search of fish that have never before been filmed in the wild many weighing more than 200kg and measuring over six metres in length. His exploits take us to a variety of remote locations Congo, Mongolia, Europe, Canada, Thailand, Ecuador and Peru. Carrying all his kit and supplies, Jakub spends days trekking through unforgiving jungle and paddling against wild river currents. He survives using the hunting and foraging skills hes honed over almost two decades of fishing missions. On his visually stunning adventure he tries to land the Amazons largest freshwater fish in Ecuador and the mighty Goliath Tiger Fish, with its 32 shark-like teeth, in Congo. He enlists the help of nomadic reindeer herders to land a giant Taimen in the ice cold rapids of the Shishgid River in Mongolia and tries to catch a massive Northern Pike in the Canadian sub-Arctic even though their natural habitat is completely frozen over. The series is packed with drama and danger. Jakub is stubborn and determined as time after time he faces nature at its most extreme. (Big Fish Man). Gamtos.

programme.title: Vienas reindžeris.
programme.desc: Teksaso reindžeris Aleksas Tairy (akt. Thomas Jane) dykumoje persekioja bankų plėšiką Deklaną Makbraitą (akt. Dean Jagger). Pasirodo, šis nusikaltėlis yra kur kas pavojingesnis, nei atrodė prieš tai. Jis - tarptautinis teroristas, ketinantis susprogdinti bombą pačiame Londono centre. Per susišaudymą netekęs partnerio, Aleksas tampa britų žvalgybos agentės Dženiferės Smit (akt. Dominique Tipper) ir jos viršininko Geidso (akt. John Malkovich) komandos dalimi. Dabar šiai komandai teks verstis per galvą, sustabdyti teroristą ir suėmus pristatyti jį į teisiamojo suolą. (One Ranger). Trileriai. Veiksmo.

programme.title: Pertrauka.
programme.desc: Filmai tiesiogiai per TV. Žiūrėk TV kanalus tiesiogiai internetu per Go3 bet kokiame įrenginyje.

programme.title: Ofelija.
programme.desc: Ofelija užkariauja jaunojo princo Hamleto širdį. Tarp jų slapta užsimezga aistringas romanas. Tačiau karalystei atsidūrus ant karo slenksčio, jos pačios politinės pažiūros tampa labai svarbios ir įtakingos. Kai nužudomas Hamleto tėvas, o princo protas ima virsti nepasotinamu keršto troškimu, Ofelija priversta rinktis tarp tikros meilės ir savo pačios gyvybės. Ar kerštas sunaikina meilę? Hamleto istorija papasakota moters akimis. Romantinė drama – "Ofelija". (Ophelia). Dramos. Trileriai. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Valstybės paslaptis.
programme.desc: Laikraščio "The Washington Post" žurnalistai gauna ypač slaptus dokumentus, įrodančius net keturių JAV prezidentų veidmainiavimą Vietnamo klausimu. Tuometinė laikraščio leidėja Katarina Greham (akt. Meryl Streep) ir vyriausias redaktorius Benas Bradlis (akt. Tom'as Hanks'as) susiduria su milžinišku vyriausybės atstovų spaudimu, šantažu ir grasinimais, siekiant sustabdyti kontroversiškas publikacijas. "The Post" straipsniai, parengti nutekėjusių "Pentagono dokumentų" pagrindu, tapo tikra bomba Amerikos politiniame gyvenime ir amžiams išliko kaip vienas sudėtingiausių ir pavojingiausių epizodų žiniasklaidos laisvės istorijoje. (The Post). Dramos. Trileriai.

programme.title: Krokodilas Dandis. Sugrįžimas.
programme.desc: Australų aktorius Polas Hoganas, įkūnijęs legendinį personažą Krokodilą Dandį, ramiai leidžia senatvės dienas, spręsdamas kryžiažodžius ir plepėdamas telefonu su dešimtmete anūke. Tačiau vieną dieną jo agentas atvyksta su netikėta žinia - Anglijos karalienė jam siūlo suteikti riterio titulą dėl nuopelnų kino industrijoje. Staiga Polas grįžta į populiarumo viršūnę, netikėtai įsivelia į dešimtis skandalų ir komiškų situacijų, apie kurias nenuilstamai kalba žurnalistai. Ramus gyvenimas aktoriui virsta pragaru, o publikai - neįtikėtina pramoga. (The Very Excellent Mr. Dundee). Komedijos.

programme.title: Mano pakvaišęs senis.
programme.desc: Pasiruoškite pačioms beprotiškiausioms šeimos atostogoms. Sūnus nusprendžia praleisti savaitgalį prabangioje savo sužadėtinės šeimos rezidencijoje, tačiau kartu su savimi pasiima didžiausią savo gyvenimo galvos skausmą – senamadišką tėvą. Šis tiesmukas italų kirpėjas nesiruošia taikytis prie ekscentriškų šeimininkų taisyklių, todėl paprastas tėvų susipažinimas greitai pavirsta triukšmingu skirtingų charakterių susidūrimu. Daug gėdingų situacijų bei neprognozuojamo elgesi (About My Father). Komedijos.

programme.title: Ištraukti peiliai.
programme.desc: Harlanas Tombris (akt. Christopheris Plummeris) yra itin sėkmingas rašytojas, švenčiantis 85-erių metų sukaktį. Šia proga į jo namus suvažiuoja visa didžiulė Harlano šeima. Kitą rytą po puikaus vakarėlio Harlanas - negyvas. Bylą tiriantis detektyvas Blankas (akt. Danielis Craigas) įtaria, kad mirtis nebuvo natūrali. Įkalinęs gausiai susirinkusius giminaičius bei tarnus jubiliato name, detektyvas ima aiškintis mirties kaltininkus. Filmas žavi ne tik puikiu humoru, bet ir tikru Holivudo žvaigždynu: Chrisas Evansas, Ana de Armas, Jamie Lee Curtis, Toni Collette, Donas Johnsonas ir Michaelas Shannonas. Originalus pavadinimas "Knives Out". (Knives Out). Mistika. Trileriai. Komedijos. Kriminalai. Dramos.

programme.title: Kino žvaigždės Liverpulyje nemiršta.
programme.desc: Gyvenimas tik parodo, jog tikros istorijos gali būti ne ką mažiau jaudinančios nei didžiajame ekrane. Tarp niekam nežinomo jauno aktoriaus Peterio ir legendinės Holivudo aktorės ir Oskaro laureatės Glorios Grahame užsimezga romanas. Tarp jų didelis amžiaus skirtumas ir jų draugystė pasmerkta nutrūkti. Kol vieną dieną jie vėl susitinka Liverpulyje. Meilėje visai kaip kine. Annette Bening trims BAFTA kino apdovanojimams nominuotoje biografinėje romantinėje dramoje – "Kino žvaigždės Liverpulyje nemiršta". (Stars Don't Die In Liverpool). Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Sparno broliai.
programme.desc: Laidų ciklas, kuriame pasakojamos įkvepiančios istorijos apie žmones, gyvenančius skrydžiu, dangumi ir aviacija. Laidose atskleidžiamos asmeninės patirtys, profesiniai iššūkiai, draugystė ir bendrystė, jungianti "Sparno brolius". (Sparno broliai).

programme.title: Faras be baimės.
programme.desc: Rajanas (akt. Tarekas Boudali, jis taip pat ir šios komedijos režisierius) - jaunas ir geraširdis, bet be galo baikštus ir nerangus policininkas. Vaikinas beviltiškai įsimylėjęs kolegę Stefani (akt. Vanessa Guide). Eilinis apsilankymas pas gydytoją priverčia Rajaną permąstyti savo gyvenimą. Daktaras praneša, kad vaikinas sunkiai serga ir jam likę gyventi daugiausiai mėnuo. Jaunasis policininkas nusprendžia, kad visiškai neturi ką prarasti, ir nutaria iš gyvenimo išeiti su trenksmu, prieš tai tapęs visų laikų didvyriu... Originalus pavadinimas "30 Jours Max". (30 jours max). Veiksmo. Komedijos. Kriminalai.

programme.title: 21 tiltas.
programme.desc: Neeilinio nusikaltimo Niujorke metu susišaudyme su nusikaltėliais žūsta net aštuoni policininkai. Detektyvas Andrė Deivisas (akt. Chadwick Boseman, "Juodoji pantera") gauna užduotį bet kokia kaina sugauti nusikaltėlius. Pradėjęs jų medžioklę, vyras greitai aptinka daug keistų faktų, sutapimų ir detalių, rodančių, kad ne viskas yra taip, kaip atrodo iš pirmo žvilgsnio. Kartu su kolege detektyve (akt. Sienna Miller) sekant karštais įtariamųjų pėdsakais, prieš Deiviso akis ima skleistis įspūdingas korupcijos tinklas, kuriame nebeaišku, kas yra įstatymo gynėjai, o kas - nusikaltėliai. (21 Bridges). Dramos. Kriminalai. Veiksmo. Nuotykių. Trileriai.

programme.title: Kurjeris.
programme.desc: Tikra istorija paremtas trileris apie paprastą britų verslininką Grevilį Vainą (akt. Benedictas Cumberbatchas), padėjusį pasauliui išvengti trečiojo pasaulinio karo. Veiksmas vyksta šaltojo karo laikais, kai dvi didžiosios pasaulio valstybės - JAV ir Sovietų Sąjunga - įsitraukę į ginklavimosi varžybas. Vieną dieną Didžiosios Britanijos žvalgyba gauna laišką su žinia apie galimą naują Šaltojo karo etapą - branduolinę konfrontaciją. Britų ir amerikiečių pareigūnai imasi drąsaus plano, į Maskvą pasiunčia žmogų, niekaip nesijusį su slaptosiomis tarnybomis ir turintį šansą neatkreipti KGB dėmesio, - verslininką Grevilį Vainą. Originalus pavadinimas "Courier". (The Courier). Dramos. Trileriai.

programme.title: Pertrauka.
programme.desc: Filmai tiesiogiai per TV. Žiūrėk TV kanalus tiesiogiai internetu per Go3 bet kokiame įrenginyje.

programme.title: Meilės istorijos Saulėgrąžų slėnyje.
programme.desc: Keitės ir Driu pažinties pradžia paženklinta išpilta kava. Dabar jie kolegos ir drauge vyksta į gimtąjį Keitės miestelį, kur jų laukia bendra užduotis. Ar ore tvyranti meilė įkvėps du nepažįstamuosius atverti savo širdis? (Love Stories in Sunflower Valley). Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Asteriksas ir Obeliksas: Drakonų imperija.
programme.desc: Žiūrovams puikiai pažįstami linksmieji Galijos narsuoliai Asteriksas ir Obeliksas leidžiasi į naujus nuotykius! Šįkart į tolimąją Kiniją, kur princesės prašymu jie turės išlaisvinti nuo sosto nuverstą ir įkalintą jos mamą Imperatorienę, o taip pat apginti Drakonų Imperiją nuo jai grasinančios galingos Cezario armijos. Pasirūpinę antžmogiškų galių suteikiančio magiškojo gėrimo atsargomis bei apsiginklavę ištisas kartas iš kojų verčiančiu humoru, neišskiriami draugai leidžiasi į iššūkių pilną kelionę. Originalus pavadinimas "Asterix & Obelix: L'Empire Du Milieu". (Astérix et Obélix : L'Empire du Milieu). [7+]. Fantastiniai. Komedijos. Nuotykių.

programme.title: Prarastasis miestas Z.
programme.desc: Tikra XX a. pradžios britų generolo-leitenanto, kartografo, keliautojo ir tyrinėtojo Persio Foseto istorija. Fosetas buvo įsitikinęs, kad neaprėpiamos Amazonės platybės slepia ne vieną paslaptį. O didžiausia jų – paslaptinga, pažengusios žmonijos dar neatrasta civilizacija, galinti užpildyti žmonių rasės kilmės spragas. Klausydamas tiek mokslininkų, tiek visuomenės prieštaravimų, juoko ir netgi patyčių, Fosetas nenuleido rankų ir kas keleri metai vėl ir vėl sugrįždavo į Amazonės džiungles ieškoti paslaptingojo miesto Z, legendose žinomo Eldorado vardu. Prieš šimtą metų jis iškeliavo ieškoti mitinio miesto. Tai ką jis atrado tapo tikra legenda. Biografinis nuotykių filmas – "Prarastasis miestas Z". (The Lost City of Z). Dramos. Veiksmo. Nuotykių.

programme.title: Šokių karalienės.
programme.desc: Marta persikėlia iš Niujorko į senjorų bendruomenės namus. Ji stengiasi pritapti prie naujų gyvenimo sąlygų, tačiau triukšminga kaimynė, iš gretimų namų, kelia grėsmę jos ramybei. Nepaisydamos savo skirtumų, jos susidraugauja ir įkuria šokančių sirgalių klubą. Nors moterų didžioji gyvenimo laiko jau praėjo, jos nusprendžia išnaudoti kiekvieną dar likusią akimirką. Susibūrusios kartu, jos ruošiasi didelėms varžyboms. Ar ši nepritapusių moterų grupė gali įveikti iššūkius ir įrodyti, kad niekada nevėlu siekti savo svajonių? (Poms). Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: Neįkainojama meilė.
programme.desc: Sendaikčių parduotuvėlės savininkė Rouzė turi išskirtinę galimybę sudalyvauti savo mėgstamos laidos filmavime. Šios laidos metu, ekspertai vertina antikvarinius daiktus ir juos įkainoja. Atnešusi vieną iš savo parduodamų daiktų – senovinį kavinuką, ji sužino neįtikėtiną dalyką. Šis porceliano gaminys yra pasakiškai vertingas ir gali atnešti mažiausiai 18 000 dolerių pelno! Atrodytų, kad laimė nusišypsojo ir Rouzė tuoj praturės, tačiau mergina nusprendžia rasti tikruosius kavinuko savininkus. Sendaikčių aukcionų prekeivis Džo, kuris bet kokia kaina nori perpirkti vertingą kavinuką, lieka it musę kandęs. Ar Rouzė išsiaiškins, kam priklausė vertingas kavinukas? (A Priceless Love). Romantiniai.

1917 metų pavasarį Pirmasis pasaulinis karas visu pajėgumu drebina Europą. Britų karinė žvalgyba gauna informacijos, kad vienas jų batalionas žygiuoja tiesiai į priešo užimtą teritoriją. Kaip laiku perspėti 1600 karių, kas minutę artėjančių prie priešo linijos. Užduotis perduoti žinią apie pasalą patikima dviem jauniems eiliniams. Šofildas (George MacKay) ir Bleikas (George MacKay) privalo nepastebėti pereiti fronto liniją ir didžiulę priešo kontroliuojamą teritoriją. Tik sėkmės atveju šiaurės Prancūzijoje į pasalą žygiuojantys ginklo broliai liks gyvi. Neperdavus žinios, - jie žus visi iki vieno. Dviem šimtams apdovanojimų nominuota, šimtą trisdešimt keturis apdovanojimus, tarp jų ir tris Oskarus, laimėjusi karinė drama, kuri įtrauks ir nepaleis iki paskutinės minutės. (1917). Dramos. Veiksmo.

programme.title: Sicario 2: Kartelių karai.
programme.desc: Iškilus naujai grėsmei, JAV pareigūnai atriša rankas specialiajam savo agentui Metui Greiveriui. Šis kreipiasi pagalbos į savo seną pažįstamą – paslaptingąjį Alechandrą. Pastarasis suorganizuoja vieno narkotikų kartelio vadeivos dukters pagrobimą. Jie tikėjosi sukelti kartelių tarpusavio karą. Tačiau planas nepavyksta ir įvykiai labai greitai pasisuka netikėta linkme. Kai nėra žmogiškumo, nėra ir taisyklių. Benicio Del Tòro ir Josh'as Brolin'as veiksmo trileryje – "Sicario 2. Kartelių karai". (Sicario 2: Soldado). Veiksmo. Mistika. Trileriai. Nuotykių. Dramos. Kriminalai.

programme.title: A-X-L.
programme.desc: Netikėtas radinys tapo jaudinančios draugystės pradžia. Jaunas vaikinas Mailsas sutiko išskirtinių gebėjimų keturkojį robotą. Neilgai trukus, jiedu susidraugavo ir pažadėjo visada rūpintis vienas kitu. Tačiau jų draugystei iškyla pavojus, kai jų kelyje pasipainioja neaiškių kėslų turinti kompanija. Geriausias žmogaus draugas nuo šiol tapo dar geresnis. Fantastinis nuotykių filmas – "Akselis". (A-X-L). Nuotykių. Dramos. Veiksmo. Trileriai.

Romantiniai.

programme.title: Šuniškas pokštas.
programme.desc: Mielas išlepintas šunelis gyvena tarsi inkstas taukuose. Tačiau vieną dieną pasaka baigsis - šunelis bus išmestas į gatvę, kur jo tykos daugybė pavojų. Ar pagaliau jis ras tikruosius namus? Originalus pavadinimas "Trouble". (Trouble). Nuotykių. Komedijos.

programme.title: Knygų klubas.
programme.desc: Keturios neišskiriamos draugės paprastai renkasi rimtą literatūrą, tačiau vieną vakarą visos nutaria perskaityti žymųjį erotinį romaną - "Penkiasdešimt pilkų atspalvių". Iš pradžių skeptiškai žiūrėjusios į šį eksperimentą, vėliau jos vis labiau įsitraukia į knygą ir vėl patiria seniai užmirštus jausmus. Nuolat skatindamos bei palaikydamos viena kitą, ištikimosios draugės pradeda vaikščioti į pasimatymus ir vėl atranda gyvenimo skonį bei džiaugsmą. Įsivelti į meilės nuotykius niekada nevėlu. Diane Keaton ir Jane Fonda romantinėje komedijoje – "Knygų klubas". (Book Club). Romantiniai. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: Kurskas.
programme.desc: 2000-ųjų m. rugpjūčio 12 dieną viename didžiausių Rusijos povandeninių laivų "Kurskas" nugriaudėjo du sprogimai, kuriuos išgyveno 23 jūreiviai iš 118 žmonių įgulos. Tačiau dėl lėtos Rusijos vyriausybės reakcijos ir nenoro priimti užsienio šalių pagalbą, siekiant išsaugoti karines paslaptis, išgyvenusių ir dėl savo gyvybių iš paskutiniųjų kovojusių jūreivių laukė dar šiurpesnis likimas. Po savaitės į "Kurską" pagaliau įsigavę Norvegijos narai gyvųjų jame neberado. Pagal neužmirštamą tikrą istoriją apie nenuskandinamu vadinto laivo tragediją sukurtas filmas. Vienintelė išeitis iškentėti kartu iki galo. Oskaro laureatas Collin'as Firth'as įtampos ir veiksmo dramoje – "Kurskas". (Kursk). Nuotykių. Dramos. Veiksmo. Trileriai.

programme.title: Fabelmanai.
programme.desc: Tai pusiau autobiografinis Holivudo karaliaus Steveno Spielbergo darbas, pasakojantis apie berniuką Semį Fabelmaną, kuris, gimęs inžinieriaus ir muzikantės šeimoje, dar nepradėjęs lankyti mokyklos, susižavi kino magija. 1952-ieji. Skatinamas motinos Semis vis drąsiau žvelgia į pasaulį pro kino kameros objektyvą. Netrukus paaiškėjus sukrečiančiai šeimos istorijos detalei, filmų kūrimas berniukui tampa neprilygstamu įrankiu ieškant atsakymų į jį kamuojančius klausimus bei išsigelbėjimu nerimą keliančioje, o kartais ir gąsdinančioje gyvenimo realybėje. Pamažu augdamas ir tobulėdamas vaikinas įsitikina, kad kinas jam - vienintelė ir nepamainoma priemonė ieškant tiesos apie aplinkinius ir save patį. (The Fabelmans). Dramos.

programme.title: Meilė užkandžiams.
programme.desc: Jauna, talentinga interjero dizainerė Olivija Alder skuba į gimtinę. Verslo sunkumus patiriantis tėvas paprašo dukros pagalbos atnaujinant šeimos restoraną. Ant ežero kranto įkurtas restoranas yra viskas, ką turi Olivijos tėvas ir prarasti šią vietą būtų be proto sunku. Mergina su dideliu užsidegimu imasi rekonstrukcijos. Netrukus ji susipažįsta su Deksu. Pasirodo, jos tėvas pasamdė tarptautinio masto kulinarijos žvaigždę, kad šis naujais patiekalais priviliotų klientų minias. Ar Olivijos ir Dekso tandemas nugalės nesėkmes ir prikels restoraną naujam gyvenimui? O gal bendradarbiavimas jiems atneš kur kas daugiau? (Love for Starters). Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Sprogstančios vestuvės.
programme.desc: Egzotiškoje saloje į porelės vestuves susirenka abiejų giminės, o ten kur giminės ten prasideda chaosas. Nuotaką trikdo jokių ribų nejaučianti uošvė, o jaunikį neramina žmonos buvusio vaikino pasirodymas. Tad porelę aplanko negera nuojauta, gal su vestuvėmis buvo paskubėta? Tačiau viską pakeičia netikėti įsibrovėliai, kurie visus šventės dalyvius paima įkaitais. Neturėdami nė menkiausio supratimo, kaip elgtis su teroristais, jaunavedžiai padarys viską, kad išlaisvintų artimuosius. (Shotgun Wedding). Komedijos. Veiksmo. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Samdinys.
programme.desc: JAV specialiųjų pajėgų seržantas Džeimsas Harperis sulaukia netikėto likimo smūgio. Dėl nelegalių steroidinių preparatų naudojimo jis pašalinamas iš tarnybos. Atidavęs jaunystę ir paaukojęs sveikatą šaliai jis akimirksniu tampa nieko vertas. Vyriškis jaučia didžiulę nuoskaudą. Negana to, praradęs tarnybą jis praranda ir pajamų šaltinį. Skolos kaupiasi ir ateitis darosi vis labiau miglota. Netekęs vilties, jis susisiekia su senu bičiuliu Maiku, dirbančiu privačioje karinėje organizacijoje. Karo veterano Rasčio Dženingso vadovaujama grupuotė vykdo slaptas Gynybos departamento operacijas, o jos nariai mėgaujasi milžiniškais uždarbiais. Pasirašęs kontraktą su Rasčiu, Džeimsas tą pačią minutę gauna 50000 dolerių, kad padengtų savo susikaupusias skolas. Visa grupuotė pradeda naujos užduoties vykdymą. Jie privalo vykti į Vokietiją, susekti įtarimus keliantį mokslininką ir perimti visus jo tyrimus. Rasčio teigimu, mokslininkas dirba teroristinei organizacijai ir kuria biologinį ginklą. Komanda be vargo pasiekia laboratoriją ir įvykdo užduotį. Bet čia netikėtai pasirodo policijos pajėgos ir visiems tenka kovoti už išlikimą. Harperio galvoje pradeda kirbėti abejonės dėl šios misijos teisėtumo. Jo galvoje skamba mirštančio mokslininko dievagojimasis, kad tyrimai atliekami norint išrasti gyvybes gelbstinčią vakciną. Džeimsas ir Maikas nusigauna iki mokslininko namų, kur žmonos padedami gauna jo kompiuterį su visais tyrimų duomenimis. Ar dabar kariams pavyks išsiaiškinti slaptus Rasčio kėslus? Ko iš tiesų siekė karinės organizacijos vadas? (The Contractor). Dramos. Trileriai. Veiksmo.

programme.title: Giesmininkas.
programme.desc: Los Andželo miestas uždarytas jau 4 metus. Dėl viruso mutacijos mirtingumas siekia 56 procentus. Tik keletas atsparių žmonių gali palikti savo namus. Niko yra vienas iš jų. Jis - kurjeris, savo dviračiu pristatantis siuntas. Los Andželo gatvės priklauso tik jam vienam, išskyrus keletą kontrolės punktų. Žmonės jo nekenčia, nes jis turi imunitetą ir gali laisvai judėti, o visi kiti - priversti būti uždaryti. Valdžia prievarta surenka užsikrėtusius žmones ir išveža juos į karantino zonas. Šios zonos laikomos greitos mirties zonomis. Vieną dieną Niko merginai pasireiškia viruso simptomai ir jai gresia atsidurti vienoje iš mirties zonų. (Songbird). Dramos. Trileriai.

programme.title: Pertrauka.
programme.desc: Filmai tiesiogiai per TV. Žiūrėk TV kanalus tiesiogiai internetu per Go3 bet kokiame įrenginyje.

programme.title: Fabelmanai.
programme.desc: Tai pusiau autobiografinis Holivudo karaliaus Steveno Spielbergo darbas, pasakojantis apie berniuką Semį Fabelmaną, kuris, gimęs inžinieriaus ir muzikantės šeimoje, dar nepradėjęs lankyti mokyklos, susižavi kino magija. 1952-ieji. Skatinamas motinos Semis vis drąsiau žvelgia į pasaulį pro kino kameros objektyvą. Netrukus paaiškėjus sukrečiančiai šeimos istorijos detalei, filmų kūrimas berniukui tampa neprilygstamu įrankiu ieškant atsakymų į jį kamuojančius klausimus bei išsigelbėjimu nerimą keliančioje, o kartais ir gąsdinančioje gyvenimo realybėje. Pamažu augdamas ir tobulėdamas vaikinas įsitikina, kad kinas jam - vienintelė ir nepamainoma priemonė ieškant tiesos apie aplinkinius ir save patį. (The Fabelmans). Dramos.

programme.title: Meilė užkandžiams.
programme.desc: Jauna, talentinga interjero dizainerė Olivija Alder skuba į gimtinę. Verslo sunkumus patiriantis tėvas paprašo dukros pagalbos atnaujinant šeimos restoraną. Ant ežero kranto įkurtas restoranas yra viskas, ką turi Olivijos tėvas ir prarasti šią vietą būtų be proto sunku. Mergina su dideliu užsidegimu imasi rekonstrukcijos. Netrukus ji susipažįsta su Deksu. Pasirodo, jos tėvas pasamdė tarptautinio masto kulinarijos žvaigždę, kad šis naujais patiekalais priviliotų klientų minias. Ar Olivijos ir Dekso tandemas nugalės nesėkmes ir prikels restoraną naujam gyvenimui? O gal bendradarbiavimas jiems atneš kur kas daugiau? (Love for Starters). Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Tamsūs vandenys.
programme.desc: Tikrais faktais paremtas trileris pasakoja, kaip didžiųjų korporacijų interesams atstovavęs teisininkas (akt. Markas Ruffalo) pereina į priešingą barikadų pusę, sužinojęs apie vienos didžiausių pasaulio korporacijos neatitaisomą žalą bendruomenei, apnuodytai jų gaminamais toksiškais chemikalais. Apsisprendęs kovoti už tiesą, jis rizikuoja sužlugdyti savo karjerą, prarasti šeimą ir visą savo gyvenimą. Vaidina Anne Hathaway, originalus pavadinimas "Dark Waters". (Dark Waters). Trileriai. Mistika. Dramos.

programme.title: Asteriksas ir stebuklingojo gėrimo paslaptis.
programme.desc: Mažame Prancūzijos kaimelyje gyvenantys Asteriksas ir Obeliksas pasaulį išvydo prieš 60 metų. Nuo pat pirmojo komikso šie du didvyriai nepailsdami kovoja su vis naujais priešais, patiria galybę neįtikėtinų nuotykių ir džiugina viso pasaulio vaikus. Asteriksas ir Obeliksas būtų niekuo neišsiskiriantys vyrukai, jei ne stebuklingas gėrimas, suteikiantis jiems antgamtiškų jėgų. Šio ypatingo gėrimo paslaptį žino vienintelis kaimelyje gyvenantis senas žiniuonis. Vieną dieną, rinkdamas amalo šakeles, žiniuonis nukrenta ir stiprokai prisitrenkia. Dėl savo mirtingumo susirūpinęs senolis nusprendžia, kad atėjo laikas perduoti didžiąją gėrimo paslaptį kitam, jaunesniam žiniuoniui. Kartu su šauniaisiais didvyriais Asteriksu ir Obeliksu žiniuonis iškeliauja į tolimą ir pavojingą kelionę, kad surastų savęs vertą įpėdinį. (Astérix: Le secret de la potion magique). Komedijos. Nuotykių.

programme.title: Tik vasarai.
programme.desc: Anglų kalbos mokytoja dirbanti Penelopė kasmet vasaroja gimtinėje. Čia ji aplanko mylimą močiutę Dotę, kuri nuolat bando supiršti anūkėlę su kiekvienu miesto viengungiu. Atvykusi į miestelį Penelopė netikėtai sutinka vaikystės simpatiją Džeisoną. Vaikinas prisipažįsta, kad jo paties močiutė Sofija elgiasi lygiai taip pat, kaip ir Penelopės močiutė. Norėdami išvengti piršliaujančių senučių dėmesio, jie nutaria apsimesti, jog susitikinėja. Ar stengdamiesi kuo geriau vaidinti mylimuosius, jaunuoliai neuždegs vis dar rusenančių senų jausmų? (Just for the Summer). Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Meile tikiu.
programme.desc: Tikrų įvykių įkvėptas pasakojimas apie amerikiečių dainininko Džeremio Kempo istoriją. Kylanti populiariosios muzikos žvaigždė sutinka savo gyvenimo meilę. Dvidešimtmetis Džeremis beprotiškai įsimyli ir yra įsitikinęs, kad Melisa yra jam skirtoji. Likimas negailestingai bloškia į bedugnę, nes Melisa sunkiai suserga. Džeremio tėvai visais būdais bando įtikinti sūnų laikytis kuo toliau nuo Melisos ir nesieti savo ateities su ja. Pati Melisa irgi maldauja vaikino neprisirišti, nes liga gali bet kurią akimirką juos išskirti amžiams. Tačiau Džeremis neklauso nei tėvų, nei Melisos. Jis lydi mylimąją į ligoninę, rūpinasi ja, bando įkvėpti jai optimizmo. Netrukus jaunuoliai pasižada vienas kitam amžinai meilei. Drauge iškęstas skausmas ir beribė viltis sustiprina jaunuolių meilę. (I Still Believe). Romantiniai. Dramos. Muzikiniai.

programme.title: Namo su laikrodžiais paslaptis.
programme.desc: Netekęs tėvų, mažametis Liujisas persikelia gyventi pas savo ekscentrišką dėdę. Ten, sename ir paslaptingame name, berniuko laukia tikri stebuklai. Netrukus paaiškėja, kad jo dėdė yra tikras burtininkas, o jo kaimynė – geroji ragana. Liujisas taip pat nori išmokti magijos, tačiau netrukus prisidirba ir atgal į gyvenimą prišaukia piktąją burtininkę. Čia magija slypi už kiekvienų durų. Cate Blanchett ir Jack'as Black'as fantastinėje nuotykių komedijoje – "Namo su laikrodžiais paslaptis". (The House with a Clock in Its Walls). Mistika. Komedijos. Fantastiniai. Siaubo.

programme.title: Valerianas ir tūkstančio planetų miestas.
programme.desc: 2150-ieji. Valerianas ir Lorelin - jauni, bet itin talentingi specialieji agentai, prižiūrintys tvarką žmonių gyvenamose teritorijose kosmose. Gavę naują užduotį, porininkai išskrenda į Alfą - įspūdingą kosminį megapolį, dar vadinamą Tūkstančio Planetų miestu. Ten jie išsiaiškina, kad nuostabią tautą, kelis amžius garsėjančią taikumu ir visų Visatos rasių vienybės skatinimu, jau kone sunaikino kruopščiai slepiamas destruktyvus sąmokslas. Valerianas ir Lorelin nedvejodami stoja ginti ne tik Alfą, bet ir Visatos ateitį. Luco Bessono filmas, kaip visada, nukelia į fantastiškų nuotykių kupiną erdvę. Vertas dėmesio Rihannos vaidmuo. (Valerian and the City of a Thousand Planets). Veiksmo.

programme.title: Londono reindžeris.
programme.desc: Teksaso reindžeris Aleksas Tairy (akt. Thomas Jane) dykumoje persekioja bankų plėšiką Deklaną Makbraitą (akt. Dean Jagger). Pasirodo, šis nusikaltėlis yra kur kas pavojingesnis, nei atrodė prieš tai. Jis - tarptautinis teroristas, ketinantis susprogdinti bombą pačiame Londono centre. Per susišaudymą netekęs partnerio, Aleksas tampa britų žvalgybos agentės Dženiferės Smit (akt. Dominique Tipper) ir jos viršininko Geidso (akt. John Malkovich) komandos dalimi. Dabar šiai komandai teks verstis per galvą, sustabdyti teroristą ir suėmus pristatyti jį į teisiamojo suolą. (One Ranger). Veiksmo. Trileriai.

programme.title: Viskas tik prasideda.
programme.desc: Djukas Daiveris – šelmiškas ir patyręs linksmų plaučių vyrukas. Jis gyvena prašmatnioje senjorų rezidencijoje. Čia netrūksta žavių damų, kurias jis visada stengiasi palinksminti. Nerūpestingą jo gyvenimą sutrikdo į rezidenciją atsikraustęs konkurentas, buvęs kariškis, ne mažiau žavingas ir šelmiškas konkurentas Leo. Kovodami dėl merginų dėmesio vyrukai greitai pamiršta geras manieras ir ne juokais kimba vienas kitam į gerklę. Nesustabdoma jėga sutinka nepajudinamą objektą. Morgan'as Freeman'as ir Tommy Lee Jones'as komedijoje – "Viskas tik prasideda". (Just Getting Started). Kriminalai. Veiksmo. Komedijos.

programme.title: Pertrauka.
programme.desc: Filmai tiesiogiai per TV. Žiūrėk TV kanalus tiesiogiai internetu per Go3 bet kokiame įrenginyje.
