And recent discoveries suggest that the number of stars in our galaxy alone, the Milky Way, may exceed 200 billion. Just what are these citizens of the night sky? (The New Frontier). Mokslas.

programme.title: New Frontier.
programme.desc: Perhaps that American politician was right. There are indeed things we know we don't know. For instance, cosmologically speaking, we know we don't know much - and certainly not nearly enough - about two of the enduring mysteries of the Universe. Dark Matter and Dark Energy, it's little wonder that scientists are devoting so much grey matter and energy of their own to finding out as much as they can. (The New Frontier). Mokslas.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures.
programme.desc: It's the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators. (Trésors volés). Kriminalai.

programme.title: Wonder.
programme.desc: Seg 1 Iridescence. Iridescence is the phenomenon where surfaces reflect a multitude of colors at once and could change color perspectives upon shifting the angle of viewing. Iridescence is caused by interference, where light gets reflected or cancelled out by the structures of the surfaces. Seg 2 Chemiluminescence. Chemiluminescence is the phenomenon of producing light energy through chemical reactions. The byproduct of a chemiluminescent reaction, instead of heat energy, is a photon or a light particle. Only selected compounds are capable of producing chemiluminescence, usually highly oxidized compounds when reacting with another compound. Seg 3 Bioluminescence. Bioluminescence is a form of chemiluminescence, only that this occurs in living things. Special compounds collectively called as luciferin oxidizes upon catalysis by enzymes called luciferase, producing oxyluciferin. Upon decay, oxyluciferin releases photons or light particles. Bioluminescence serve different functions for each organism, but all for survival purposes. Seg 4 Gemstone Coloration. A gemstone acquires its color through elements that are essential to its structure or through impurities, or elements that replace some of the metallic ions in the structure that will affect which colors in the visible spectrum gets absorbed or reflected. Seg 5 Mechanical Plant Defenses. Mechanical plant defenses demonstrate how survival instincts are incorporated into plant morphologies and physiologies by growing or producing various defensive features such as thorns, spines, and prickles to the less obvious ones like trichomes and raphides and less aggressive forms of defense like thigmonasty. (Wonder). Mokslas.

programme.title: Wonder.
programme.desc: Seg 1 Visually-Evoked Auditory Response. VEAR or Visually Evoked Auditory response is the type of auditory perception where our brains perceive to hear sounds in response to seeing something. In the case of the jumping pylon illusion, a thud sound is perceived even though there is no sound accompanying the animation. Seg 2 Retinal Fatigue. Retinal fatigue is the term used to describe the condition when the photoreceptors in our eyes become tired or strained due to staring at one color for extend periods of time. The effect causes an afterimage of the complementary color to appear out of nowhere and will be temporarily visible for a few seconds. Seg 3 Müller-Lyer illusion. The Müller-Lyer illusion is an optical illusion where parallel lines of the same length appear longer when perceived with different pointed arrowheads drawn at the ends. Possible explanations suggest that our minds tend to look at overall length rather than just the line's parts or segments when processing the image. Another possible explanation is that our minds tendency to look at angled lines and perceive patterns of depth. Seg 4 Ames Room. The Ames room is a specially constructed room that features a distorted and skewed floor plan. when viewed from one angle, our brain is tricked into thinking that the perspective of the rooms is normal but when a person walks from one end to another the distorted floor angle makes it look as if the person changes size drastically. Seg 5 Synesthesia. Synesthesia is a genetic condition that is present in at least 4% of the human population. People with synesthesia have hyper connected neurons that allow them to perceive a stimuli as interconnected with different senses. An example of which is the ability to see color while hearing sounds. (Wonder). Mokslas.

This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements. (Everyday Elements). Mokslas.

programme.desc: This episode picks up a story started in "Chicago Fire" (Series 7 ep2, 'Going to War') and continued in "Chicago Med" (Series 4 ep2, 'When to Let Go'), in which a fire was deliberately started in an apartment, claiming several lives. The doctor is proved right, as the victim is soon found in a desperate condition. Despite medical attention, she passes away. programme.title: Chicago P.D..
programme.desc: This episode picks up a story started in "Chicago Fire" (Series 7 ep2, 'Going to War') and continued in "Chicago Med" (Series 4 ep2, 'When to Let Go'), in which a fire was deliberately started in an apartment, claiming several lives. programme.title: Chicago P.D..
programme.desc: 31 Chicago PD Trigger (Series 6: 7/22) The intense US police drama series continues its sixth season on 5USA with a case in which a terrorist manifesto encouraging bombers to target the city produces some deadly results. In the wake of the bombing of an army recruitment centre, Atwater goes undercover inside a mosque, trying to get close to its leader, who goes by the name of Akeem, while Halstead and Upton look on from an unmarked car. Atwater suggests to Akeem that the bombing was a good job, but that it didn't go far enough since it claimed no lives. Akeem responds that his campaign is solely to get inside the hearts and minds of Americans. The mosque is under surveillance as it is believed to be the place from where a manifesto titled "Chicago Must Burn" was uploaded onto the internet. As Voight orders the team to restrain their emotions and study the evidence, a call comes in of a bomb threat at a hospital. Despite a search of the building, the bomb goes off. A suspect is identified, but his loyalty and love for America is beyond question. Would a patriot kill for his country? (Chicago P.D.). Trileriai. Dramos. Kriminalai. Veiksmo.

programme.title: Chicago P.D..
programme.desc: Having woken up together, Hailey and Adam head out to get a coffee before their shifts start. A call immediately comes through of a woman in distress in a nearby property. They arrive to spot a car speeding off, narrowly missing Adam. Inside the property, they find a severely beaten woman who, despite Hailey's best efforts, passes away. Voight is suspicious as to why Hailey and Adam were together so early, but the focus switches to the case. A troubled teenager is brought in, who had "borrowed" the car that was seen making a getaway. The youngster says he was in the park smoking at the time. Hailey opens up to the teen about her own difficult childhood, and it helps to break down barriers, but tragically the youngster takes his own life before new evidence backs up his alibi, and leads the team to suspect someone much closer to the victim. (Chicago P.D.). Veiksmo. Kriminalai. Trileriai. Dramos.

programme.title: Chicago P.D..
programme.desc: 31 Chicago PD Trigger (Series 6: 7/22) The intense US police drama series continues its sixth season on 5USA with a case in which a terrorist manifesto encouraging bombers to target the city produces some deadly results. In the wake of the bombing of an army recruitment centre, Atwater goes undercover inside a mosque, trying to get close to its leader, who goes by the name of Akeem, while Halstead and Upton look on from an unmarked car. Atwater suggests to Akeem that the bombing was a good job, but that it didn't go far enough since it claimed no lives. Akeem responds that his campaign is solely to get inside the hearts and minds of Americans. The mosque is under surveillance as it is believed to be the place from where a manifesto titled "Chicago Must Burn" was uploaded onto the internet. As Voight orders the team to restrain their emotions and study the evidence, a call comes in of a bomb threat at a hospital. Despite a search of the building, the bomb goes off. A suspect is identified, but his loyalty and love for America is beyond question. Would a patriot kill for his country? (Chicago P.D.). Veiksmo. Dramos. Kriminalai. Trileriai.

programme.title: Chicago P.D..
programme.desc: Trying to get close to a drug kingpin, Upton and Halstead approach a young boy down a dark alley and ask him to arrange a big deal for them. The youngster agrees and arranges a time and a place for them to meet up later. But the promised deal never happens. After a call comes through of shots being fired in a nearby block, Halstead and Upton find the youngster Malik barely alive, and he passes away in front of them. Voight believes that the dealer who Malik was running for must have got spooked as to why the boy asked for such a big deal. The team then bring in another young runner, and threaten him with heroin possession unless he wears a wire and helps them bring in whoever shot Malik. But Atwater nearly blows the whole case when he gets too close to one of the suspects—one whose prints were found on the gun used to kill Malik. (Chicago P.D.). Trileriai. Veiksmo. Kriminalai. [18+]. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Dingo be žinios.

programme.title: Dingo be žinios.

programme.title: Samdoma žmogžudystė.
programme.desc: Po skaudžių skyrybų, priklausomybių terapeutė šantažuoja savo pacientą, kad šis padėtų jai rasti samdomą žudiką buvusiam vyrui nužudyti. Tačiau ji nežino, kad pacientas kreipėsi į nusikaltėliu apsimetantį policijos pareigūną, kuris siekė užkirsti kelią šaltakraujiškai žmogžudystei. (Murder for Hire). Kriminalai.

programme.title: Pirmos 48 valandos.
programme.desc: Narkotikų sandėris automobilių stovėjimo aikštelėje virsta susišaudymu, pareikalavusiu dviejų Atlantos gyventojų gyvybių; egzekucija prie Talsos motelio virsta dviguba žmogžudyste, kai žudikas pastebi liudininką. (The First 48). [12+]. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Dingo be žinios.
programme.desc: Be žinios dingus 70-mečiui buvusiam ugniagesiui Michaelui Chambersui garaže aptikta kruvina nusikaltimo vieta sufleruoja įvykdytą nusikaltimą. Visgi tyrėjai pradeda įtarti, kad nusikaltimo vieta - inscenizuota, ir Michaelas galėjo pasislėpti pats. (Disappeared). [18+]. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Nužudyti prieš išauštant.
programme.desc: Baigęs darbą naktinėje pamainoje Indianos studentas važiuoja namo. Po kelių valandų jo mašina randama palikta už kelių mylių. Neilgai trukus, pranešimų apie du radinius sulaukę pareigūnai pradeda įtarti, kad jų miestelyje veikia serijinis žudikas. (Murdered by Morning). Kriminalai.

programme.title: Vieniša girta moteris.
programme.desc: Po gėdingo pasirodymo viešumoje dvidešimtmetė alkoholikė Sam priversta grįžti namo pas valdingą motiną Kerol; apsupta visų dirgiklių, kurie privertė gerti, Sam bando įveikti savo blogiausias dienas ir atrasti geriausią savo versiją. (Single Drunk Female). [14+]. Dramos. Komedijos.

Tuo tarpu pasirodžius Sam lygtinį paleidimą kontroliuojančiam pareigūnui, Kerol sunkiai sekasi paaškinti dukros situaciją draugams. (Single Drunk Female). [14+]. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: My Name is Earl.
programme.desc: Earl Hickey's life has been full of poor choices and mistakes, and upon discovering that he is the holder of a winning lottery ticket, Earl is hit by a car and the ticket blows out of his hand as he lies unconscious in the street. While recovering in the hospital and watching television, Earl has a karmic epiphany, thanks to Carson Daly, who attributes his success to doing good for others. A light bulb goes on in Earl's dim head, and he sets out to right every wrong he has done. He will turn his good fortune into a life changing event, as he sets out to right all the wrongs from his past. Despite his seemingly limited intelligence, he is oddly effective and has a voice and style of his own. (My Name is Earl). [12+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: Young Sheldon.
programme.desc: The US comedy series and spin-off prequel to The Big Bang Theory comes to E4, giving TV audiences the chance to meet the eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper in childhood as he embarks upon his awkward and hopeful journey towards the man he will become. For nine-year-old Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage) it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Possessing a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are kings. And, while the vulnerable, gifted and naive Sheldon deals with the world, his family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George (Lance Barber), is struggling to navigate a path as a high school football coach and father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary (Zoe Perry), fiercely protects and nurtures her son in a town where he just doesn't fit in. Sheldon's older brother, Georgie (Montana Jordan), does the best he can in high school, but it's hard to be cool when you're in the same classes as your nine-year-old sibling. Finally, there's Sheldon's twin sister, Missy (Raegan Revord), who often resents all the attention Sheldon gets, but also remains the one person who can reliably tell him the truth. Narrated by Jim Parsons, who plays the adult Sheldon in The Big Bang Theory. (Young Sheldon). Komedijos.

Also, Rachel's efforts to make the apartment safe for her baby make Joey crazy. (Friends). Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Friends.
programme.desc: Delve into the hearts and minds of six friends living in New York City as they explore the anxieties and absurdities of true adulthood. This smart, sophisticated series offers a hilarious take on dating and working in the big city. As Rachel, Monica, Phoebe, Joey, Chandler and Ross realize, the search for happiness often seems to turn up more questions than answers. But while they look within for fulfillment, they also look out for one another during this exciting time when everything seems possible – as long as they've got Friends. (Friends). Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Young Sheldon.
programme.desc: The US comedy series and spin-off prequel to The Big Bang Theory comes to E4, giving TV audiences the chance to meet the eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper in childhood as he embarks upon his awkward and hopeful journey towards the man he will become. For nine-year-old Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage) it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Possessing a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are kings. And, while the vulnerable, gifted and naive Sheldon deals with the world, his family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George (Lance Barber), is struggling to navigate a path as a high school football coach and father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary (Zoe Perry), fiercely protects and nurtures her son in a town where he just doesn't fit in. Sheldon's older brother, Georgie (Montana Jordan), does the best he can in high school, but it's hard to be cool when you're in the same classes as your nine-year-old sibling. Finally, there's Sheldon's twin sister, Missy (Raegan Revord), who often resents all the attention Sheldon gets, but also remains the one person who can reliably tell him the truth. Narrated by Jim Parsons, who plays the adult Sheldon in The Big Bang Theory. (Young Sheldon). Komedijos.

programme.title: Young Sheldon.

To appease his mother, who worries that he might be lonely, Sheldon employs the techniques described in a self-help book from the library in an attempt to make a friend. Narrated by Jim Parsons, who plays the adult Sheldon in The Big Bang Theory. (Young Sheldon). Komedijos.

programme.title: My Name is Earl.
programme.desc: Earl Hickey's life has been full of poor choices and mistakes, and upon discovering that he is the holder of a winning lottery ticket, Earl is hit by a car and the ticket blows out of his hand as he lies unconscious in the street. While recovering in the hospital and watching television, Earl has a karmic epiphany, thanks to Carson Daly, who attributes his success to doing good for others. A light bulb goes on in Earl's dim head, and he sets out to right every wrong he has done. He will turn his good fortune into a life changing event, as he sets out to right all the wrongs from his past. Despite his seemingly limited intelligence, he is oddly effective and has a voice and style of his own. (My Name is Earl). [12+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: Young Sheldon.
programme.desc: For 11-year-old Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naïve Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son in a town where he just doesn't fit in. Sheldon's older brother, Georgie, does the best he can in high school, but it's tough to be cool when you're in the same classes with your odd 11-year-old brother. Finally, there's Sheldon's twin sister, Missy, who sometimes resents all the attention Sheldon gets, but also remains the one person who can reliably tell Sheldon the truth. (Young Sheldon). Komedijos.

programme.title: Young Sheldon.
programme.desc: For 11-year-old Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naïve Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son in a town where he just doesn't fit in. Sheldon's older brother, Georgie, does the best he can in high school, but it's tough to be cool when you're in the same classes with your odd 11-year-old brother. Finally, there's Sheldon's twin sister, Missy, who sometimes resents all the attention Sheldon gets, but also remains the one person who can reliably tell Sheldon the truth. (Young Sheldon). Komedijos.

programme.title: Friends.
programme.desc: Still in Barbados after Ross' keynote address, the friends cope with a variety of dilemmas. Ross has kissed his colleague Charlie Wheeler (Aisha Tyler), although she is still officially dating Joey. Joey and Rachel have kissed as well, but they agonize over how to tell Ross. Phoebe's former boyfriend, Mike (Paul Rudd), has followed Phoebe to the island and proposed marriage to her, despite his being in a relationship with someone else. And Monica has developed really big hair, due to the humidity. Chandler's problem is that he can barely restrain himself from making fun of his wife. (Friends). Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Two and a Half Men.
programme.desc: "Such a Funny Life" is about the Guiterrez family who moves to New York from "nowhere". Our main character, David grew up in a challenging household with an abusive and plotting father Ralph, and mentally challenged mother Mariah. David is a complete pariah in school and in the street but he is destined to be a comic and entertainer. Through his childhood we follow him as he loses his sister Gabriella, to a tragic death, and then in his teens he falls in love with a complicated and troubled girl named Mariah. He befriends Tito, the responsible kid turned club owner and Rob, the neighborhood leader who turns into the biggest drug dealer in Brooklyn. We see the evolution of David as he juggles painful circumstances with dire decisions while still honing his ambition to be a successful comic, entertainer and actor (Two and a Half Men). [12+]. Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Two and a Half Men.
programme.desc: Charlie is a well-to-do bachelor with a house at the beach, a Jaguar in the front, and an easy way with women. His casual Malibu lifestyle is interrupted when his tightly wound brother Alan, who's facing a divorce, and his son Jake, come to live with him. Together, these two and a half men confront the challenges of growing up; finally. Complicating matters are the brothers' self-obsessed, controlling mother, Evelyn, Alan's estranged wife, Judith and Charlie's crazy neighbor Rose, who wants to be a part of his life and is willing to do anything to be around. After the death of his brother, Alan Harper meets and befriends a lonely young man named Walden Schmidt who turns out to be a billionaire. Unable to afford his brother's home, Alan sells Walden the house, and as a way of showing his gratitude, Walden allows Alan and his son Jake to move in with him. (Two and a Half Men). [12+]. Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Modern Family.
programme.desc: Rather than be ripped off by a pricey repair service, Phil resolves to fix the clothes dryer by himself. Claire's been preparing family dinners gleaned from a new cooking show, but she's proving to not be a diligent student so Haley enrolls them both in a cooking class taught by the show's chef with the hopes of showing Claire the error of her ways. Meanwhile, Jay feels emasculated when Gloria hires the little league coach to teach Joe how to throw a baseball properly. And when Lily uses an app to hire a lady to clean her room, Mitch and Cam realize that it's time to unplug and become more self-reliant. (Modern Family). [12+]. Komedijos. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Modern Family.
programme.desc: Despite their lofty hopes, Phil and Jay's property investment might turn out to be a bust, forcing Phil to rethink his original dream. Meanwhile, Cam lands in the hospital due to a head injury and refuses to have an MRI thanks to a traumatic incident with a well when he was a child. Determined to finally impress Claire and keep her from re-gifting her birthday present, Gloria surprises her with a day of luxury at the office. programme.title: Young Sheldon.
programme.desc: The US comedy series and spin-off prequel to The Big Bang Theory comes to E4, giving TV audiences the chance to meet the eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper in childhood as he embarks upon his awkward and hopeful journey towards the man he will become. For nine-year-old Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage) it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Possessing a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are kings. And, while the vulnerable, gifted and naive Sheldon deals with the world, his family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George (Lance Barber), is struggling to navigate a path as a high school football coach and father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary (Zoe Perry), fiercely protects and nurtures her son in a town where he just doesn't fit in. Sheldon's older brother, Georgie (Montana Jordan), does the best he can in high school, but it's hard to be cool when you're in the same classes as your nine-year-old sibling. Finally, there's Sheldon's twin sister, Missy (Raegan Revord), who often resents all the attention Sheldon gets, but also remains the one person who can reliably tell him the truth. Narrated by Jim Parsons, who plays the adult Sheldon in The Big Bang Theory. (Young Sheldon). Komedijos.

programme.title: My Name is Earl.
programme.desc: Earl Hickey's life has been full of poor choices and mistakes, and upon discovering that he is the holder of a winning lottery ticket, Earl is hit by a car and the ticket blows out of his hand as he lies unconscious in the street. While recovering in the hospital and watching television, Earl has a karmic epiphany, thanks to Carson Daly, who attributes his success to doing good for others. A light bulb goes on in Earl's dim head, and he sets out to right every wrong he has done. He will turn his good fortune into a life changing event, as he sets out to right all the wrongs from his past. Despite his seemingly limited intelligence, he is oddly effective and has a voice and style of his own. (My Name is Earl). [12+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: Modern Family.

programme.title: Young Sheldon.
programme.desc: For 11-year-old Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naïve Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son in a town where he just doesn't fit in. Sheldon's older brother, Georgie, does the best he can in high school, but it's tough to be cool when you're in the same classes with your odd 11-year-old brother. Finally, there's Sheldon's twin sister, Missy, who sometimes resents all the attention Sheldon gets, but also remains the one person who can reliably tell Sheldon the truth. (Young Sheldon). Komedijos.

programme.title: Friends.
programme.desc: Disappointed to learn that they cannot conceive a baby naturally, Monica and Chandler mull their options. When Chandler brings home a handsome, unknowing co-worker, Zack (John Stamos), for dinner, Monica and Chandler embarrassingly "interview" him as a potential sperm donor. Meanwhile, while shopping with Phoebe, Rachel confides that she is enamored with Joey. Unfortunately, Joey's current girlfriend, Charlie (Aisha Tyler), overhears. And Phoebe encounters a boyfriend, David (Hank Azaria), from long ago. (Friends). Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Friends.
programme.desc: Ross is so excited to deliver a keynote address at a paleontologists convention on Barbados that he procures free passes to the event for all his friends. On the island, Joey is amazed that Ross is the one being recognized by fans instead of him, but at least Joey is still dating gorgeous paleontologist Charlie (Aisha Tyler), to Ross' chagrin. Having recently ended her relationship with Mike (Paul Rudd), Phoebe brings her former boyfriend, David (Hank Azaria), to the island. (Friends). Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Friends.
programme.desc: Delve into the hearts and minds of six friends living in New York City as they explore the anxieties and absurdities of true adulthood. This smart, sophisticated series offers a hilarious take on dating and working in the big city. As Rachel, Monica, Phoebe, Joey, Chandler and Ross realize, the search for happiness often seems to turn up more questions than answers. But while they look within for fulfillment, they also look out for one another during this exciting time when everything seems possible – as long as they've got Friends. (Friends). Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Friends.
programme.desc: Still in Barbados after Ross' keynote address, the friends cope with a variety of dilemmas. Ross has kissed his colleague Charlie Wheeler (Aisha Tyler), although she is still officially dating Joey. Joey and Rachel have kissed as well, but they agonize over how to tell Ross. Phoebe's former boyfriend, Mike (Paul Rudd), has followed Phoebe to the island and proposed marriage to her, despite his being in a relationship with someone else. And Monica has developed really big hair, due to the humidity. Chandler's problem is that he can barely restrain himself from making fun of his wife. (Friends). Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: My Name is Earl.
programme.desc: Earl Hickey's life has been full of poor choices and mistakes, and upon discovering that he is the holder of a winning lottery ticket, Earl is hit by a car and the ticket blows out of his hand as he lies unconscious in the street. While recovering in the hospital and watching television, Earl has a karmic epiphany, thanks to Carson Daly, who attributes his success to doing good for others. A light bulb goes on in Earl's dim head, and he sets out to right every wrong he has done. He will turn his good fortune into a life changing event, as he sets out to right all the wrongs from his past. Despite his seemingly limited intelligence, he is oddly effective and has a voice and style of his own. (My Name is Earl). [12+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: Two and a Half Men.
programme.desc: "Such a Funny Life" is about the Guiterrez family who moves to New York from "nowhere". Our main character, David grew up in a challenging household with an abusive and plotting father Ralph, and mentally challenged mother Mariah. David is a complete pariah in school and in the street but he is destined to be a comic and entertainer. Through his childhood we follow him as he loses his sister Gabriella, to a tragic death, and then in his teens he falls in love with a complicated and troubled girl named Mariah. He befriends Tito, the responsible kid turned club owner and Rob, the neighborhood leader who turns into the biggest drug dealer in Brooklyn. We see the evolution of David as he juggles painful circumstances with dire decisions while still honing his ambition to be a successful comic, entertainer and actor (Two and a Half Men). [12+]. Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Two and a Half Men.
programme.desc: Charlie is a well-to-do bachelor with a house at the beach, a Jaguar in the front, and an easy way with women. His casual Malibu lifestyle is interrupted when his tightly wound brother Alan, who's facing a divorce, and his son Jake, come to live with him. Together, these two and a half men confront the challenges of growing up; finally. Complicating matters are the brothers' self-obsessed, controlling mother, Evelyn, Alan's estranged wife, Judith and Charlie's crazy neighbor Rose, who wants to be a part of his life and is willing to do anything to be around. After the death of his brother, Alan Harper meets and befriends a lonely young man named Walden Schmidt who turns out to be a billionaire. Unable to afford his brother's home, Alan sells Walden the house, and as a way of showing his gratitude, Walden allows Alan and his son Jake to move in with him. (Two and a Half Men). [12+]. Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Young Sheldon.
programme.desc: For 11-year-old Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naïve Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son in a town where he just doesn't fit in. Sheldon's older brother, Georgie, does the best he can in high school, but it's tough to be cool when you're in the same classes with your odd 11-year-old brother. Finally, there's Sheldon's twin sister, Missy, who sometimes resents all the attention Sheldon gets, but also remains the one person who can reliably tell Sheldon the truth. (Young Sheldon). Komedijos.

programme.title: Two and a Half Men.
programme.desc: "Such a Funny Life" is about the Guiterrez family who moves to New York from "nowhere". Our main character, David grew up in a challenging household with an abusive and plotting father Ralph, and mentally challenged mother Mariah. David is a complete pariah in school and in the street but he is destined to be a comic and entertainer. Through his childhood we follow him as he loses his sister Gabriella, to a tragic death, and then in his teens he falls in love with a complicated and troubled girl named Mariah. He befriends Tito, the responsible kid turned club owner and Rob, the neighborhood leader who turns into the biggest drug dealer in Brooklyn. We see the evolution of David as he juggles painful circumstances with dire decisions while still honing his ambition to be a successful comic, entertainer and actor (Two and a Half Men). [12+]. Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Two and a Half Men.
programme.desc: Charlie is a well-to-do bachelor with a house at the beach, a Jaguar in the front, and an easy way with women. His casual Malibu lifestyle is interrupted when his tightly wound brother Alan, who's facing a divorce, and his son Jake, come to live with him. Together, these two and a half men confront the challenges of growing up; finally. Complicating matters are the brothers' self-obsessed, controlling mother, Evelyn, Alan's estranged wife, Judith and Charlie's crazy neighbor Rose, who wants to be a part of his life and is willing to do anything to be around. After the death of his brother, Alan Harper meets and befriends a lonely young man named Walden Schmidt who turns out to be a billionaire. Unable to afford his brother's home, Alan sells Walden the house, and as a way of showing his gratitude, Walden allows Alan and his son Jake to move in with him. (Two and a Half Men). [12+]. Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Young Sheldon.
programme.desc: For 11-year-old Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naïve Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son in a town where he just doesn't fit in. Sheldon's older brother, Georgie, does the best he can in high school, but it's tough to be cool when you're in the same classes with your odd 11-year-old brother. Finally, there's Sheldon's twin sister, Missy, who sometimes resents all the attention Sheldon gets, but also remains the one person who can reliably tell Sheldon the truth. (Young Sheldon). Komedijos.

Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naïve Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son in a town where he just doesn't fit in. Sheldon's older brother, Georgie, does the best he can in high school, but it's tough to be cool when you're in the same classes with your odd 11-year-old brother. Finally, there's Sheldon's twin sister, Missy, who sometimes resents all the attention Sheldon gets, but also remains the one person who can reliably tell Sheldon the truth. (Young Sheldon). Komedijos.

programme.title: Married ... with Children.
programme.desc: This Fox comedy broke the mold of unbelievably selfless family characters which had become the norm in American sitcoms of the 1980's. Al Bundy, shoe salesman, fears the frequent amorous advances of his ditsy wife Peggy, who henpecks him and frivolously spends all of his money, reliving his 4 touchdowns in a single game at high school. Supporting characters include their two shallow, self-serving teenage children Kelly and Bud, as well as nosy neighbor Marcy and her husband. (Married with Children). [12+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: Friends.
programme.desc: Delve into the hearts and minds of six friends living in New York City as they explore the anxieties and absurdities of true adulthood. This smart, sophisticated series offers a hilarious take on dating and working in the big city. As Rachel, Monica, Phoebe, Joey, Chandler and Ross realize, the search for happiness often seems to turn up more questions than answers. But while they look within for fulfillment, they also look out for one another during this exciting time when everything seems possible – as long as they've got Friends. (Friends). Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Friends.
programme.desc: Rachel feels like her annoying, self-indulgent younger sister, Amy (Christina Applegate), is finally on the verge of making a major change in her attitude. In order to help Amy become a more responsible person, Rachel overrides Ross' strong protests and allows Amy to baby-sit Emma. She soon regrets that decision. Meanwhile, Phoebe unknowingly thwarts Mike's "anniversary" surprise for her. Also, Monica and Chandler become concerned when Joey tries to use big words in a recommendation letter on their behalf to a child adoption agency. (Friends). Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Two and a Half Men.
programme.desc: Charlie is a well-to-do bachelor with a house at the beach, a Jaguar in the front, and an easy way with women. His casual Malibu lifestyle is interrupted when his tightly wound brother Alan, who's facing a divorce, and his son Jake, come to live with him. Together, these two and a half men confront the challenges of growing up; finally. Complicating matters are the brothers' self-obsessed, controlling mother, Evelyn, Alan's estranged wife, Judith and Charlie's crazy neighbor Rose, who wants to be a part of his life and is willing to do anything to be around. After the death of his brother, Alan Harper meets and befriends a lonely young man named Walden Schmidt who turns out to be a billionaire. Unable to afford his brother's home, Alan sells Walden the house, and as a way of showing his gratitude, Walden allows Alan and his son Jake to move in with him. (Two and a Half Men). [12+]. Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Modern Family.
programme.desc: The focus is on three families who are related: Jay and his young wife Gloria, with their son Manny. Claire, the daughter of Jay from a previous marriage, and her family; husband, Phil, and children, Hayley, Alex, and Luke. Then the third family, which compromises of Mitchell, Jay's other son and Claire's brother, and his family; Cameron, his husband, and their adopted child, Lily. All members of this diverse family have their own character quirks, which combine to create hilarious scenarios around family life. The show first aired in 2009, and has watched the characters grow through the years, addressing all the dramas that come with this. It does so in a light-hearted humorous way, with some heart-touching moments along the way. The series has won multiple awards, including "Outstanding Comedy Series" in 2014. (Modern Family). [12+]. Dramos. Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Modern Family.
programme.desc: Mitch and Cam have five minutes to catch a new flight while fighting the effects of sleeping pills they took prematurely. Then, at Rainer's birthday dinner, Haley and Rainer are forced to reevaluate their entire relationship in the five minutes before the birthday cake arrives. Meanwhile, Phil and Claire pay a surprise visit to Alex and are given a five-minute surprise introduction to her new boyfriend. Finally, with only five minutes to catch a movie, Manny has to find the perfect parking space and endure Jay and Gloria's backseat argument. (Modern Family). [12+]. Komedijos. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Arrested Development.
programme.desc: Some unfortunate pictures of Tobias wind up on the Internet, which the military mistakes for pictures of Iraq and proof that the Bluth Company was building houses over there. Wayne Jarvis, the family's former attorney, makes Michael an offer he can't refuse. Meanwhile, Buster seeks GOB's help to provide motivation for his Army training. (Arrested Development). [12+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: Arrested Development.
programme.desc: While Buster looks for ways to get out of serving in Iraq, Lindsay's quest to score a date at the Bluth Company Christmas party backfires after Gob's sexual harassment speech. Michael and Maeby get in trouble singing Afternoon Delight, but are quickly overshadowed by Oscar and Lucille's afternoon delight. (Arrested Development). [12+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: The Mick.
programme.desc: Mackenzie "Mickey" Murphy, a hard-living, rude and foul-mouthed woman takes a role of a lifetime when she is left to take care of her wealthy sister's three spoiled children - 18-year-old Sabrina,13-year-old Chip and 7-year-old Ben, when her sister flees the country with her husband to avoid criminal charges. Mickey is left in charge and must quickly become responsible as she moves in their Connecticut mansion and struggles to raise the kids with the help from her crazy boyfriend Jimmy and housekeeper Alba. (The Mick). [14+]. Komedijos.

Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son in a town where he just doesn't fit in. Sheldon's older brother, Georgie, does the best he can in high school, but it's tough to be cool when you're in the same classes with your odd 11-year-old brother. Finally, there's Sheldon's twin sister, Missy, who sometimes resents all the attention Sheldon gets, but also remains the one person who can reliably tell Sheldon the truth. (Young Sheldon). Komedijos.

programme.title: Modern Family.
programme.desc: Summer vacations take the Dunphys to New York; Mitch, Cam and Lily to the Midwest; and Jay, Gloria, Manny and Joe to Juarez, Mexico. Then the Pritchett-Dunphy-Tucker clan reunites in its eighth season premiere with all of the families converging at home for Father's Day. In subsequent episodes, as Claire struggles to keep order at the company with Jay back in the fold at Pritchett's Closets, Phil starts to enjoy more hobbies. Gloria's hot sauce business starts to pick up steam, while Mitch and Cam continue to see a parade of interesting guests in their upstairs rental unit, and also deal with their maturing tween, Lily. Meanwhile, Haley changes jobs and starts down a new entrepreneurial path, focusing on her career in an attempt to balance out her wobbly romantic life, and Alex learns to keep her life balanced at Caltech, including dealing with a considerable bout of mononucleosis. Manny and Luke fumble through their freedom-filled senior year of high school but feel the pressure of college approaching, complete with a joint college visit. Halloween and New Year's Eve episodes will punctuate a season that continues to watch this wonderfully large and blended family evolve, giving us an honest and often hilarious look into the warm and sometimes twisted embrace of the modern family. (Modern Family). [12+]. Romantiniai. Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: Friends.

Unfortunately, Laura horrifies the uptight couple when she confesses that she was once romanced by a cad named Joey, who lives in the same building and never returned her calls. Meanwhile, Phoebe and Mike opt to have a small wedding and donate the extra money to a children's charity - only to demand it all back later. And Ross tries to help Rachel overcome her irrational fear of swing sets so baby Emma can enjoy herself at the playground. (Friends). Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Young Sheldon.
programme.desc: For 11-year-old Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naïve Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son in a town where he just doesn't fit in. Sheldon's older brother, Georgie, does the best he can in high school, but it's tough to be cool when you're in the same classes with your odd 11-year-old brother. Finally, there's Sheldon's twin sister, Missy, who sometimes resents all the attention Sheldon gets, but also remains the one person who can reliably tell Sheldon the truth. (Young Sheldon). Komedijos.

programme.title: Modern Family.
programme.desc: Summer vacations take the Dunphys to New York; Mitch, Cam and Lily to the Midwest; and Jay, Gloria, Manny and Joe to Juarez, Mexico. Then the Pritchett-Dunphy-Tucker clan reunites in its eighth season premiere with all of the families converging at home for Father's Day. In subsequent episodes, as Claire struggles to keep order at the company with Jay back in the fold at Pritchett's Closets, Phil starts to enjoy more hobbies. Gloria's hot sauce business starts to pick up steam, while Mitch and Cam continue to see a parade of interesting guests in their upstairs rental unit, and also deal with their maturing tween, Lily. Meanwhile, Haley changes jobs and starts down a new entrepreneurial path, focusing on her career in an attempt to balance out her wobbly romantic life, and Alex learns to keep her life balanced at Caltech, including dealing with a considerable bout of mononucleosis. Manny and Luke fumble through their freedom-filled senior year of high school but feel the pressure of college approaching, complete with a joint college visit. Halloween and New Year's Eve episodes will punctuate a season that continues to watch this wonderfully large and blended family evolve, giving us an honest and often hilarious look into the warm and sometimes twisted embrace of the modern family. (Modern Family). [12+]. Dramos. Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Friends.
programme.desc: A reflection on the destinies of comrades who were once bound by ideologies and remain tightly knit friends, We Were Communists an uninhibited examination of the legacy of Lebanon's civil war and its post-war present. Four men recount their stories from the battlefield, their broken dreams, and their eventual disillusionment in light of the country's unsettled crises. Artistically and politically audacious, incisive and tender, the film travels the chimeric and daunting reality of Lebanon's fractured post-war landscape. As sectarian leaders continue to strengthen their hold over political discourse, the film poses serious questions regarding the country's future. (Friends). Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Young Sheldon.
programme.desc: For 11-year-old Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naïve Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son in a town where he just doesn't fit in. Sheldon's older brother, Georgie, does the best he can in high school, but it's tough to be cool when you're in the same classes with your odd 11-year-old brother. Finally, there's Sheldon's twin sister, Missy, who sometimes resents all the attention Sheldon gets, but also remains the one person who can reliably tell Sheldon the truth. (Young Sheldon). Komedijos.

programme.title: Modern Family.
programme.desc: Summer vacations take the Dunphys to New York; Mitch, Cam and Lily to the Midwest; and Jay, Gloria, Manny and Joe to Juarez, Mexico. Then the Pritchett-Dunphy-Tucker clan reunites in its eighth season premiere with all of the families converging at home for Father's Day. In subsequent episodes, as Claire struggles to keep order at the company with Jay back in the fold at Pritchett's Closets, Phil starts to enjoy more hobbies. Gloria's hot sauce business starts to pick up steam, while Mitch and Cam continue to see a parade of interesting guests in their upstairs rental unit, and also deal with their maturing tween, Lily. Meanwhile, Haley changes jobs and starts down a new entrepreneurial path, focusing on her career in an attempt to balance out her wobbly romantic life, and Alex learns to keep her life balanced at Caltech, including dealing with a considerable bout of mononucleosis. Manny and Luke fumble through their freedom-filled senior year of high school but feel the pressure of college approaching, complete with a joint college visit. Halloween and New Year's Eve episodes will punctuate a season that continues to watch this wonderfully large and blended family evolve, giving us an honest and often hilarious look into the warm and sometimes twisted embrace of the modern family. (Modern Family). [12+]. Romantiniai. Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: Two and a Half Men.
programme.desc: Charlie is a well-to-do bachelor with a house at the beach, a Jaguar in the front, and an easy way with women. His casual Malibu lifestyle is interrupted when his tightly wound brother Alan, who's facing a divorce, and his son Jake, come to live with him. Together, these two and a half men confront the challenges of growing up; finally. Complicating matters are the brothers' self-obsessed, controlling mother, Evelyn, Alan's estranged wife, Judith and Charlie's crazy neighbor Rose, who wants to be a part of his life and is willing to do anything to be around. After the death of his brother, Alan Harper meets and befriends a lonely young man named Walden Schmidt who turns out to be a billionaire. Unable to afford his brother's home, Alan sells Walden the house, and as a way of showing his gratitude, Walden allows Alan and his son Jake to move in with him. (Two and a Half Men). [12+]. Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Friends.
programme.desc: Delve into the hearts and minds of six friends living in New York City as they explore the anxieties and absurdities of true adulthood. This smart, sophisticated series offers a hilarious take on dating and working in the big city. As Rachel, Monica, Phoebe, Joey, Chandler and Ross realize, the search for happiness often seems to turn up more questions than answers. But while they look within for fulfillment, they also look out for one another during this exciting time when everything seems possible – as long as they've got Friends. (Friends). Komedijos. programme.title: Friends.
programme.desc: A reflection on the destinies of comrades who were once bound by ideologies and remain tightly knit friends, We Were Communists an uninhibited examination of the legacy of Lebanon's civil war and its post-war present. Four men recount their stories from the battlefield, their broken dreams, and their eventual disillusionment in light of the country's unsettled crises. Artistically and politically audacious, incisive and tender, the film travels the chimeric and daunting reality of Lebanon's fractured post-war landscape. As sectarian leaders continue to strengthen their hold over political discourse, the film poses serious questions regarding the country's future. (Friends). Komedijos. Romantiniai.

Claire, the daughter of Jay from a previous marriage, and her family; husband, Phil, and children, Hayley, Alex, and Luke. Then the third family, which compromises of Mitchell, Jay's other son and Claire's brother, and his family; Cameron, his husband, and their adopted child, Lily. All members of this diverse family have their own character quirks, which combine to create hilarious scenarios around family life. The show first aired in 2009, and has watched the characters grow through the years, addressing all the dramas that come with this. It does so in a light-hearted humorous way, with some heart-touching moments along the way. The series has won multiple awards, including "Outstanding Comedy Series" in 2014. (Modern Family). [12+]. programme.title: Young Sheldon.
programme.desc: For 11-year-old Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naïve Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son in a town where he just doesn't fit in. Sheldon's older brother, Georgie, does the best he can in high school, but it's tough to be cool when you're in the same classes with your odd 11-year-old brother. Finally, there's Sheldon's twin sister, Missy, who sometimes resents all the attention Sheldon gets, but also remains the one person who can reliably tell Sheldon the truth. (Young Sheldon). Komedijos.

programme.title: Modern Family.
programme.desc: Summer vacations take the Dunphys to New York; Mitch, Cam and Lily to the Midwest; and Jay, Gloria, Manny and Joe to Juarez, Mexico. Then the Pritchett-Dunphy-Tucker clan reunites in its eighth season premiere with all of the families converging at home for Father's Day. In subsequent episodes, as Claire struggles to keep order at the company with Jay back in the fold at Pritchett's Closets, Phil starts to enjoy more hobbies. Gloria's hot sauce business starts to pick up steam, while Mitch and Cam continue to see a parade of interesting guests in their upstairs rental unit, and also deal with their maturing tween, Lily. Meanwhile, Haley changes jobs and starts down a new entrepreneurial path, focusing on her career in an attempt to balance out her wobbly romantic life, and Alex learns to keep her life balanced at Caltech, including dealing with a considerable bout of mononucleosis. Manny and Luke fumble through their freedom-filled senior year of high school but feel the pressure of college approaching, complete with a joint college visit. Halloween and New Year's Eve episodes will punctuate a season that continues to watch this wonderfully large and blended family evolve, giving us an honest and often hilarious look into the warm and sometimes twisted embrace of the modern family. (Modern Family). [12+]. Dramos. Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Young Sheldon.
programme.desc: For 11-year-old Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naïve Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son in a town where he just doesn't fit in. Sheldon's older brother, Georgie, does the best he can in high school, but it's tough to be cool when you're in the same classes with your odd 11-year-old brother. Finally, there's Sheldon's twin sister, Missy, who sometimes resents all the attention Sheldon gets, but also remains the one person who can reliably tell Sheldon the truth. (Young Sheldon). Komedijos.

programme.title: Friends.
programme.desc: A reflection on the destinies of comrades who were once bound by ideologies and remain tightly knit friends, We Were Communists an uninhibited examination of the legacy of Lebanon's civil war and its post-war present. Four men recount their stories from the battlefield, their broken dreams, and their eventual disillusionment in light of the country's unsettled crises. Artistically and politically audacious, incisive and tender, the film travels the chimeric and daunting reality of Lebanon's fractured post-war landscape. As sectarian leaders continue to strengthen their hold over political discourse, the film poses serious questions regarding the country's future. (Friends). Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Friends.
programme.desc: When Phoebe and Rachel see Chandler getting into a car with a pretty woman during work hours, they follow him to the suburbs and witness him going inside a large house with the woman. Fearing that Chandler is cheating on Monica, they inform her - and learn that the woman is a real estate agent. The pair has been secretly shopping for houses and struggling with how to tell their best friends that they are leaving the City. In an emotional montage, clips from previous episodes highlight many of the experiences the friends have shared in Monica and Chandler's apartment. (Friends). Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Friends.
programme.desc: Joey appears as a celebrity contestant on "The $100,000 Pyramid," with its actual host, Donny Osmond (himself), but Joey's dubious IQ costs his partner the prize money. Meanwhile, Monica and Rachel hire an ungainly stripper, Roy (Danny DeVito), without seeing him first, for Phoebe's bachelorette party. Also, Chandler and Ross attend a college reunion and meet an attractive woman they both promised not to date during school. (Friends). Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Two and a Half Men.
programme.desc: Charlie is a well-to-do bachelor with a house at the beach, a Jaguar in the front, and an easy way with women. His casual Malibu lifestyle is interrupted when his tightly wound brother Alan, who's facing a divorce, and his son Jake, come to live with him. Together, these two and a half men confront the challenges of growing up; finally. Complicating matters are the brothers' self-obsessed, controlling mother, Evelyn, Alan's estranged wife, Judith and Charlie's crazy neighbor Rose, who wants to be a part of his life and is willing to do anything to be around. After the death of his brother, Alan Harper meets and befriends a lonely young man named Walden Schmidt who turns out to be a billionaire. Unable to afford his brother's home, Alan sells Walden the house, and as a way of showing his gratitude, Walden allows Alan and his son Jake to move in with him. (Two and a Half Men). [12+]. Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Modern Family.
programme.desc: Summer vacations take the Dunphys to New York; Mitch, Cam and Lily to the Midwest; and Jay, Gloria, Manny and Joe to Juarez, Mexico. Then the Pritchett-Dunphy-Tucker clan reunites in its eighth season premiere with all of the families converging at home for Father's Day. In subsequent episodes, as Claire struggles to keep order at the company with Jay back in the fold at Pritchett's Closets, Phil starts to enjoy more hobbies. Gloria's hot sauce business starts to pick up steam, while Mitch and Cam continue to see a parade of interesting guests in their upstairs rental unit, and also deal with their maturing tween, Lily. Meanwhile, Haley changes jobs and starts down a new entrepreneurial path, focusing on her career in an attempt to balance out her wobbly romantic life, and Alex learns to keep her life balanced at Caltech, including dealing with a considerable bout of mononucleosis. Manny and Luke fumble through their freedom-filled senior year of high school but feel the pressure of college approaching, complete with a joint college visit. Halloween and New Year's Eve episodes will punctuate a season that continues to watch this wonderfully large and blended family evolve, giving us an honest and often hilarious look into the warm and sometimes twisted embrace of the modern family. (Modern Family). [12+]. Dramos. Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Modern Family.
programme.desc: The focus is on three families who are related: Jay and his young wife Gloria, with their son Manny. Claire, the daughter of Jay from a previous marriage, and her family; husband, Phil, and children, Hayley, Alex, and Luke. Then the third family, which compromises of Mitchell, Jay's other son and Claire's brother, and his family; Cameron, his husband, and their adopted child, Lily. All members of this diverse family have their own character quirks, which combine to create hilarious scenarios around family life. The show first aired in 2009, and has watched the characters grow through the years, addressing all the dramas that come with this. It does so in a light-hearted humorous way, with some heart-touching moments along the way. The series has won multiple awards, including "Outstanding Comedy Series" in 2014. (Modern Family). [12+]. programme.title: Married ... with Children.
programme.desc: This Fox comedy broke the mold of unbelievably selfless family characters which had become the norm in American sitcoms of the 1980's. Al Bundy, shoe salesman, fears the frequent amorous advances of his ditsy wife Peggy, who henpecks him and frivolously spends all of his money, reliving his 4 touchdowns in a single game at high school. Supporting characters include their two shallow, self-serving teenage children Kelly and Bud, as well as nosy neighbor Marcy and her husband. (Married with Children). [12+]. Komedijos.

Tuomet jie sužino, kad dėl deguonies kiekio ir energijos naudojimo jam neužtenka vietos, tačiau tuomet kažkas turi pasiaukoti arba jį nužudyti, kad tęstų kelionę ir išgyventų. programme.title: Boso lygis.
programme.desc: Buvusiam specialiųjų pajėgų kariui Frenkui išaušo nekokia diena - nė nespėjęs papusryčiauti jis priverstas nudėti keletą samdomų žudikų, siųstų nužudyti jį. Toks rytas vyrukui jau tapęs kone rutina - patekęs į laiko kilpą jis kasdien doroja eilę jį medžiojančių galvažudžių, o pralaimėjus kovą - miršta ir diena prasideda iš naujo. Siekdamas galų gale pabėgti iš nesibaigiančio mirčių ir žmogžudysčių rato, Frenkas privalo pasiekti pagrindinį mirtino žaidimo bosą - tai vienintelis būdas apsaugoti savo šeimą bei sužinoti kas ir kodėl medžioja jį. (Boss Level). [18+]. Mistika. Trileriai. Veiksmo. Nuotykių.

programme.title: Avarinis nusileidimas.
programme.desc: Pilotas Brodis Torensas (akt. Gerardas Butleris) - patyręs ir užsigrūdinęs lakūnas, tad nieko nuostabaus, kad FTB prireikus pergabenti nusikaltėlį, jį nusprendžiama skraidinti būtent Torenso reisu. Luji Gasparas (akt. Mike'as Colteris) yra nuteistas už žmogžudystę, tačiau jo tikroji istorija kur kas spalvingesnė. Skrendant virš Filipinų, Torenso lėktuvas pakliūna į didžiulę audrą ir yra priverstas leistis avariniu būdu. Piloto meistriškumas leidžia nutupdyti lėktuvą, bet netrukus paaiškėja, kad didžiausi pavojai jų laukia būtent ant žemės. Originalus pavadinimas "Plane". (Plane). [16+]. Trileriai. Veiksmo. Nuotykių.

programme.title: Džonas Vikas.
programme.desc: Keanu Reeves'o vaidinamas Džonas Vikas gyvena paprastą ir tylų gyvenimą. Vienišas jo dienas praskaidrina mielo šunelio draugija ir pasivažinėjimai kolekciniu "Mustangu". Vieną iš tokių dienų, sustojus pasipildyti degalų atokioje degalinėje, Džono automobilis patraukia nelabai garbingų vyrukų dėmesį. Į vieno iš jų klausimą "kiek kainuoja?" atsakęs - "neparduodama", Džonas padaro klaidą. Svetimo gero užsigeidusi gauja paseka Džoną iki namų ir, sulaukę nakties, įsibrauna vidun. Sumušę šeimininką ir pasiėmę automobilio raktelius, chuliganai tuo nepasitenkina - demonstruodami savo galią, jie dar užmuša ir mylimą Džono šunį, dovanotą jam mirštančios žmonos. Atvarę mašiną savo bosui, išdidūs ir besidžiaugiantys savo sėkme vyrukai netrukus sužino, kad prie atokios degalinės klaidą padarė ne nepažįstamasis su "Mustangu", atsisakęs parduoti mašiną, o jie patys. Dar didesnė klaida buvo įsibrauti į nepažįstamojo namus, o užvis didžiausia (ir kvailiausia) iš klaidų buvo šuns pribaigimas. Situacijoje nesigaudantiems savo "torpedoms" bosas paaiškina (kumščių pagalba taip pat), kad jie užkabino ne šiaip eilinį vyruką, o legendinį žudiką Džoną Viką. Bosas nerimauja ne be reikalo. Atsitiktinių nusikaltėlių įžūlumo įsiutintas Džonas iš slėptuvės išsitraukia seniai praėjusių dienų darbo įrankius ir išsirengia į karo žygį. Sulig kiekvienu šūviu vis labiau artėdamas prie savo šuns žudikų, Džonas nesustos prieš jokią kliūtį. Nelaimingieji automobilio vagys netrukus suvokia, kad nuo Džono Viko įniršio jų niekas neapsaugos. (John Wick). Kriminalai. Trileriai. Veiksmo.

programme.title: Džonas Vikas.
programme.desc: Keanu Reeves'o vaidinamas Džonas Vikas gyvena paprastą ir tylų gyvenimą. Vienišas jo dienas praskaidrina mielo šunelio draugija ir pasivažinėjimai kolekciniu "Mustangu". Vieną iš tokių dienų, sustojus pasipildyti degalų atokioje degalinėje, Džono automobilis patraukia nelabai garbingų vyrukų dėmesį. Į vieno iš jų klausimą "kiek kainuoja?" atsakęs - "neparduodama", Džonas padaro klaidą. Svetimo gero užsigeidusi gauja paseka Džoną iki namų ir, sulaukę nakties, įsibrauna vidun. Sumušę šeimininką ir pasiėmę automobilio raktelius, chuliganai tuo nepasitenkina - demonstruodami savo galią, jie dar užmuša ir mylimą Džono šunį, dovanotą jam mirštančios žmonos. Atvarę mašiną savo bosui, išdidūs ir besidžiaugiantys savo sėkme vyrukai netrukus sužino, kad prie atokios degalinės klaidą padarė ne nepažįstamasis su "Mustangu", atsisakęs parduoti mašiną, o jie patys. Dar didesnė klaida buvo įsibrauti į nepažįstamojo namus, o užvis didžiausia (ir kvailiausia) iš klaidų buvo šuns pribaigimas. Situacijoje nesigaudantiems savo "torpedoms" bosas paaiškina (kumščių pagalba taip pat), kad jie užkabino ne šiaip eilinį vyruką, o legendinį žudiką Džoną Viką. Bosas nerimauja ne be reikalo. programme.title: Ant ribos.
programme.desc: Gyvenimas yra pavojingas, nenuspėjamas ir negailestingas. Jeigu dar vakar dirbai policininku, tai šiandien gali tapti teisėsaugos pareigūnų ieškomiausiu bėgliu. Nikas Kesidis (Samas Worthingtonas, Įsikūnijimas , Terminatorius. Išsigelbėjimas , Titanų susidūrimas ) jaučiasi absoliučiai nekaltu dėl jam inkriminuojamo nusikaltimo. Bet byla yra nugrimzdusi į gilius korupcijos liūnus, kad išduotam vyrui nebelieka kitos išeities įrodyti savo tiesą. Vieną saulėtą rytą jis atidarys viešbučio Roosevelt kambario langą ūžiančiame Manhetene, išlips ant dangoraižio briaunos ir rimtu ketinimu nušokti žemyn tikėsis atkreipti dėmesį žmonių, kurie sutrypė ir sužlugdė jo reputaciją, apkaltino prabangaus deimanto vagyste ir uždarė į kalėjimą. Nikas pasinaudoja išėjimu į laisvę vienai dienai dėl tėvo laidotuvių, bet vakare negrįžta atgal ir nusprendžia sprukti. Jis nieko nebijo ir neturi ko prarasti. Beveik viską, ką Nikas sukaupė ir pasiekė, jau pasigrobė nesąžiningi priešai. Tačiau tie godūs žmonės nesustabdė Niko užsispyrimo mąstyti ir neįvertino gebėjimo suregzti gudrų planą. Savižudis sąmoningai pareikalauja Niujorko policijos departamento iškviesti į karštąjį kambarį ne pačios geriausios reputacijos derybininkę Lidiją Merser (aktorė Elizabeth Banks, Trys įtemptos dienos , W. , trilogija Žmogus-voras ), kurios prižiūrimas jaunuolis vis dėlto neišgirdo psichologinių patarimų ir nušoko nuo tilto. Bendraudamas su dailia moterimi, Nikas siekia laimėti laiko, atkeršyti nedoram nekilnojamojo turto magnatui Davidui Englanderiui (aktorius Edas Harris, Trumeno šou , Priešas prie vartų , Kodas L.O.B.I.A.I. , Nuostabus protas , ) ir nuvilioti milijonieriaus verslininko budrumą nuo brolio Džojaus (aktorius Jamie Bellas, Pasipriešinimas , Šoklys ) veiksmų. Broliai ketina įvykdyti vagystę, už kurią Nikas jau nuteistas 25 metams. Jų planas paprastas - įrodyti, kad teismuose nagrinėtas nusikaltimas dar nebuvo padarytas. Bent jau iki šiol. Ne viskas yra taip, kaip atrodo iš pirmo žvilgsnio! (Man on a Ledge). [14+]. Nuotykių. Kriminalai. Veiksmo. Trileriai.

programme.title: Džonas Vikas 2.
programme.desc: Prieš pusantrų metų stilingame keršto trileryje Keanu Reeves'o vaidinamas Džonas Vikas nesusivaldė, chuliganams pavogus jo vintažinį "Mustangą" ir užmušus velionės žmonos dovanotą mylimą šunį. Sutvarkęs reikalus, Džonas tenorėjo vieno: kad jam leistų ramiai gyventi toliau. Tačiau žmogui su tokiais gebėjimais ramiai gyventi tiesiog nelemta. Audringa, tamsi ir pavojinga samdomo žudiko Džono Viko praeitis sugrįžta. (John Wick 2). [12+]. Kriminalai. Veiksmo. Trileriai.

programme.desc: Curtis LaForche gyvena mažame Ohajo miestelyje su savo žmona Samantha ir šešerių metukų kurčia dukryte Hannah. programme.title: Kolumbiana.
programme.desc: Katalėja Restrepo laimingai leidžia savo vaikystę saulėtoje Bogotoje. Deja, mergaitės laukia kraupus likimo smūgis: žiauriai nužudomi abu jos tėvai. Ketė, tuo metu sulaukusi vos dešimties metų, tampa pagrindine klaikaus įvykio liudininke. Per laimingą atsitiktinumą mergaitė išvengia savo tėvų likimo ir pabėgusi randa prieglobstį savo dėdės namuose. Vaikystės košmarų ir keršto troškimo persekiojama Ketė užaugusi tampa šaltakrauje profesionalia žudike. Mergina nė dienos nesiliovė narplioti painios savo tėvų nužudymo istorijos. Jos tikslas - rasti žudikus. Visi pėdsakai heroję veda link Kolumbijos narkotikų barono Dono Lusijaus. Bene vienintelis siūlas, rišantis merginos gyvenimą su įprastų žmonių pasauliu, - jos mylimas vaikinas, kuris nė neįtaria, kuo iš tiesų užsiima jo draugė. (Colombiana). Veiksmo. Trileriai. Dramos. Kriminalai. Nuotykių.

programme.title: Džonas Vikas 3.
programme.desc: Antroje serijos dalyje, atkeršijęs jį apgavusiam Italijos mafijos bosui Santinui, Džonas Vikas patenka į nepavydėtiną padėtį. Nužudęs Santiną viešbutyje "Continental", teikiančiame nusikaltėliams absoliutų prieglobstį, Džonas pažeidžia vieną svarbiausių samdomų žudikų bendrijos įsakų. Viešbučio valdytojas Vinstonas neturi kitos išeities, kaip paskelbti atlygį už paties Džono Viko galvą. 14 milijonų dolerių - riebus kąsnelis net ir geriausiai besiverčiantiems nusikaltėliams, tad prabėgus valandai, kurią jam davė Vinstonas, Džoną ims medžioti daugybė aukščiausio kalibro samdomų žudikų. (John Wick: Chapter 3 - Parabellum). Trileriai. Veiksmo. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Romi ir Mišelė bendraklasių susitikime.
programme.desc: Dvi neišskiriamos, tačiau ne itin sumanios draugės vyksta į dešimties metų mokyklos baigimo susitikimą ir sukuria sudėtingą melą apie savo gyvenimus, kad padarytų įspūdį buvusiems bendraklasiams. (Romy and Michele's High School Reunion). [12+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: Kolumbiana.
programme.desc: Katalėja Restrepo laimingai leidžia savo vaikystę saulėtoje Bogotoje. Deja, mergaitės laukia kraupus likimo smūgis: žiauriai nužudomi abu jos tėvai. Ketė, tuo metu sulaukusi vos dešimties metų, tampa pagrindine klaikaus įvykio liudininke. Per laimingą atsitiktinumą mergaitė išvengia savo tėvų likimo ir pabėgusi randa prieglobstį savo dėdės namuose. Vaikystės košmarų ir keršto troškimo persekiojama Ketė užaugusi tampa šaltakrauje profesionalia žudike. Mergina nė dienos nesiliovė narplioti painios savo tėvų nužudymo istorijos. Jos tikslas - rasti žudikus. Visi pėdsakai heroję veda link Kolumbijos narkotikų barono Dono Lusijaus. Bene vienintelis siūlas, rišantis merginos gyvenimą su įprastų žmonių pasauliu, - jos mylimas vaikinas, kuris nė neįtaria, kuo iš tiesų užsiima jo draugė. (Colombiana). Nuotykių. Trileriai. Dramos. Kriminalai. Veiksmo.

programme.title: Džonas Vikas 3.
programme.desc: Antroje serijos dalyje, atkeršijęs jį apgavusiam Italijos mafijos bosui Santinui, Džonas Vikas patenka į nepavydėtiną padėtį. Nužudęs Santiną viešbutyje "Continental", teikiančiame nusikaltėliams absoliutų prieglobstį, Džonas pažeidžia vieną svarbiausių samdomų žudikų bendrijos įsakų. Viešbučio valdytojas Vinstonas neturi kitos išeities, kaip paskelbti atlygį už paties Džono Viko galvą. 14 milijonų dolerių - riebus kąsnelis net ir geriausiai besiverčiantiems nusikaltėliams, tad prabėgus valandai, kurią jam davė Vinstonas, Džoną ims medžioti daugybė aukščiausio kalibro samdomų žudikų. (John Wick: Chapter 3 - Parabellum). Veiksmo. Kriminalai. Trileriai.

programme.title: Sachara.
programme.desc: Šiaurės Afrikoje pasklinda naujas pragaištingas virusas. Jis stumia vietinius gyventojus į beprotybę ir kanibalizmą. Ištirti siaubingą virusą pasiunčiama daktarė Eva Rochas. Tyrimai parodo, kad šios ligos priežastimi tapo didelio masto ekologinis užterštumas. O blogiausia tai, kad užterštas plotas sparčiai plečiasi. Daktarei Evai prieš akis atsiveria liūdna perspektyva - jei nebus imtasi atitinkamų priemonių, Žemei gresia ekologinė katastrofa, kurios padarinius sunku net įsivaizduoti. (Sahara). [12+]. Komedijos. Nuotykių. Veiksmo.

programme.title: Džonas Vikas 4.
programme.desc: Tironiškasis Aukštasis stalas pasmerkė Džoną slapstytis ir bėgti nuo žudikų. Tačiau ypatingi Džono sugebėjimai į šipulius sudaužė Aukščiausiosios samdomų žudikų Tarybos planą skirti 14 milijonų dolerių premiją už Viko pašalinimą ir taip juo atsikratyti. Taryba akivaizdžiai ima nekantrauti ir imasi kito plano. Džonui teks susiremti su galingiausiais nusikaltėlių aljansais pasaulyje. Jėgomis, kurios senus draugus akimirksniu gali paversti priešais. Keršto ir sielvarto kurstoma Džono kelionė atveda jį tiesiai pas buvusius užsakovus, nusikaltimų meistrus, privertusius jį iškeliauti į amžiną tremtį. Dabar visagaliai Viko priešai susitelks, kad šį karta nušluotų jį nuo žemės paviršiaus. Ar jiems pavyks? Ar kovoje už laisvę bus padėtas taškas? (John Wick: Chapter 4). Trileriai. Veiksmo. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Pragaras rojuje.
programme.desc: Henris (aktorius Ewanas McGregoras) su žmona gydytoja Marija (aktorė Naomi Watts) bei trejais sūnumis atostogų atvyksta į Tailando Kao Lako kurortą ir pasijunta lyg patekę į rojų Žemėje: auksaspalviai smėlio paplūdimiai, skaidriai permatomas Indijos vandenyno vanduo, menkiausio debesėlio neįsileidžiantis mėlynas dangus, naktimis ryškiai tviskančios žvaiždės ir prabangūs, visus įgeidžius pildantys viešbučiai. Tačiau nuostabios ramybės idilę akimirksniu sugriauna atsiritusios milžiniškos Žemės drebėjimo Indonezijoje sukeltos vandenyno bangos, akimirksniu sužalojusios ir be žinios pradanginusios daugybę žmonių. Nevaldomai šėlstanti stichija išskiria ir Henrio bei Marijos šeimą. Sunkiai sužeista Marija pirmiausiai atranda vyriausiąjį sūnų Luką. Bandydama ką nors sužinoti apie kitus savo šeimos narius, ji neatsisako padėti dar labiau nukentėjusiems turistams ir kurorto gyventojams. Tuo tarpu per stebuklą išsigelbėjęs Henris desperatiškai ieško mylimos žmonos bei vaikų, nekreipdamas dėmesio į paniką provokuojantį chaosą bei įspėjimus apie prognozuojamą antrąją cunamio ataką. (The Impossible). [12+]. Dramos. Trileriai.

programme.title: Džekė Braun.
programme.desc: Džeki Braun, lėktuvo stiuardesė, pagaunama nelegaliai gabenanti pinigus, gautus už prekybą ginklais. Rėjus Nikoletas ir Markas Dargusas, stovintys įstatymo pusėje, pasiūlo jau bendradarbiauti, padedant sučiupti ginklų tiekėją Ordelį, kuriam mergina dirba. Merginai tenka rinktis, ar padėti teisėsaugininkams ir tapti laisva, rizikuojant savo galva, jei Ordelis sužinotų apie susitarimą, ar tylėti ir sėsti už grotų. Tačiau mergina pasirenka trečią variantą - apmauti tiek policininkus, tiek savo bosą ir pasprukti į laisvę su visais pinigais... (Jackie Brown). [16+]. Dramos. Trileriai. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Sumautos atostogos Meksikoje.
programme.desc: Holivudo superherojus Melas Gibsonas šiam filmui parašė svajonių scenarijų ir savo lėšomis finansavo veiksmo trilerį be jokių taisyklių ir pataikavimų cenzūrai. "Mirtino ginklo" žvaigždė nuotykius Meksikos kalėjime papasakojo šmaikščiai, netikėtai, ironiškai ir įpynė ne vieną tikrą faktą. Jo herojus neturi gėdos ir sąžinės, tad ramiai uždarbiauja atlikdamas juodus ir nešvarius darbelius. Prisidengdamas cirko klounu jis sumoja nelegaliai pervežti 2 mln. JAV dolerių per JAV ir Meksikos valstybinę sieną. Bet nuo galvos iki kojų korumpuoti pasienio pareigūnai šio juokelio nesuprato. Vietoj išvajotų atostogų prabangiame Kankūno viešbutyje vyrukui teks pailsėti meksikietiškame kalėjime. (Get the Gringo). Veiksmo. Trileriai. Dramos. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Grėsmingasis aštuonetas.
programme.desc: Po Pilietinio karo prabėgus keliams metams, vaizdingoje Vajomingo kalnų papėdėje siaučia galinga pūga. Žvarbus vėjas ir užpustyti keliai įvairaus plauko prašalaičius, keliaujančius į Red Roko miestelį, suburia diližanų stotelėje - vienintele užuovėja nuo gamtos šėlionių tapusioje smuklėje. Į ją užklysta premijų medžiotojas Johnas su savo grobiu - žudike Deize, kurios vos pasibaigus pūgai laukia teisingumas - virvė ant kaklo. (The Hateful Eight). [18+]. Mistika. Trileriai. Dramos. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Aš esu legenda.
programme.desc: Mokslininkas Robertas Nevilas (akt. Will Smith) nesėkmingai bandė sustabdyti dirbtinai sukurtą virusą, užkrėtusį visus planetos gyventojus, tačiau pats dėl nepaaiškinamų priežasčių liko neužkrėstas. Niujorkas, kuriame jis gyvena, virto kraugerių mutantų miestu. Jau trejus metus jo gatvėmis besiblaškančios būtybės bijo saulės šviesos ir desperatiškai ieško paskutiniųjų sveikų žmonių. Robertas – vienas kaip pirštas. Tiesa, jo kasdienybę skaidrina vokiečių aviganių veislės kalytė Samanta. Dienomis vyras naršo Niujorko gatves, ieškodamas maisto ir siųsdamas desperatiškus pranešimus radijo bangomis, o naktimis eksperimentuoja su kraujo mėginiais, bandydamas įveikti virusą. Tačiau laikas – jo priešas, mat infekuotieji atidžiai stebi kiekvieną jo žingsnį ir laukia tinkamo momento, kuomet galės priimti Robertą į savo gretas. (I Am Legend). Nuotykių. Dramos. Trileriai. Veiksmo. Siaubo.

programme.title: Sumautos atostogos Meksikoje.
programme.desc: Holivudo superherojus Melas Gibsonas šiam filmui parašė svajonių scenarijų ir savo lėšomis finansavo veiksmo trilerį be jokių taisyklių ir pataikavimų cenzūrai. "Mirtino ginklo" žvaigždė nuotykius Meksikos kalėjime papasakojo šmaikščiai, netikėtai, ironiškai ir įpynė ne vieną tikrą faktą. Jo herojus neturi gėdos ir sąžinės, tad ramiai uždarbiauja atlikdamas juodus ir nešvarius darbelius. Prisidengdamas cirko klounu jis sumoja nelegaliai pervežti 2 mln.
