programme.title: Возвращение Мухтара.
programme.desc: Приключения сплоченной команды сотрудников милиции и служебного пса Мухтара продолжаются. Оперативники Максим Жаров и Алексей Самойлов, следователь Василиса Михайлова и их четвероногий друг сталкиваются с самыми разными преступлениями. Чаще всего главную роль в расследованиях играет именно мохнатый страж порядка. Работа у Мухтара непростая, и его главная задача — найти и обезвредить! Помимо того, что Муха — настоящий профессионал, он еще и верный помощник, настоящий друг, готовый всегда прийти на выручку. Он — душа команды. Именно благодаря его уникальным способностям — исключительному обонянию, "шестому чувству", моментальной реакции и преданности хозяину — команде детективов удается справляться с любыми делами — и рядовыми, и повышенной сложности! (Возвращение Мухтара). [16+]. Nuotykių. Veiksmo. Mistika. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Агенты справедливости.
programme.desc: Шестой сезон украинского детективного сериала \"Агенты справедливости\" повышает градус интриги тех дел, с которыми приходится работать журналисту Вадиму Зорину и детективу Наталье Дзюбейко. В расследований запутанных преступлений героям помогает целая команда специалистов высочайшей квалификации, в числе психолог, криминалист, судмедэксперт, баллистик, юрист и другие профессионалы. В этом сезоне бюро поджидают дела, требующие использования самых передовых технологий. Впрочем, работа работой, а центральные лица сериала не забывают и о личной жизни. Вадим делает предложение Наталье, но перед самой свадьбой происходит беда: некие таинственные злоумышленники похищают Карину - девочку, о которой детективы заботились, как о родной дочери. Поиски Карины оборачиваются неожиданными осложнениям, которые нарушают слаженность работы агентов. Внезапно оказывается, что угроза исходит не только от могущественных противников, но и от внутренних противоречий. (Агенти справедливості). [16+]. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Пёс.
programme.desc: Макс — алкоголик. Когда-то лучший сыщик в городе, Макс потерял все — работу, друзей, жену. У него остался единственный друг — Пес. После серии погонь, драк и перестрелок, Пес и Макс раскрыли тайну загадочного убийства. Макс с Псом снова стали детективами. Теперь каждый день начинается с того, что Пес и Макс пытаются выяснить, кто совершил преступление… И выяснить — кто из них лучший сыщик в городе! (Pios). [16+]. Dramos. Kriminalai.

programme.desc: Федеральная экспертная служба занимается расследованием самых запутанных дел. К помощи экспертов обращаются различные государственные структуры, будь то полиция или следственный комитет. Служба имеет целый штат профессионалов своего дела – тут и криминалисты, и баллистики, и патологоанатомы, и программисты. Кроме того, каждый кабинет оборудован по последнему слову техники. Парк автомобилей представлен лучшими моделями отечественного и иностранного производства. На этот раз ребятам предстоит столкнуться с серийным убийцей. Он хитер, расчетлив, и каждый раз ему удается бежать от наказания. Однако за дело берутся лучшие специалисты в своем деле, и на этот раз ему не скрыться. Улики собраны, осталось только навестить преступника. проверенным товарищам, и скоро ему понадобится их помощь и поддержка… (След). [16+]. Mistika. Dramos. Kriminalai. Trileriai.

programme.title: 90 Day Fiance.
programme.desc: Buckle up, TLC and 90 Day Fiancé fans! Hot off their upcoming appearance on 90 DAY FIANCÉ: HAPPILY EVER AFTER?, fan-favorites Pedro and Chantel and their lively in-laws will be the focal point of a spinoff series from the 90 DAY FIANCÉ franchise called THE FAMILY CHANTEL, premiering Monday nights this July. Ever since Chantel first introduced Pedro to her family under the false pretense of him coming to America on a student visa, the drama that followed has kept fans obsessed. From their beginnings on 90 DAY FIANCÉ season four through 90 DAY FIANCÉ: HAPPILY EVER AFTER, Pedro and Chantel have weathered major marital ups and downs involving everything from feisty family members to their own trust issues. Viewers will follow this unique modern family as they try to move past their differences and come together as an extended family, but as Chantel's parents Karen and Thomas try to protect their brood, will they push their children too far? The family members featured in the upcoming series include Chantel's parents Karen and Thomas and siblings River and Winter, as well as Pedro's mother Lidia and sister Nicole. (90 Day Fiancé).

programme.title: Sister Wives.
programme.desc: Kody Brown, with his four wives Meri, Janelle, Robyn and Christine and their combined 17 children, attempt to navigate life as a "normal" family in a society that shuns their lifestyle. From their unconventional family structure and living arrangements to financial challenges, each half hour episode exposes the inner workings of a polygamist household, revealing the unexpectedly tight-knit and loving relationships between Kody's wives. The series also captures the intense dynamics surrounding a man juggling three wives while attempting to keep it a secret from the outside world- but the general public is not the only challenge that the Brown family unit is facing. (Sister Wives).

programme.title: Forbidden Love.
programme.desc: Ashley finally confronts Mohammed's twin brother. Kris's dad pushes Lensa too far. Lindsey and Elmer head into Amish country to reconcile with his family but when word gets out, things take a turn for the worse. (Forbidden Love). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: Welcome To Plathville.
programme.desc: Welcome To Plathville is an American reality series following husband and wife Kim and Barry Plath, and their nine children; Ethan, Hosanna, Micah, Moriah, Lydia, Isaac, Amber, Cassia, and Mercy. Apart from Ethan and Hosanna, who live with their respective spouses, the family reside on a rural farm in Georgia, where the children must abide by Kim and Barry's conservative rules. No sugar, no television, no non-religious music and no video games, the children must follow their parents' strict guidelines, as family life centres around music and God. We follow the family through their daily routines, revealing all the drama that ensues with having so many children. (Welcome To Plathville). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: Neighborhood Watch.
programme.desc: When surprises happen, not everyone remains calm, cool, and collected. But no need to panic, it's just another day in the neighbourhood. (Neighborhood Watch). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: Neighborhood Watch.
programme.desc: From good luck to bad decisions, these are moments that made people wonder: Did that really just happen? (Neighborhood Watch). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: Kitchen Boss.
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. Each meal usually consists of a main course, a side dish and a dessert and Buddy is joined in the kitchen by members of his family to show us how it's done and to add authenticity. Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. The recipe for each dish can be found on the show's website. (Kitchen Boss). Maisto gamyba.

programme.title: 90 Day Fiance: The Other Way.
programme.desc: In a spin off of the US series 90 Day Fiance, Americans move to foreign countries to pursue romances and get married. In the original show, partners move into the US on a K-1 visa and have 90 days to settle before the wedding due to the visa process. This spin off sees US citizens applying for their own visas abroad, experiencing culture shocks and leaving behind their entire families for their fiance. These engagements aren't without drama, secrets and lies come to light and relationships are tested to the extreme. Will these Americans find happiness and love abroad, or will they be booking a flight back home? (The 90 Day Fiance: The Other Way). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: 7 Little Johnstons.
programme.desc: Amber and Trent Johnston are living the American dream. They have been happily married for 14 years and have five children ranging from 6 to 13 years old. On paper, they might seem like your average family...yet in person, they attract a lot of attention.... because all seven members of the Johnston family – Amber, Trent, their two biological children, Jonah and Elizabeth, as well as their three adopted children, Anna, Emma and Alex – happen to have Achondroplasia Dwarfism. Together, these spunky seven make up the largest known family of Achondroplastic dwarfs in the world, and even describe themselves as "the real life seven dwarfs." (7 Little Johnstons).

programme.title: Down Home Fab.
programme.desc: A local romance author and her husband love to host parties in their backyard oasis, but their indoor space is cramped, dark, and gloomy. programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper.
programme.desc: Definitely not created for the squeamish, Dr Pimple Popper features dermatologist and Internet celebrity Dr. Sandra Lee as she treats patients suffering with unique skin conditions such as facial and skin disorders. Including the extraction of blackheads, cysts and uncovering new skin conditions that audiences may not have known of before, Dr. Sandra Lee started uploading content onto Youtube and Instagram, gaining a lot of popularity by people enjoying spots and cysts being popped. Those included within her videos gave written permission for her to record and post the content in exchange for discounted or free-treatments. Dr. Pimple Popper is on a mission to reclaim the lives of those suffering with these unusual and rare skin condition and remove their embarrassment. (Dr. Pimple Popper).

programme.title: Body Bizarre.
programme.desc: Criss-crossing the globe, 'Body Bizarre' embarks on a voyage of discovery unlike any other. From India's child snake charmers to the world's hairiest girl, this series uncovers the real human stories behind the headlines. With deeply personal interviews and footage from the most unusual of day-to-day routines, it's an adventure through the truly astonishing. Six-year-old Liu Jiangli was abandoned by her parents as a two-year-old after being born with large black spots and fur on her face and body. Connie Culp became the first American to undergo a face transplant in 2008, after being shot in the face by her ex-husband. These stories, and others, explore what life is like for some of the world's most extraordinary individuals. (Body Bizarre). [12+]. Sveikata.

He accused her of defamation, but also of trying to take over creative direction of the film. Now, a trial has been set for March of 2026. programme.title: 90 Day Fiance.
programme.desc: Buckle up, TLC and 90 Day Fiancé fans! Hot off their upcoming appearance on 90 DAY FIANCÉ: HAPPILY EVER AFTER?, fan-favorites Pedro and Chantel and their lively in-laws will be the focal point of a spinoff series from the 90 DAY FIANCÉ franchise called THE FAMILY CHANTEL, premiering Monday nights this July. Ever since Chantel first introduced Pedro to her family under the false pretense of him coming to America on a student visa, the drama that followed has kept fans obsessed. From their beginnings on 90 DAY FIANCÉ season four through 90 DAY FIANCÉ: HAPPILY EVER AFTER, Pedro and Chantel have weathered major marital ups and downs involving everything from feisty family members to their own trust issues. Viewers will follow this unique modern family as they try to move past their differences and come together as an extended family, but as Chantel's parents Karen and Thomas try to protect their brood, will they push their children too far? The family members featured in the upcoming series include Chantel's parents Karen and Thomas and siblings River and Winter, as well as Pedro's mother Lidia and sister Nicole. (90 Day Fiancé).

programme.title: Sister Wives.
programme.desc: Kody Brown, with his four wives Meri, Janelle, Robyn and Christine and their combined 17 children, attempt to navigate life as a "normal" family in a society that shuns their lifestyle. From their unconventional family structure and living arrangements to financial challenges, each half hour episode exposes the inner workings of a polygamist household, revealing the unexpectedly tight-knit and loving relationships between Kody's wives. The series also captures the intense dynamics surrounding a man juggling three wives while attempting to keep it a secret from the outside world- but the general public is not the only challenge that the Brown family unit is facing. (Sister Wives).

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper.
programme.desc: Definitely not created for the squeamish, Dr Pimple Popper features dermatologist and Internet celebrity Dr. Sandra Lee as she treats patients suffering with unique skin conditions such as facial and skin disorders. Including the extraction of blackheads, cysts and uncovering new skin conditions that audiences may not have known of before, Dr. Sandra Lee started uploading content onto Youtube and Instagram, gaining a lot of popularity by people enjoying spots and cysts being popped. Those included within her videos gave written permission for her to record and post the content in exchange for discounted or free-treatments. Dr. Pimple Popper is on a mission to reclaim the lives of those suffering with these unusual and rare skin condition and remove their embarrassment. (Dr. Pimple Popper).

programme.title: Body Bizarre.
programme.desc: Criss-crossing the globe, 'Body Bizarre' embarks on a voyage of discovery unlike any other. From India's child snake charmers to the world's hairiest girl, this series uncovers the real human stories behind the headlines. With deeply personal interviews and footage from the most unusual of day-to-day routines, it's an adventure through the truly astonishing. Six-year-old Liu Jiangli was abandoned by her parents as a two-year-old after being born with large black spots and fur on her face and body. Connie Culp became the first American to undergo a face transplant in 2008, after being shot in the face by her ex-husband. These stories, and others, explore what life is like for some of the world's most extraordinary individuals. (Body Bizarre). [12+]. Sveikata.

programme.title: Kitchen Boss.
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. Each meal usually consists of a main course, a side dish and a dessert and Buddy is joined in the kitchen by members of his family to show us how it's done and to add authenticity. Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. The recipe for each dish can be found on the show's website. (Kitchen Boss). Maisto gamyba.

programme.title: MILF Manor.
programme.desc: Although they may be a few years older than the average dating show contestant, these women are not out of practice. Ranging from 40 to 60 years young, this vibrant group brings their unique life experiences to the game. They have decades of dating experience and will use it to find a lasting connection with men half their age. However, nothing can prepare them for a jaw dropping surprise that will greet them at the front door. (MILF Manor). [12+].

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper.
programme.desc: Definitely not created for the squeamish, Dr Pimple Popper features dermatologist and Internet celebrity Dr. Sandra Lee as she treats patients suffering with unique skin conditions such as facial and skin disorders. Including the extraction of blackheads, cysts and uncovering new skin conditions that audiences may not have known of before, Dr. Sandra Lee started uploading content onto Youtube and Instagram, gaining a lot of popularity by people enjoying spots and cysts being popped. Those included within her videos gave written permission for her to record and post the content in exchange for discounted or free-treatments. Dr. Pimple Popper is on a mission to reclaim the lives of those suffering with these unusual and rare skin condition and remove their embarrassment. (Dr. Pimple Popper).

programme.title: Body Bizarre.
programme.desc: Criss-crossing the globe, 'Body Bizarre' embarks on a voyage of discovery unlike any other. From India's child snake charmers to the world's hairiest girl, this series uncovers the real human stories behind the headlines. With deeply personal interviews and footage from the most unusual of day-to-day routines, it's an adventure through the truly astonishing. Six-year-old Liu Jiangli was abandoned by her parents as a two-year-old after being born with large black spots and fur on her face and body. Connie Culp became the first American to undergo a face transplant in 2008, after being shot in the face by her ex-husband. These stories, and others, explore what life is like for some of the world's most extraordinary individuals. (Body Bizarre). [12+]. Sveikata.

programme.title: My 3000-lb Family.
programme.desc: Cousins Naomi, Drew and Chitoka nearly weigh a combined 2,000 pounds. With the help of Dr. Charles Procter Jr., the desperate cousins attempt to overcome anxieties and live healthier lives, and this series follows their progress. It begins with Naomi's mom, Beverly, undergoing weight-loss surgery, which she hopes will inspire her daughter, niece and nephew to follow her footsteps. Despite seeing the complications involved in her mom's recovery, Naomi is motivated by her dream to start a family. Drew, meanwhile, needs to realize how addictive his eating habits have become, and Chitoka – bed-bound for more than three years – must literally take steps forward before qualifying for surgery. (Family by the Ton).

programme.title: Sister Wives.

(Sister Wives).

programme.title: Say Yes To the Dress: Lancashire.
programme.desc: It's the dress that all little girls dream of, and one that most will only get chance to pick out once. A fairy tale occasion that has the ability to make dreams come true. It's also the source of tantrums, tears and arguments all wrapped up in tulle and satin with an intricate beading. A bride's journey to picking out that perfect wedding gown is a near military operation. Luckily, Gok Wan has joined the expert bridal consultants at Ava Rose Hamilton's Boutique in Lancashire to help an abundance of brides-to-be track down their dream dress. But, with budgets to consider, personal issues, dramas and the opinions of the entourage, will Gok be able to help these brides find their perfect gown? (Say Yes to the Dress: England).

programme.title: 7 Little Johnstons.
programme.desc: Amber and Trent Johnston are living the American dream. They have been happily married for 14 years and have five children ranging from 6 to 13 years old. Together, these spunky seven make up the largest known family of Achondroplastic dwarfs in the world, and even describe themselves as "the real life seven dwarfs." (7 Little Johnstons).

programme.title: Love Off the Grid.
programme.desc: Four city-dwellers leave the comforts of home for a chance at love in the wilderness. Beach-loving Jen gives up Botox and spa treatments for mountain man Charlie and part boy Josh must survive 120° temperatures in the Mojave to be with Angela. (Love Off the Grid).

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper.
programme.desc: Definitely not created for the squeamish, Dr Pimple Popper features dermatologist and Internet celebrity Dr. Sandra Lee as she treats patients suffering with unique skin conditions such as facial and skin disorders. Including the extraction of blackheads, cysts and uncovering new skin conditions that audiences may not have known of before, Dr. Sandra Lee started uploading content onto Youtube and Instagram, gaining a lot of popularity by people enjoying spots and cysts being popped. Those included within her videos gave written permission for her to record and post the content in exchange for discounted or free-treatments. Dr. Pimple Popper is on a mission to reclaim the lives of those suffering with these unusual and rare skin condition and remove their embarrassment. (Dr. Pimple Popper).

programme.title: Body Bizarre.
programme.desc: Criss-crossing the globe, 'Body Bizarre' embarks on a voyage of discovery unlike any other. From India's child snake charmers to the world's hairiest girl, this series uncovers the real human stories behind the headlines. With deeply personal interviews and footage from the most unusual of day-to-day routines, it's an adventure through the truly astonishing. Six-year-old Liu Jiangli was abandoned by her parents as a two-year-old after being born with large black spots and fur on her face and body. Connie Culp became the first American to undergo a face transplant in 2008, after being shot in the face by her ex-husband. These stories, and others, explore what life is like for some of the world's most extraordinary individuals. (Body Bizarre). [12+]. Sveikata.

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper.
programme.desc: Definitely not created for the squeamish, Dr Pimple Popper features dermatologist and Internet celebrity Dr. Sandra Lee as she treats patients suffering with unique skin conditions such as facial and skin disorders. Including the extraction of blackheads, cysts and uncovering new skin conditions that audiences may not have known of before, Dr. Sandra Lee started uploading content onto Youtube and Instagram, gaining a lot of popularity by people enjoying spots and cysts being popped. Those included within her videos gave written permission for her to record and post the content in exchange for discounted or free-treatments. Dr. Pimple Popper is on a mission to reclaim the lives of those suffering with these unusual and rare skin condition and remove their embarrassment. (Dr. Pimple Popper).

programme.title: Body Bizarre.
programme.desc: Criss-crossing the globe, 'Body Bizarre' embarks on a voyage of discovery unlike any other. From India's child snake charmers to the world's hairiest girl, this series uncovers the real human stories behind the headlines. With deeply personal interviews and footage from the most unusual of day-to-day routines, it's an adventure through the truly astonishing. Six-year-old Liu Jiangli was abandoned by her parents as a two-year-old after being born with large black spots and fur on her face and body. Connie Culp became the first American to undergo a face transplant in 2008, after being shot in the face by her ex-husband. These stories, and others, explore what life is like for some of the world's most extraordinary individuals. (Body Bizarre). [12+]. Sveikata.

programme.title: Most Terrifying Places.
programme.desc: Join our crew as they take us on a journey to investigate some of the scariest and most spine-chilling places on the planet. (Most Terrifying Places). [16+].

programme.title: Expedition Unknown.
programme.desc: Expedition Unknown chronicles the adventures of Josh Gates as he investigates iconic mysteries across the globe. Gates begins by interviewing key eyewitnesses and uncovering recent developments in the story, then springboards into a fully immersive exploration. This authentic, roughshod adventure leads Gates closer to the truth behind these unanswered global enigmas, such as the disappearance of Amelia Earhart's plane. Josh Gates is an adventurer and avid explorer with a unique brand of humor and passion for off-the-map excursions. (Expedition Unknown). Nuotykių.

programme.title: Finding Bigfoot.
programme.desc: From small towns in the South to remote areas of the Pacific Northwest and Alaska, four eccentric but passionate members of the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO) embark on one single-minded mission: to find the elusive "creature" known as Bigfoot or the Sasquatch. The team consists of Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO) founder and President Matt Moneymaker, researchers James "Bobo" Fay and Cliff Barackman and skeptical scientist Ranae Holland. The series never questions the existence of Bigfoot, but rather documents the team's search efforts and study of evidence in an attempt to prove the existence of the elusive creature. (Finding Bigfoot). Nuotykių.

programme.title: Edge of Alaska.
programme.desc: Hidden deep in the wilderness of eastern Alaska and built during the Gold Rush as Alaska's original 'Sin City', only 42 residents currently brave the extreme conditions in McCarthy. It's an isolated outlaw town - a refuge for people who don't want to be found that's surrounded by extreme wilderness over 100 miles from the authorities where young men go to prove themselves and old outlaws go to die; hunters, gold miners, gunsmiths, and survivalists who reside in this 'Old West' town are willing to risk their lives to live truly free. While some believe in continuing the town's frontier way of life, others feel the future of McCarthy depends on dragging itself into the modern age. Which way of life will reign supreme? (Edge of Alaska). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: Cooper's Treasure.
programme.desc: Considered one of NASA's original space pioneers, astronaut Gordon Cooper discovered something extraordinary on a 1963 mission. While circling Earth during a 122-hour flight to detect nuclear sites, Cooper photographed more than 100 anomalies around the South Caribbean. He later believed the dark patches that appeared on the photos to be sunken ships, and while working for decades in secret, Gordon created a map that he thought could uncover treasures worth billions of dollars. Before passing away, he shared his meticulous research with longtime friend Darrell Miklos, and now Miklos is teaming with seasoned explorers and researchers to finally make good on Gordon's dream. (Cooper's Treasure). Nuotykių.

programme.title: Alaska Monsters.
programme.desc: Within the Last Frontier lies a region known as the Alaska Triangle, spanning 200,000 unforgiving square miles where more people go missing per capita than anywhere else on earth. Treacherous terrain and unforgiving natural elements have stopped many in their tracks, but some Alaskans hold onto the idea that mysterious monsters snatched them up. Unidentified crypto-creatures wander the state covered by millions of acres of dense wilderness and are known to lift and reposition trees with ease, create seismic activity with their minds, and even decapitate humans with one bite. Destination America's new series ALASKA MONSTERS travels with a team of native outdoorsmen, who call themselves the Midnight Sons, as they investigate the harsh Alaskan forest in a quest to uncover proof of frightening monsters thought to be living there. (Alaska Monsters). Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods with Andrew Zimmern.
programme.desc: Unmasking an aspect of dining out that will make you think twice before ordering off the menu, and utilizing his knowledge of all things edible, Andrew Zimmern is on a quest to find the world's most bizarre foods. Andrew knows that one man's poison is another's delicacy but he isn't afraid to poke a little fun at the local fare or himself. Our energetic food-a-holic infiltrates markets and restaurants taking viewers behind the scenes to savor the local cuisine - even if that means chewing on eggs with legs, gulping down a beating frog heart or polishing off a lamb's eyeball. Andrew is game for anything and knows the most interesting food is found closest to the source. So whether he's chasing down large water rodents in the Louisiana bayou, fishing for piranha in the Amazon or flushing out cave bats in Malaysia, you can be sure the guy with the iron stomach will dish up the unimaginable. (Bizarre Foods).

programme.title: Finding Bigfoot.
programme.desc: From small towns in the South to remote areas of the Pacific Northwest and Alaska, four eccentric but passionate members of the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO) embark on one single-minded mission: to find the elusive "creature" known as Bigfoot or the Sasquatch. The team consists of Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO) founder and President Matt Moneymaker, researchers James "Bobo" Fay and Cliff Barackman and skeptical scientist Ranae Holland. The series never questions the existence of Bigfoot, but rather documents the team's search efforts and study of evidence in an attempt to prove the existence of the elusive creature. (Finding Bigfoot). Nuotykių.

programme.title: The Holzer Files.
programme.desc: Based on the real life files of America's first ghost hunter, Dr. Hans Holzer (whose most famous case concerned the Lutz family of Amityville, NY), this show follows a team of paranormal investigators as they reexamine the terrifying tales that mystified the doctor. The team consists of paranormal investigator Dave Schrader, psychic medium Cindy Kaza and equipment technician Shane Pittman and they are aided by Holzer's daughter, Alexandra. They examine thousands of documents, letters, photographs, and audio and visual recordings, sometimes going as far back as the 50s. Following on from where Holzer left off, the team bring the investigations up to the present day and visit the locations of the supernatural events such as the Peck House, the Morris-Jumel Mansion, the Whaley House, and the USS Constellation. (The Holzer Files).

It's an isolated outlaw town - a refuge for people who don't want to be found that's surrounded by extreme wilderness over 100 miles from the authorities where young men go to prove themselves and old outlaws go to die; hunters, gold miners, gunsmiths, and survivalists who reside in this 'Old West' town are willing to risk their lives to live truly free. While some believe in continuing the town's frontier way of life, others feel the future of McCarthy depends on dragging itself into the modern age. Which way of life will reign supreme? (Edge of Alaska). Laisvalaikio.

programme.title: Building Alaska.

programme.title: Ghost Lab.
programme.desc: Ghost Lab is an American paranormal TV series revolving around ghost-hunting brothers Brad and Barry Klinge, the founders of Everyday Paranormal- a paranormal investigation team. programme.title: Paranormal Lockdown With Nick Groff.
programme.desc: Paranormal Lockdown brings together Nick Groff from Ghost Adventures and Katrina Weidmann from Paranormal State as they spend 72 hours completely locked down in some of the most haunted places in America. Believing that by spending time isolated within a haunted location for a longer period of time than most paranormal shows will bring them closer to communication with the spirits that may be haunting these locations. (Paranormal Lockdown). [12+].

programme.title: Ghost Brothers.
programme.desc: What you see is what you get with Dalen Spratt, Juwan Mass and Marcus Harvey, the Southeast's newest and most dynamic paranormal investigation team. These three best friends lead Destination America's new series GHOST BROTHERS, on a mission to uncover whether some unique, legendary "haunted" houses are the real deal. Raised in religious households, Dalen, Juwan and Marcus were taught that "messing" with the dead is dangerous business, but some unexplained experiences of their own piqued their intense fascination, ultimately driving them to find out firsthand just how spooky the supernatural can be. Blending natural curiosity with comedic flair, these charismatic characters offer a fresh, funny and unique take on the spirit world. (Ghost Brothers). [12+].

programme.title: Expedition Unknown.
programme.desc: To find a viable sample of mammoth DNA, Josh Gates retrieves bone samples from the massive Batagay crater, then journeys far upriver to a site in the lawless Siberian wilderness where tusk hunters carve out troves of bones from the permafrost. He takes the DNA samples back to the lab and watches the process of treating and testing the specimens. At long last, he views the DNA results to find out if the woolly mammoth will walk the earth again. (Expedition Unknown). Nuotykių.

programme.title: Mountain Monsters.
programme.desc: Mountain Monsters is an American cryptozoology-themed reality TV series revolving around the Appalachian Investigators of Mysterious Sightings team. It is a group of six skilled native West Virginian hunters and trappers. They are on a mission to study and track unidentified creatures in the Appalachian Mountains. Their main goal is to prove that mysterious creatures like Bigfoot, Werewolf, Hellhound, Lizard Man, and Mothman do exist and provide the proper evidence to the viewers. (Mountain Monsters). [12+]. Gyvūnai.

programme.title: The Holzer Files.
programme.desc: Based on the real life files of America's first ghost hunter, Dr. Hans Holzer (whose most famous case concerned the Lutz family of Amityville, NY), this show follows a team of paranormal investigators as they reexamine the terrifying tales that mystified the doctor. The team consists of paranormal investigator Dave Schrader, psychic medium Cindy Kaza and equipment technician Shane Pittman and they are aided by Holzer's daughter, Alexandra. They examine thousands of documents, letters, photographs, and audio and visual recordings, sometimes going as far back as the 50s. Following on from where Holzer left off, the team bring the investigations up to the present day and visit the locations of the supernatural events such as the Peck House, the Morris-Jumel Mansion, the Whaley House, and the USS Constellation. (The Holzer Files).

programme.title: Portals To Hell.
programme.desc: Growing up around Ozzy Osbourne must have been, at times, a frightening ordeal for Jack Osbourne, however that hasn't stopped the son of the Prince of Darkness teaming up with paranormal investigator Katrina Weidman, to explore infamous, haunted locations. In each episode of this frightening reality series, Jack and Katrina head to a new place with a chilling history, and each sinister site is said to be a portal to the depths of the underworld. With the help of a team of experts and armed with unique technology, the pair thoroughly examine each new haunting site, hoping to unearth the truth behind their respective mysterious pasts. (Portals To Hell). [12+].

programme.title: Haunting In The Heartland.
programme.desc: Something evil lurks in the shadows of the close-knit communities, idyllic Main Streets and rolling fields of America's heartland. Paranormal investigator Steve Shippy witnessed this darkness firsthand as a child growing up in rural Michigan. Now, with the help of local eyewitnesses and historical records, he's made it his mission to solve these mysterious hauntings and bring resolution to the living and the dead. (Haunting in the Heartland). [16+].

programme.title: Ghost Asylum.
programme.desc: TWC returns to their home state to investigate Brushy Mountain State Penitentiary, which held some of the most violent criminals in Tennessee, including it most infamous inmate, James Earl Ray, who assassinated Martin Luther King. In the order to trap the former inmate of a little person named Jack Jett who was stabbed 19 times, the guys build a "Wraith Fog Trap" with four spinning lasers that projects onto a moisture-rich thick fog to draw entities in, transforming into electricity with a Jacob's ladder. (Ghost Asylum). [12+].

programme.title: Cooper's Treasure.
programme.desc: Considered one of NASA's original space pioneers, astronaut Gordon Cooper discovered something extraordinary on a 1963 mission. While circling Earth during a 122-hour flight to detect nuclear sites, Cooper photographed more than 100 anomalies around the South Caribbean. He later believed the dark patches that appeared on the photos to be sunken ships, and while working for decades in secret, Gordon created a map that he thought could uncover treasures worth billions of dollars. Before passing away, he shared his meticulous research with longtime friend Darrell Miklos, and now Miklos is teaming with seasoned explorers and researchers to finally make good on Gordon's dream. (Cooper's Treasure). Nuotykių.

programme.title: Finding Bigfoot.
programme.desc: From small towns in the South to remote areas of the Pacific Northwest and Alaska, four eccentric but passionate members of the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO) embark on one single-minded mission: to find the elusive "creature" known as Bigfoot or the Sasquatch. The team consists of Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO) founder and President Matt Moneymaker, researchers James "Bobo" Fay and Cliff Barackman and skeptical scientist Ranae Holland. The series never questions the existence of Bigfoot, but rather documents the team's search efforts and study of evidence in an attempt to prove the existence of the elusive creature. (Finding Bigfoot). Nuotykių.

programme.title: Alaska Monsters.
programme.desc: Within the Last Frontier lies a region known as the Alaska Triangle, spanning 200,000 unforgiving square miles where more people go missing per capita than anywhere else on earth. Treacherous terrain and unforgiving natural elements have stopped many in their tracks, but some Alaskans hold onto the idea that mysterious monsters snatched them up. Unidentified crypto-creatures wander the state covered by millions of acres of dense wilderness and are known to lift and reposition trees with ease, create seismic activity with their minds, and even decapitate humans with one bite. Destination America's new series ALASKA MONSTERS travels with a team of native outdoorsmen, who call themselves the Midnight Sons, as they investigate the harsh Alaskan forest in a quest to uncover proof of frightening monsters thought to be living there. (Alaska Monsters). Gyvūnai.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods with Andrew Zimmern.
programme.desc: Unmasking an aspect of dining out that will make you think twice before ordering off the menu, and utilizing his knowledge of all things edible, Andrew Zimmern is on a quest to find the world's most bizarre foods. Andrew knows that one man's poison is another's delicacy but he isn't afraid to poke a little fun at the local fare or himself. Our energetic food-a-holic infiltrates markets and restaurants taking viewers behind the scenes to savor the local cuisine - even if that means chewing on eggs with legs, gulping down a beating frog heart or polishing off a lamb's eyeball. Andrew is game for anything and knows the most interesting food is found closest to the source. So whether he's chasing down large water rodents in the Louisiana bayou, fishing for piranha in the Amazon or flushing out cave bats in Malaysia, you can be sure the guy with the iron stomach will dish up the unimaginable. (Bizarre Foods).

programme.title: Bizarre Foods with Andrew Zimmern.
programme.desc: Unmasking an aspect of dining out that will make you think twice before ordering off the menu, and utilizing his knowledge of all things edible, Andrew Zimmern is on a quest to find the world's most bizarre foods. Andrew knows that one man's poison is another's delicacy but he isn't afraid to poke a little fun at the local fare or himself. Our energetic food-a-holic infiltrates markets and restaurants taking viewers behind the scenes to savor the local cuisine - even if that means chewing on eggs with legs, gulping down a beating frog heart or polishing off a lamb's eyeball. programme.title: NASA's Unexplained Files.
programme.desc: Cold Warrior: December 1998 - NASA astronauts begin construction of the International Space Station and photograph a strange object that some link to the 1950s story of the 'Black Knight'. Space Geysers: The Casini probe takes pictures of Saturn's moon Enceladus and sees massive geysers of liquid water on a moon that should be dead. These geysers also contain the building blocks of life. Hole in the Sun: July 18, 2013 - Scientists observing the Sun see what appears to be a 500,000 mile hole creep across the Surface of the Sun. Alien Spies: September 2002 - An amateur astronomer spots a bright object orbiting Earth. He reports the object to the authorities and NASA scientists are surprised to find the object covered in paint. Martian Tracks: November 1971 - Mariner 9 arrives on Mars and sends back images of unusual tracks on the planet's surface. Faster Than The Speed of Light: December 1995 - The Hubble Telescope is pointed at a completely empty spot of sky to see what's there and surprisingly the faint galaxies seen appear to be traveling faster than the speed of light. STS-114 Boomerang: July 26, 2005 - One of the cameras from Space Shuttle Discovery sees an object change direction own its own. We Are The Aliens: The theory of Panspermia is that life here on Earth may have originated elsewhere, by riding rocks to Earth after being knocked off other planets by asteroid strikes. (NASA's Unexplained Files). Mokslas.

programme.title: NASA's Unexplained Files.
programme.desc: A distant planet shows evidence of an Earth-like atmosphere, while a mysterious light suggests an atmosphere on the Moon. Have we found evidence of a crashed alien ship in the asteroid belt? Why are there "blueberries" on Mars? 43 min | TV-PG | Premiered 03/18/2014 Apollo 12 Follower: Shortly after Apollo 12's launch the ship is struck by lightning, twice. After the ship computers recover from the lightning strike the mission continues and strange objects are seen following the moon landing. Alien Crash Site: The Dawn space probe in 2011 studies Vesta, a 4.5 million year old asteroid in the Asteroid Belt. Pictures seem to show the crash site of a triangular shaped object. Could it be a failed attempt at mining asteroids for precious metals by a race from beyond the solar system. The Gemini X Incident: A mission meant to learn how to dock with booster rockets in space turns strange when the astronauts spot flashing objects that suddenly disappear. Alien Cloud: A planet 63 light years away is photographed by the Hubble Telescope. Studies of these photos show the presence of methane that may indicate life. Skylab's Gremlins: NASA's Skylab is plagued by accidents, almost from the start of the mission. While trying to figure out why the mission has so many problems scientists see a photo of a mysterious object that leave and then returns. Mars Blueberries: The Opportunity rover lands on Mars and the first thing it photographs is little round rocks that are less red than everything else seen on the planet. Hubble Encounter: On the mission to repair the Hubble Space Telescope, the crew sees multiple objects buzz the mission as if watching their progress. Moon Glow: Surveyor 7 lands on the Moon prior to the first manned mission and photographs an unexpected glow. When an Apollo 17 astronaut reports a glow on the horizon, NASA finally attempts to understand the phenomenon. (NASA's Unexplained Files). Mokslas.

programme.title: NASA's Unexplained Files.
programme.desc: Cold Warrior: December 1998 - NASA astronauts begin construction of the International Space Station and photograph a strange object that some link to the 1950s story of the 'Black Knight'. Space Geysers: The Casini probe takes pictures of Saturn's moon Enceladus and sees massive geysers of liquid water on a moon that should be dead. These geysers also contain the building blocks of life. Hole in the Sun: July 18, 2013 - Scientists observing the Sun see what appears to be a 500,000 mile hole creep across the Surface of the Sun. Alien Spies: September 2002 - An amateur astronomer spots a bright object orbiting Earth. He reports the object to the authorities and NASA scientists are surprised to find the object covered in paint. Martian Tracks: November 1971 - Mariner 9 arrives on Mars and sends back images of unusual tracks on the planet's surface. Faster Than The Speed of Light: December 1995 - The Hubble Telescope is pointed at a completely empty spot of sky to see what's there and surprisingly the faint galaxies seen appear to be traveling faster than the speed of light. STS-114 Boomerang: July 26, 2005 - One of the cameras from Space Shuttle Discovery sees an object change direction own its own. We Are The Aliens: The theory of Panspermia is that life here on Earth may have originated elsewhere, by riding rocks to Earth after being knocked off other planets by asteroid strikes. (NASA's Unexplained Files). Mokslas.

programme.title: NASA's Unexplained Files.

The Gemini X Incident: A mission meant to learn how to dock with booster rockets in space turns strange when the astronauts spot flashing objects that suddenly disappear. Skylab's Gremlins: NASA's Skylab is plagued by accidents, almost from the start of the mission. Mars Blueberries: The Opportunity rover lands on Mars and the first thing it photographs is little round rocks that are less red than everything else seen on the planet. Hubble Encounter: On the mission to repair the Hubble Space Telescope, the crew sees multiple objects buzz the mission as if watching their progress. Moon Glow: Surveyor 7 lands on the Moon prior to the first manned mission and photographs an unexpected glow. (The Holzer Files). [16+].

programme.title: Cooper's Treasure.
programme.desc: Considered one of NASA's original space pioneers, astronaut Gordon Cooper discovered something extraordinary on a 1963 mission. While circling Earth during a 122-hour flight to detect nuclear sites, Cooper photographed more than 100 anomalies around the South Caribbean. He later believed the dark patches that appeared on the photos to be sunken ships, and while working for decades in secret, Gordon created a map that he thought could uncover treasures worth billions of dollars. Before passing away, he shared his meticulous research with longtime friend Darrell Miklos, and now Miklos is teaming with seasoned explorers and researchers to finally make good on Gordon's dream. (Cooper's Treasure). Nuotykių.

programme.desc: Join our crew as they take us on a journey to investigate some of the scariest and most spine-chilling places on the planet. We visit horrifying haunts and encounter mysterious creatures that are not of this world. Not for the faint-hearted, each hour-long episode of this series explores such ghoulish phenomena as the malevolent spirits that stalk an abandoned amusement park; the realm of the undead who inhabit a derelict theatre that is used as a morgue; the spirits of long-dead seamen who still walk the decks of a decommisioned warship; and an island that is still in thrall to the presence of an infamous pirate. (Most Terrifying Places). [16+].

programme.title: Most Terrifying Places In America: Devil's Playground.
programme.desc: The series is narrated by Mason Pettit. Each parted episode starts off with a haunted hotspot on a map of the United States. A particular haunted location is selected in a state and thus begins the journey into the unknown. Parnormal investigators, Historians, psychics, and mediums all discover the secrets behind these hotspots. Plus historical footage and interviews from eyewitness reports on the paranormal is told from personal encounters with ghosts, spirits, and everything that is supernatural. (Most Terrifying Places in America). [12+]. Nuotykių.

programme.title: The Holzer Files.
programme.desc: Based on the real life files of America's first ghost hunter, Dr. Hans Holzer (whose most famous case concerned the Lutz family of Amityville, NY), this show follows a team of paranormal investigators as they reexamine the terrifying tales that mystified the doctor. The team consists of paranormal investigator Dave Schrader, psychic medium Cindy Kaza and equipment technician Shane Pittman and they are aided by Holzer's daughter, Alexandra. They examine thousands of documents, letters, photographs, and audio and visual recordings, sometimes going as far back as the 50s. Following on from where Holzer left off, the team bring the investigations up to the present day and visit the locations of the supernatural events such as the Peck House, the Morris-Jumel Mansion, the Whaley House, and the USS Constellation. (The Holzer Files). [16+].

programme.title: Portals To Hell.
programme.desc: Growing up around Ozzy Osbourne must have been, at times, a frightening ordeal for Jack Osbourne, however that hasn't stopped the son of the Prince of Darkness teaming up with paranormal investigator Katrina Weidman, to explore infamous, haunted locations. In each episode of this frightening reality series, Jack and Katrina head to a new place with a chilling history, and each sinister site is said to be a portal to the depths of the underworld. With the help of a team of experts and armed with unique technology, the pair thoroughly examine each new haunting site, hoping to unearth the truth behind their respective mysterious pasts. (Portals To Hell). [12+].

programme.title: Expedition Unknown.

programme.title: Finding Bigfoot.
programme.desc: The team takes an unprecedented trip across the globe to investigate recent eyewitness reports of yowies terrorizing locals in Australia's Gold Coast. Yowies are mysterious creatures described as bipedal, apex predators with brown fur, and the team must use their sasquatch expertise to track down where these creatures may be. With help from local witnesses and experts, the investigators traverse deep into Australia's jungle in hopes of proving bigfoot's cousin down under is in fact real. (120 Minute special episode) (Finding Bigfoot). Nuotykių.

programme.title: The Alaska Triangle.
programme.desc: Experts and eyewitnesses attempt to unlock the mystery of the Alaska Triangle, a remote area infamous for alien abductions, Bigfoot sightings, paranormal phenomena and vanishing airplanes. Throughout the series, we meet a woman whose idyllic Alaskan dream soon descends into a paranormal nightmare, as she starts to suffer attacks by an unseen force. Recent sightings may prove that a Native American legend about a mysterious race of giants is true. The series also explores The Missing Douglas and whether an interdimensional portal in the Alaska Triangle led to the disappearance of the airplane carrying 44 military personnel in 1950. (The Alaska Triangle). Mokslas.

programme.title: Finding Bigfoot.
programme.desc: From small towns in the South to remote areas of the Pacific Northwest and Alaska, four eccentric but passionate members of the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO) embark on one single-minded mission: to find the elusive "creature" known as Bigfoot or the Sasquatch. The team consists of Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO) founder and President Matt Moneymaker, researchers James "Bobo" Fay and Cliff Barackman and skeptical scientist Ranae Holland. The series never questions the existence of Bigfoot, but rather documents the team's search efforts and study of evidence in an attempt to prove the existence of the elusive creature. programme.title: Finding Bigfoot.
programme.desc: New Mexico is dubbed the "Land of Enchantment," and the team is in the Jemez Mountains to investigate a thermal video image captured during a Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO) expedition. Through the testimonials of local eyewitnesses, the team discovers that this particular bigfoot may be residing in the Valles Caldera, a National Park which hosts vast herds of elk. Forested canyons surround the park, and the team of investigators believes it's found the perfect habitat for the world's largest and most mysterious apex predator. In a stealthy attempt to pinpoint this elusive beast, the team takes to the friendly skies via a hot air balloon. (Finding Bigfoot). Nuotykių.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods with Andrew Zimmern.
programme.desc: Unmasking an aspect of dining out that will make you think twice before ordering off the menu, and utilizing his knowledge of all things edible, Andrew Zimmern is on a quest to find the world's most bizarre foods. Andrew knows that one man's poison is another's delicacy but he isn't afraid to poke a little fun at the local fare or himself. Our energetic food-a-holic infiltrates markets and restaurants taking viewers behind the scenes to savor the local cuisine - even if that means chewing on eggs with legs, gulping down a beating frog heart or polishing off a lamb's eyeball. Andrew is game for anything and knows the most interesting food is found closest to the source. So whether he's chasing down large water rodents in the Louisiana bayou, fishing for piranha in the Amazon or flushing out cave bats in Malaysia, you can be sure the guy with the iron stomach will dish up the unimaginable. (Bizarre Foods).

(Backpack).

programme.title: Xplore Bulgaria.
programme.desc: Documentary series. Step into a world of Eastern European diversity as we explore the fascinating country of Bulgaria. Steeped in a rich culture that takes in Greek, Slavic, Ottoman, and Persian influences, Bulgaria is a country with a remarkable history. With its capital Sofia first established over 7000 years ago (making it the second oldest city in Europe) this series takes a look at how this history still plays a huge part in today's way of life. From its traditional music to vibrant dancing, Bulgaria has established itself as one of the most unique cultures in Europe. (Xplore Bulgaria).

Live life like the stars as we explore every corner of the world from the comfort of your sofa. Season one alone takes us from Dubai to Mauritius to the Maldives. Whether you're an avid traveller or have never left the country, this journey is suitable for everyone. This is your journey. This is our journey. (Great World Hotels).

programme.title: Backpack.
programme.desc: For many years passion for travelling has been bringing people to unexplored continents, countries and places to look into culture, history, food, nature and people. This kind of passion if the key point of Backpack, a travel show that opens new spots all over the world by a show host travelling solo with a backpack. So make yourself comfortable and enjoy visiting Serbia, Spain, Israel, India, Egypt and many more. Take a look at the historical past and modern life, find out about traditions, get to know tourism hotspots and treasures of nature, plan your future vacations with the help of show hosts' recommendations. (Backpack).

programme.title: Xplore Bulgaria.
programme.desc: Documentary series. Step into a world of Eastern European diversity as we explore the fascinating country of Bulgaria. Steeped in a rich culture that takes in Greek, Slavic, Ottoman, and Persian influences, Bulgaria is a country with a remarkable history. With its capital Sofia first established over 7000 years ago (making it the second oldest city in Europe) this series takes a look at how this history still plays a huge part in today's way of life. From its traditional music to vibrant dancing, Bulgaria has established itself as one of the most unique cultures in Europe. (Xplore Bulgaria).

programme.desc: Po tėvo žūties, pamotė paliko Leilą. Mergaitė užauga ir netrukus grįžta, norėdama atkeršyti. Tačiau ne tokią kelionę ji planavo. Leila sutinka tikrąją meilę ir tai pasėja dvejonę jos širdyje. Ar ji išdrįs kovoti su moterimi, kuri sugriovė jos gyvenimą? (Leyla: Hayat... Aşk... Adalet...). [7+]. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: "Velvet". Nauja imperija.
programme.desc: Siuvėja ir "Galerías Velvet" paveldėtojas siekia uždraustos meilės, o tai išryškina problemas, su kuriomis Amerikoje susiduria įvairių kartų lotynų amerikiečiai mados ir kasdienio gyvenimo srityse. Kokius pavojus slepia mados imperijos glėbys? Kuo baigsis verslui nepatogi dviejų žmonių meilė? (Velvet: el nuevo imperio). [7+]. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Profesorius T..
programme.desc: Profesorius Džasperis, genialus Kembridžo universiteto kriminologas, bendradarbiauja su aklavietėje atsidūrusia policija. Vyras kenčia nuo obsesinio kompulsinio sutrikimo ir vis dar taikosi prie valdingos motinos kaprizų. (Professor T). [7+]. Kriminalai. Dramos.

programme.title: Rezidentas.
programme.desc: Idealizmo kupinas jaunasis gydytojas Devonas Pravešas pradeda pirmuosius metus Atlantos ligoninėje, Džordžijos valstijoje. Jam vadovauja trečiakursis rezidentas Konradas Hokinsas - gudrus, greitas ir šiek tiek kitaip nei Devonas apie mediciną galvojantis gydytojas. Jis teigia, kad gydymas iš tikro visai kitoks nei rašoma vadovėliuose, ir jei nori būti geras daktaras, mokytis turi ne iš knygų. Padėti pacientams - daug būdų, bet, kaip sako Konradas, niekas nemoko, kad dar daugiau būdų yra jiems pakenkti. Kaip to išvengti? Ar nuslėpti gydymo klaidas, ar susitaikyti su faktu, kad tai tik darbas? Devonui teks nagrinėti ne tik žmogaus anatomiją, bet ir etines dilemas. Pamačius vyresnius gydytojus tampa daugiau nei aišku, kad nė vienas iš jų nėra be nuodėmės, ypač gydytojas Belas. Ar išduoti jo paslaptis? Devoną vaidina Roshanas Sethis iš filmų "Šimto žingsnių kelionė" ir "Agentūra S.K.Y.D.A.S.", Konradą - Mattas Czuchry iš serialo "Gera žmona", jo meilės objektą, seselę Nikoletę - serialo "Kerštas" žvaigždė, o daktarą Belą - Bruce'as Greenwoodas, žinomas iš filmų "Skrydis", "Niujorko šešėlis" ir serialo "Reklamos vilkai". (The Resident). [16+]. Dramos. Medicina.

Šio serialo centre ne tik policijos pareigūnai, tiriantys įvykdytą nusikaltimą ir medžiojantys nusikaltėlius, bet ir prokurorai, kurių kasdien laukia sunkūs mūšiai už teisingumą. (Law & Order: Special Victims Unit). [7+]. Kriminalai. Mistika. Trileriai. Dramos.

programme.title: Likimo seserys.

Jos didžiausia svajonė - išleisti seserį už mylinčio, pagarbaus vyro ir apsaugoti nuo sunkios moters tarnystės. Ar seserims pavyks pasipriešinti nepalankioms šeimos tradicijoms? (Mangal Laxmi). [7+]. programme.title: Leila.
programme.desc: Po tėvo žūties, pamotė paliko Leilą. Mergaitė užauga ir netrukus grįžta, norėdama atkeršyti. Tačiau ne tokią kelionę ji planavo. Leila sutinka tikrąją meilę ir tai pasėja dvejonę jos širdyje. Ar ji išdrįs kovoti su moterimi, kuri sugriovė jos gyvenimą? (Leyla: Hayat... Aşk... Adalet...). [7+]. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: "Velvet". Nauja imperija.
programme.desc: Siuvėja ir "Galerías Velvet" paveldėtojas siekia uždraustos meilės, o tai išryškina problemas, su kuriomis Amerikoje susiduria įvairių kartų lotynų amerikiečiai mados ir kasdienio gyvenimo srityse. Kokius pavojus slepia mados imperijos glėbys? Kuo baigsis verslui nepatogi dviejų žmonių meilė? (Velvet: el nuevo imperio). [7+]. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Profesorius T..
programme.desc: Profesorius Džasperis, genialus Kembridžo universiteto kriminologas, bendradarbiauja su aklavietėje atsidūrusia policija. Vyras kenčia nuo obsesinio kompulsinio sutrikimo ir vis dar taikosi prie valdingos motinos kaprizų. (Professor T). [7+]. Kriminalai. Dramos.

programme.title: Rezidentas.
programme.desc: Idealizmo kupinas jaunasis gydytojas Devonas Pravešas pradeda pirmuosius metus Atlantos ligoninėje, Džordžijos valstijoje. Jam vadovauja trečiakursis rezidentas Konradas Hokinsas - gudrus, greitas ir šiek tiek kitaip nei Devonas apie mediciną galvojantis gydytojas. Jis teigia, kad gydymas iš tikro visai kitoks nei rašoma vadovėliuose, ir jei nori būti geras daktaras, mokytis turi ne iš knygų. Padėti pacientams - daug būdų, bet, kaip sako Konradas, niekas nemoko, kad dar daugiau būdų yra jiems pakenkti. Kaip to išvengti? Ar nuslėpti gydymo klaidas, ar susitaikyti su faktu, kad tai tik darbas? Devonui teks nagrinėti ne tik žmogaus anatomiją, bet ir etines dilemas. Pamačius vyresnius gydytojus tampa daugiau nei aišku, kad nė vienas iš jų nėra be nuodėmės, ypač gydytojas Belas. Ar išduoti jo paslaptis? Devoną vaidina Roshanas Sethis iš filmų "Šimto žingsnių kelionė" ir "Agentūra S.K.Y.D.A.S.", Konradą - Mattas Czuchry iš serialo "Gera žmona", jo meilės objektą, seselę Nikoletę - serialo "Kerštas" žvaigždė, o daktarą Belą - Bruce'as Greenwoodas, žinomas iš filmų "Skrydis", "Niujorko šešėlis" ir serialo "Reklamos vilkai". (The Resident). [16+]. Dramos. Medicina.

programme.title: Įstatymas ir tvarka. Specialiųjų tyrimų skyrius.
programme.desc: Milžiniško populiarumo Amerikoje sulaukęs ir net du dešimtmečius rodytas kirminalinis serialas. Šio serialo centre ne tik policijos pareigūnai, tiriantys įvykdytą nusikaltimą ir medžiojantys nusikaltėlius, bet ir prokurorai, kurių kasdien laukia sunkūs mūšiai už teisingumą. (Law & Order: Special Victims Unit). [7+]. Dramos. Mistika. Trileriai. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Prahos kriminalinė policija.
programme.desc: Čekų kriminalinis serialas, kuris žiūrovus nukelia į vaizdingas ir paslaptingas Prahos gatves. (Specialisté). [7+]. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Anupama.
programme.desc: Ji daug paaukojo, kad taptų ištikima žmona, atsidavusia marčia ir mylinčia motina, o mainais pelnė didžiulę nepagarbą. Nepaisydama karčios tiesos, ji stengsis gyventi toliau. (Anupamaa). Dramos.

programme.title: Likimo seserys.
programme.desc: Dvi seserys ir du skirtingi jų likimai. Vyresnioji, paaukojusi savo gyvenimą šeimai ir vyrui, siekia apsaugoti jaunėlę nuo klaidų. Jos didžiausia svajonė - išleisti seserį už mylinčio, pagarbaus vyro ir apsaugoti nuo sunkios moters tarnystės. Ar seserims pavyks pasipriešinti nepalankioms šeimos tradicijoms? (Mangal Laxmi). [7+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Paslėpk mane.
programme.desc: Turkiška drama, pasakojanti dviejų šeimų istoriją. Jau seniai suplanuota, kad turtingų šeimų vaikai Metė ir Naz, užaugę - susituoks. Kai prieš Metę pasirodo Inčila, kuri nuo vaikystės buvo su Naz, viskas pasikeičia. Ar Inčilos ir Metės susitikimas pakeis šeimų planus? Kokia bus tikros meilės kaina? (Sakla Beni). [7+]. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Ūkininkas ieško žmonos.
programme.desc: Visame pasaulyje populiarus pasimatymų šou. Penki vieniši australai, kaimo vaikinai, ieško savo gyvenimo meilės. Su ūkininkais trokš susipažinti būrys vienišų miestiečių merginų, jos eis į pasimatymus, o labiausiai patikusias vaikinai pakvies apsigyventi savo ūkyje, kad geriau su jomis susipažintų. Tada ūkininkas išsirinks tą vienintelę, su kuria norės tęsti pažintį. (The Farmer Wants a Wife Australia).

programme.title: Atsarginis prezidentas.
programme.desc: Įtempto siužeto įtraukiantis "Netlix" politinis serialas. Jungtinių Valstijų Kapitolijų susprogdina teroristai. Žūva prezidentas ir jo artimiausi įpėdiniai. Pagal įstatymus, prie šalies vairo turi stoti atsarginis prezidentas - žemesnio lygio ministrų kabineto narys Tomas Kirkmanas, to visai netrokštantis. Jam teks įveikti pačiam save, susigaudyti nuolat kintančioje politinėje arenoje, pelnyti žmonių palankumą, apsaugoti savo šeimą ir, žinoma, rasti išpuolį įvykdžiusius teroristus. Pagrindinį vaidmenį atlieka Kieferis Sutherlandas. (Designated Survivor). [7+]. Veiksmo. Dramos. Trileriai. Mistika.

programme.title: Įstatymas ir tvarka. Specialiųjų tyrimų skyrius.
programme.desc: Niujorko specialiųjų aukų skyriaus detektyvai ir toliau tiria sudėtingiausius seksualinius nusikaltimus, kuriuose aukos ir jų artimieji susiduria su skaudžiomis pasekmėmis. Kiekviena byla priverčia komandą ieškoti tiesos tarp melo, manipuliacijų ir paslapčių, o nusikaltėlių medžioklė tampa vis pavojingesnė. (Law & Order: Special Victims Unit). [7+]. Mistika. Trileriai. Kriminalai. Dramos.

programme.title: Detektyvas Kardinalas. Mašalų sezonas.
programme.desc: Ketvirtajame ir paskutiniame sezone, pavadintame "Iki nakties", adaptuojamas šeštasis ir paskutinis serijos romanas. Detektyvai Džonas Kardinalas ir Liza Delormė tiria seriją žmogžudysčių, kai pagrobtos aukos paliekamos mirti, o kaip vizitinė kortelė paliekama sakalo plunksna. Ar detektyvai suvoks keršto ir kultūrų susidūrimo skirtumus? (Cardinal). [14+]. Kriminalai. Mistika. Trileriai. Dramos.

programme.title: Leila.
programme.desc: Po tėvo žūties, pamotė paliko Leilą. Mergaitė užauga ir netrukus grįžta, norėdama atkeršyti. Tačiau ne tokią kelionę ji planavo. Leila sutinka tikrąją meilę ir tai pasėja dvejonę jos širdyje. Ar ji išdrįs kovoti su moterimi, kuri sugriovė jos gyvenimą? (Leyla: Hayat... Aşk... Adalet...). [7+]. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Paslėpk mane.
programme.desc: Turkiška drama, pasakojanti dviejų šeimų istoriją. Jau seniai suplanuota, kad turtingų šeimų vaikai Metė ir Naz, užaugę - susituoks. Kai prieš Metę pasirodo Inčila, kuri nuo vaikystės buvo su Naz, viskas pasikeičia. Ar Inčilos ir Metės susitikimas pakeis šeimų planus? Kokia bus tikros meilės kaina? (Sakla Beni). [7+]. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Ūkininkas ieško žmonos.
programme.desc: Visame pasaulyje populiarus pasimatymų šou. Penki vieniši australai, kaimo vaikinai, ieško savo gyvenimo meilės. Su ūkininkais trokš susipažinti būrys vienišų miestiečių merginų, jos eis į pasimatymus, o labiausiai patikusias vaikinai pakvies apsigyventi savo ūkyje, kad geriau su jomis susipažintų. Tada ūkininkas išsirinks tą vienintelę, su kuria norės tęsti pažintį. (The Farmer Wants a Wife Australia).

Romantiniai.

programme.title: Akloji.
programme.desc: Kai įprasti sprendimai nepadeda, žmonės kreipiasi į paslaptingą aiškiaregę, gebančią įžvelgti tai, kas paslėpta nuo kitų akių. Ji padeda atskleisti melo, išdavysčių ir nelaimių priežastis, tačiau jos įžvalgos ne visada atneša lengvus atsakymus. Kiekviena istorija atskleidžia paslaptį, galinčią pakeisti žmogaus gyvenimą. (Слепая). [7+]. Dramos. Mistika.

programme.title: Akloji.
programme.desc: Šio mistinio serialo istorijos paimtos iš realaus aiškiarėgės Ninos, kuri yra lyginama su garsiąja Vanga, gyvenimo. Kiekviena serija pasakoja vis naują istoriją, kurioje Nina kas kartą į ją besikreipiantiems žmonėms įkvėps vilties ir palaikymo. Ir nors nuošaliame kaimelyje gyvenanti senolė vengia žmonių dėmesio, ji niekam neatsako padėti. (Слепая). [7+]. Dramos. Mistika.

programme.title: Leila.

programme.title: "Velvet". Nauja imperija.
programme.desc: Siuvėja ir "Galerías Velvet" paveldėtojas siekia uždraustos meilės, o tai išryškina problemas, su kuriomis Amerikoje susiduria įvairių kartų lotynų amerikiečiai mados ir kasdienio gyvenimo srityse. Kokius pavojus slepia mados imperijos glėbys? Kuo baigsis verslui nepatogi dviejų žmonių meilė? (Velvet: el nuevo imperio). [7+]. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Profesorius T..
programme.desc: Profesorius Džasperis, genialus Kembridžo universiteto kriminologas, bendradarbiauja su aklavietėje atsidūrusia policija. Vyras kenčia nuo obsesinio kompulsinio sutrikimo ir vis dar taikosi prie valdingos motinos kaprizų. (Professor T). [7+]. Dramos. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Rezidentas.
programme.desc: Idealizmo kupinas jaunasis gydytojas Devonas Pravešas pradeda pirmuosius metus Atlantos ligoninėje, Džordžijos valstijoje. Jam vadovauja trečiakursis rezidentas Konradas Hokinsas - gudrus, greitas ir šiek tiek kitaip nei Devonas apie mediciną galvojantis gydytojas. Jis teigia, kad gydymas iš tikro visai kitoks nei rašoma vadovėliuose, ir jei nori būti geras daktaras, mokytis turi ne iš knygų. Padėti pacientams - daug būdų, bet, kaip sako Konradas, niekas nemoko, kad dar daugiau būdų yra jiems pakenkti. Kaip to išvengti? Ar nuslėpti gydymo klaidas, ar susitaikyti su faktu, kad tai tik darbas? Devonui teks nagrinėti ne tik žmogaus anatomiją, bet ir etines dilemas. Pamačius vyresnius gydytojus tampa daugiau nei aišku, kad nė vienas iš jų nėra be nuodėmės, ypač gydytojas Belas. Ar išduoti jo paslaptis? Devoną vaidina Roshanas Sethis iš filmų "Šimto žingsnių kelionė" ir "Agentūra S.K.Y.D.A.S.", Konradą - Mattas Czuchry iš serialo "Gera žmona", jo meilės objektą, seselę Nikoletę - serialo "Kerštas" žvaigždė, o daktarą Belą - Bruce'as Greenwoodas, žinomas iš filmų "Skrydis", "Niujorko šešėlis" ir serialo "Reklamos vilkai". (The Resident). [16+]. Medicina. Dramos.

programme.title: Anupama.
programme.desc: Ji daug paaukojo, kad taptų ištikima žmona, atsidavusia marčia ir mylinčia motina, o mainais pelnė didžiulę nepagarbą. Nepaisydama karčios tiesos, ji stengsis gyventi toliau. (Anupamaa). Dramos.

programme.title: Likimo seserys.
programme.desc: Dvi seserys ir du skirtingi jų likimai. Vyresnioji, paaukojusi savo gyvenimą šeimai ir vyrui, siekia apsaugoti jaunėlę nuo klaidų. Jos didžiausia svajonė - išleisti seserį už mylinčio, pagarbaus vyro ir apsaugoti nuo sunkios moters tarnystės. Ar seserims pavyks pasipriešinti nepalankioms šeimos tradicijoms? (Mangal Laxmi). [7+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Pirmieji pasimatymai.
programme.desc: Akli pirmieji pasimatymai visuomet kelia stresą - ar jaudulys nepakiš kojos, ar bus apie ką kalbėtis, ar partneris nenuvils? Realybės šou, kuriame nejaukias akimirkas keičia juokingi nutikimai, abejingumą - aistringi susižavėjimai. Nuotaikingas, netikėtų situacijų, nusikalbėjimų, susikalbėjimų ir šokiruojančių prisipažinimų kupinas šou. Ar pirmas pasimatymas netaps paskutiniu? (First Dates Australia). [7+].

Kokius pavojus slepia mados imperijos glėbys? Kuo baigsis verslui nepatogi dviejų žmonių meilė? (Velvet: el nuevo imperio). [7+]. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Profesorius T..
programme.desc: Profesorius Džasperis, genialus Kembridžo universiteto kriminologas, bendradarbiauja su aklavietėje atsidūrusia policija. Vyras kenčia nuo obsesinio kompulsinio sutrikimo ir vis dar taikosi prie valdingos motinos kaprizų. (Professor T). [7+]. Dramos. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Rezidentas.
programme.desc: Idealizmo kupinas jaunasis gydytojas Devonas Pravešas pradeda pirmuosius metus Atlantos ligoninėje, Džordžijos valstijoje. Jam vadovauja trečiakursis rezidentas Konradas Hokinsas - gudrus, greitas ir šiek tiek kitaip nei Devonas apie mediciną galvojantis gydytojas. Jis teigia, kad gydymas iš tikro visai kitoks nei rašoma vadovėliuose, ir jei nori būti geras daktaras, mokytis turi ne iš knygų. Padėti pacientams - daug būdų, bet, kaip sako Konradas, niekas nemoko, kad dar daugiau būdų yra jiems pakenkti. Kaip to išvengti? Ar nuslėpti gydymo klaidas, ar susitaikyti su faktu, kad tai tik darbas? Devonui teks nagrinėti ne tik žmogaus anatomiją, bet ir etines dilemas. Pamačius vyresnius gydytojus tampa daugiau nei aišku, kad nė vienas iš jų nėra be nuodėmės, ypač gydytojas Belas. Ar išduoti jo paslaptis? Devoną vaidina Roshanas Sethis iš filmų "Šimto žingsnių kelionė" ir "Agentūra S.K.Y.D.A.S.", Konradą - Mattas Czuchry iš serialo "Gera žmona", jo meilės objektą, seselę Nikoletę - serialo "Kerštas" žvaigždė, o daktarą Belą - Bruce'as Greenwoodas, žinomas iš filmų "Skrydis", "Niujorko šešėlis" ir serialo "Reklamos vilkai". (The Resident). [16+]. Dramos. Medicina.

programme.title: Įstatymas ir tvarka. Specialiųjų tyrimų skyrius.
programme.desc: Niujorko specialiųjų aukų skyriaus detektyvai ir toliau tiria sudėtingiausius seksualinius nusikaltimus, kuriuose aukos ir jų artimieji susiduria su skaudžiomis pasekmėmis. Kiekviena byla priverčia komandą ieškoti tiesos tarp melo, manipuliacijų ir paslapčių, o nusikaltėlių medžioklė tampa vis pavojingesnė. (Law & Order: Special Victims Unit). [7+]. Kriminalai. Dramos. Trileriai. Mistika.

programme.title: Prahos kriminalinė policija.
programme.desc: Čekų kriminalinis serialas, kuris žiūrovus nukelia į vaizdingas ir paslaptingas Prahos gatves. (Specialisté). [7+]. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Anupama.
programme.desc: Ji daug paaukojo, kad taptų ištikima žmona, atsidavusia marčia ir mylinčia motina, o mainais pelnė didžiulę nepagarbą. Nepaisydama karčios tiesos, ji stengsis gyventi toliau. (Anupamaa). Dramos.

programme.title: Likimo seserys.
programme.desc: Dvi seserys ir du skirtingi jų likimai. Vyresnioji, paaukojusi savo gyvenimą šeimai ir vyrui, siekia apsaugoti jaunėlę nuo klaidų. Jos didžiausia svajonė - išleisti seserį už mylinčio, pagarbaus vyro ir apsaugoti nuo sunkios moters tarnystės. Ar seserims pavyks pasipriešinti nepalankioms šeimos tradicijoms? (Mangal Laxmi). [7+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Likimo seserys.

programme.title: Akloji.
programme.desc: Kai įprasti sprendimai nepadeda, žmonės kreipiasi į paslaptingą aiškiaregę, gebančią įžvelgti tai, kas paslėpta nuo kitų akių. Ji padeda atskleisti melo, išdavysčių ir nelaimių priežastis, tačiau jos įžvalgos ne visada atneša lengvus atsakymus. Kiekviena istorija atskleidžia paslaptį, galinčią pakeisti žmogaus gyvenimą. (Слепая). [7+]. Dramos. Mistika.

programme.title: Akloji.
programme.desc: Šio mistinio serialo istorijos paimtos iš realaus aiškiarėgės Ninos, kuri yra lyginama su garsiąja Vanga, gyvenimo. Kiekviena serija pasakoja vis naują istoriją, kurioje Nina kas kartą į ją besikreipiantiems žmonėms įkvėps vilties ir palaikymo. Ir nors nuošaliame kaimelyje gyvenanti senolė vengia žmonių dėmesio, ji niekam neatsako padėti. (Слепая). [7+]. Dramos. Mistika.

programme.title: Pirmieji pasimatymai.
programme.desc: Akli pirmieji pasimatymai visuomet kelia stresą - ar jaudulys nepakiš kojos, ar bus apie ką kalbėtis, ar partneris nenuvils? Realybės šou, kuriame nejaukias akimirkas keičia juokingi nutikimai, abejingumą - aistringi susižavėjimai. Nuotaikingas, netikėtų situacijų, nusikalbėjimų, susikalbėjimų ir šokiruojančių prisipažinimų kupinas šou. Ar pirmas pasimatymas netaps paskutiniu? (First Dates Australia). [7+].

programme.title: Spąstai.
programme.desc: Atokiame Islandijos miestelyje policija desperatiškai bando išaiškinti nusikaltimą, kai miestelį užklumpa galinga audra ir atkerta jį nuo civilizacijos. Paaiškės, kad šis mažas miestelis tik iš pirmo žvilgsnio atrodė ramus... (Ófærð). [14+]. Kriminalai. Trileriai. Dramos. Mistika.

programme.title: Meilės spąstai.
programme.desc: Romantikos ir švelnaus humoro prisotintas turkų draminis serialas pasakoja Aišės - geraširdės, bet ambicingos jaunos tekstilės darbuotojos - ir Keremo - nerūpestingo, žavaus mados imperijos paveldėtojo - istoriją. Dėl virtinės nesusipratimų jiedu įsipainioja į vienas kito gyvenimus priversti sudaryti fiktyvią santuoką, kad apsaugotų savo reputaciją. Kokių netikėtų vingių jiems dar atseikės likimas? (Afili Aşk). [14+]. Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Leila.
programme.desc: Po tėvo žūties, pamotė paliko Leilą. Mergaitė užauga ir netrukus grįžta, norėdama atkeršyti. Tačiau ne tokią kelionę ji planavo. Leila sutinka tikrąją meilę ir tai pasėja dvejonę jos širdyje. Ar ji išdrįs kovoti su moterimi, kuri sugriovė jos gyvenimą? (Leyla: Hayat... Aşk... Adalet...). [7+]. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Paslėpk mane.
programme.desc: Turkiška drama, pasakojanti dviejų šeimų istoriją. Jau seniai suplanuota, kad turtingų šeimų vaikai Metė ir Naz, užaugę - susituoks. Kai prieš Metę pasirodo Inčila, kuri nuo vaikystės buvo su Naz, viskas pasikeičia. Ar Inčilos ir Metės susitikimas pakeis šeimų planus? Kokia bus tikros meilės kaina? (Sakla Beni). [7+]. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Ūkininkas ieško žmonos.
programme.desc: Visame pasaulyje populiarus pasimatymų šou. Penki vieniši australai, kaimo vaikinai, ieško savo gyvenimo meilės. Su ūkininkais trokš susipažinti būrys vienišų miestiečių merginų, jos eis į pasimatymus, o labiausiai patikusias vaikinai pakvies apsigyventi savo ūkyje, kad geriau su jomis susipažintų. Tada ūkininkas išsirinks tą vienintelę, su kuria norės tęsti pažintį. (The Farmer Wants a Wife Australia).

programme.desc: Paranormalių tyrimų laida, kurioje dalyviai varžosi atlikdami įvairias užduotis, remdamiesi savo ypatingais gebėjimais ir instinktais. Laimėtojas apdovanojamas piniginiu prizu. Laidos vedėjas - Michailas Porečenkovas. (Битва екстрасенсів). [7+].

programme.title: Žiniuonio mokinė.
programme.desc: Išmintingojo Molfaro mokinė, turinti unikalią dovaną suvokti ir suprasti antgamtinius reiškinius, padės žmonėms rasti būdą išspręsti savo problemas. Remdamasi šimtmečių senumo ukrainiečių tradicijomis, protėvių patirtimi ir senojo Molfaro žiniomis, ji skatins žmones tikėti savo jėgomis ir parodys, kad net sunkiausiose situacijose yra išeitis. (Ученица Мольфара). [7+]. Dramos. Mistika.

programme.title: Sesers Bonifacijos paslaptys.
programme.desc: XX a. 7-asis dešimtmetis. Didžiojo Sloterio miestelis Anglijoje. Šv. Vincento vienuolyno sesuo Bonifacija policijai padeda tirti nusikaltimus. Nes ji ne šiaip paprasta vienuolė - ji mokslų daktarė ir policijos konsultantė. O dar ji gamina vyną ir mėgsta greitai lakstyti motociklu. (Sister Boniface Mysteries). [7+]. Komedijos. Kriminalai. Mistika. Dramos.

programme.title: Mirtis rojuje.
programme.desc: Britų policijos detektyvas inspektorius perkeliamas į vienos Karibų jūros salos policijos departamentą, kad padėtų tirti čia vykstančius nužudymus. Išsprendęs keletą sudėtingų žmogžudysčių, jis pasirodė esąs puikus detektyvas, todėl paliekamas čia dirbti. Bėda ta, kad jis visiškai nekenčia salos gyvenimo tempo, karščio, smėlio ir jūros gėrybių. Kaip seksis prisitaikyti prie naujos gyvenimo vietos ir kokie iššūkiai laukia? Vėlesnėse serijose vaidmenį perims kiti anglų ir airių detektyvai. (Death in Paradise). [7+]. Romantiniai. Komedijos. Kriminalai. Dramos. Mistika.

programme.title: Didingasis amžius.
programme.desc: Ištaigingas ir jausmingas, tarptautinio pripažinimo sulaukęs turkiškas serialas, pasakojantis apie sultono Suleimano ir karo metu į vergovę paimtos ukranietės meilę. Rūmų intrigos, spalvingas haremo gyvenimas ir nagailestinga kova ne tik dėl valdžios, bet ir dėl valdovo širdies. (Muhteşem Yüzyıl). [7+]. Nuotykių. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Prancūziška žmogžudystė.
programme.desc: Sables-d'Olonne mieste viskas paruošta regatos startui. Kol regatos dalyviai ruošiasi išplaukti, vietos veikėjo nužudymas sutrikdo pasirengimus. Auka buvo vieno iš dalyvių rėmėjas. Tyrimą pradeda leitenantai Kamara ir Finet. (Meurtres à...). [7+]. Romantiniai. Dramos. Mistika. Trileriai. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Žingsnis iki dangaus.
programme.desc: Pagrindiniai serialo herojai - visų gerbiamas miško prižiūrėtojas Pjetras, kurio žmona tragiškai žuvo, ir iš didmiesčio atvykęs policijos pareigūnas Vinčensas. Jie skirtingi tarsi diena ir naktis, tačiau kartu imasi tirti nusikaltimus mažame Italijos miestelyje. Detektyvas ir komedija, drama, meilė, draugystė, praeities paslaptys ir santykiai su gamta bei žmonėmis - viskas čia susijungs į įspūdingas istorijas. (Un passo dal cielo). [7+]. Komedijos. Veiksmo.

programme.title: Anika.
programme.desc: Šmaikšti ir paslaptinga detektyvė Anika Strandhed vadovauja Jūrų žmogžudysčių skyriui, kurio užduotis - tirti žmogžudystes Škotijos vandenyse ir aplink juos. Ir antrąjame sezone, ji akylai tęsia savo bylas. (Annika). [14+]. Dramos. Kriminalai.
